name: Eritel LN 40mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET

ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET is used in adults to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

Common side effects of taking ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET Works

ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.

warnings.details: ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor for advice.
ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness after taking ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET as it may cause low blood pressure while standing up from sitting or lying position (orthostatic hypotension).

ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic renal insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function, bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis of the artery to a single functioning kidney. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, cholestasis, biliary obstructive disorders. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver impairment and elevated liver enzymes. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan, Cilnidipine or calcium channel antagonists such as amlodipine, nifedipine.

ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with advanced aortic stenosis. It should be used with caution in patients with aortic or mitral stenosis, obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, angina, ischaemic cardiopathy or ischaemic cardiovascular disease and congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking it.
ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking ERITEL LN 40MG TABLET

introduction:
Introduction About METOSARTAN 50MG TABLET

Metosartan 50mg Tablet is a combination medicine used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension). It may also be used to lower the risk of heart attack, heart failure and stroke in future. It contains Metoprolol and Telmisartan, which work together to control blood pressure and reduce the risk of heart-related complications.

It is recommended to take Metosartan 50mg Tablet with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

mechanismOfAction:
How METOSARTAN 50MG TABLET Works
How Metosartan 50mg Works for Hypertension:

Metosartan 50mg is a combination antihypertensive medication containing Metoprolol (a beta-blocker) and Telmisartan (an angiotensin receptor blocker - ARB). These two active ingredients work together to effectively lower high blood pressure and protect the heart from complications.

Metoprolol blocks beta receptors in the heart, reducing heart rate and the force of contraction, which lowers blood pressure and decreases the heart’s workload.
Telmisartan blocks the angiotensin II hormone, preventing blood vessel constriction, leading to wider blood vessels and improved blood flow, reducing BP levels.

This dual mechanism effectively controls hypertension, improves blood circulation, and reduces the risk of heart attacks, strokes, and kidney damage in hypertensive patients.

How Metosartan 50mg Works for Controlling Heart Attack:

Metosartan 50mg helps reduce the risk of heart attack by lowering blood pressure, improving blood flow, and reducing strain on the heart. It contains two key ingredients:

Metoprolol (Beta-Blocker): Slows down the heart rate and reduces the force of heart contractions, which lowers oxygen demand and prevents excessive stress on the heart, reducing the risk of heart attacks.
Telmisartan (Angiotensin Receptor Blocker - ARB): Helps relax and widen blood vessels, improving blood circulation and preventing sudden spikes in blood pressure, which can trigger heart attacks.

By controlling hypertension, improving heart efficiency, and reducing cardiovascular stress, Metosartan 50mg plays a crucial role in preventing heart attacks and other heart-related complications in high-risk patients. Regular use under medical supervision ensures optimal heart protection and long-term cardiovascular health.

Metosartan 50mg: Morning or Night?

Metosartan 50mg can be taken either in the morning or at night, depending on your doctor’s recommendation. However, if it causes dizziness or drowsiness, taking it at night may be beneficial.

Metosartan 50mg: Once or Twice Daily?

The dosage frequency depends on your doctor’s prescription and your blood pressure levels. While many patients take Metosartan 50mg once daily, some may need twice-daily dosing for better BP control.

Metosartan 50mg Tablet Dosage Instructions:
Standard Dosage for Hypertension: Usually one tablet per day or as directed by the doctor.
Dosage Adjustment in Elderly Patients: Lower doses may be required due to age-related changes in kidney and liver function.
Adjusting Metosartan 50mg Dose for Better BP Control:

If blood pressure is not adequately controlled, your doctor may adjust the dose or combine it with other antihypertensive medications for better results. Never adjust the dose on your own.

How Many Times Should I Take Metosartan 50mg Daily?

Most patients take Metosartan 50mg once daily, but in severe hypertension cases, doctors may prescribe twice-daily dosing for better control.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of METOSARTAN 50MG TABLET

Like all medicines, Metosartan 50mg Tablet may cause certain side effects although not everybody gets them.

Common Side Effects of Metosartan 50mg:
Dizziness or fatigue
Low blood pressure
Slow heart rate
Nausea
Diarrhoea
Itchy skin and rashes
Vertigo (sudden internal or external spinning sensation)
Metosartan 50mg Long-Term Side Effects:

Long-term use of Metosartan 50mg is generally safe when taken under medical supervision. However, prolonged use may cause:

Electrolyte imbalances (low sodium or potassium levels)
Kidney function changes (if not monitored properly)
Heart rate irregularities in some individuals
Increased risk of low blood pressure (hypotension)
Fatigue or decreased exercise tolerance

Regular blood pressure, kidney function, and electrolyte level monitoring can help prevent these complications.

Metosartan 50mg Side Effects on Kidneys:

Metosartan 50mg can affect kidney function, especially in patients with pre-existing kidney disease. Possible effects include:

Changes in creatinine levels (indicating kidney stress)
Reduced kidney filtration rate (leading to fluid retention)
Electrolyte disturbances (such as high potassium levels)

Patients with kidney disease should have regular kidney function tests while on Metosartan.

Metosartan 50mg Side Effects on Heart:

Although Metosartan protects the heart, in some cases, it may cause:

Bradycardia (slow heart rate)
Excessive drop in blood pressure leading to fainting
Heart palpitations or irregular heartbeats
In rare cases, worsening of pre-existing heart failure
Metosartan 50mg Serious Side Effects:

Seek immediate medical attention if you experience:

Severe dizziness or fainting
Extreme weakness or confusion
Swelling of the face, lips, or throat (allergic reaction)
Shortness of breath or chest pain
High potassium levels (causing muscle weakness or irregular heartbeats)

It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring are required in such patients. Therefore, if you have any pre-existing kidney diseases, inform your doctor as a precaution before taking this medicine.

Metosartan 50mg Tablet is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Talk to your doctor as a precaution.

Storage
Store METOSARTAN 50MG TABLET at a temperature between 15°C to 30°C (59°F to 86°F). Avoid exposure to extreme heat or cold.
Keep the tablet in a dry place. Avoid storing it in areas with high humidity, such as bathrooms or near kitchen sinks, as moisture can degrade the medication.
Do not use METOSARTAN 50MG TABLET past its expiration date, as it may not be effective and could be harmful.
Dispose of unused or expired tablets according to local regulations. Do not flush them down the toilet or throw them in household trash.
Check the tablets regularly for any discoloration, crumbling, or unusual odor.
Store the medication in a secure, high place or a locked cabinet to prevent accidental ingestion by children or pets.

introduction:
Introduction About OPTIDOZ TABLET

OPTIDOZ TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take OPTIDOZ TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking OPTIDOZ TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking OPTIDOZ TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of OPTIDOZ TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How OPTIDOZ TABLET Works

OPTIDOZ TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicines before taking OPTIDOZ TABLET:

NSAIDs: Can reduce the blood pressure-lowering effect of OPTIDOZ TABLET, potentially leading to less control over hypertension.
Lithium: May increase the risk of lithium toxicity, requiring close monitoring of blood levels.
Other Antihypertensive Medications: Can enhance blood pressure-lowering effects, increasing the risk of hypotension.
Potassium Supplements: Risk of hyperkalemia, leading to potentially dangerous heart-related issues.
B. Other Drug-Drug interactions:
Direct renin inhibitor (Ex. Aliskiren)
Antimanic (Ex. Lithium)
Cardiac glycosides (Ex. Digoxin)
Antidiabetic drugs (Ex. glimepiride, insulin)
Antihyperlipidemics (Ex. Cholestyramine and Colestipol)
Phosphodiesterase inhibitors (Ex. Sildenafil)
Statins (Ex. Simvastatin)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. cyclosporine or tacrolimus)
C. Drug-food interactions:
High Potassium Foods: Should be consumed cautiously to prevent excessive potassium levels, which may lead to heart complications.
Alcohol: Can enhance dizziness and low blood pressure, increasing the risk of fainting.

Introduction About XSTAN AM TABLET

XSTAN AM TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take XSTAN AM TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking XSTAN AM TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking XSTAN AM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take XSTAN AM TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking XSTAN AM TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About LNTRIO 10 TABLET

LNTRIO 10 TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs.  It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness).

LNTRIO 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. LNTRIO 10 TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. LNTRIO 10 TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. LNTRIO 10 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

LNTRIO 10 TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking LNTRIO 10 TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.

CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

introduction:
Introduction About VALENTAS 100 TABLET

VALENTAS 100 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. VALENTAS 100 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking VALENTAS 100 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. VALENTAS 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking VALENTAS 100 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking VALENTAS 100 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages long-term heart failure in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of VALENTAS 100 TABLET
 Manages long-term heart failure in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How VALENTAS 100 TABLET Works

VALENTAS 100 TABLET helps to manage long-term heart failure, where sacubitril works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body and valsartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by blocking a substance called angiotensin-II (causing blood vessels to tighten) which is produced in the body and thus lowers the blood pressure.

Take VALENTAS 100 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow VALENTAS 100 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About OLKEM TRIO 12.5MG TABLET

OLKEM TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage essential hypertension.

Hypertension also known as high or raised blood pressure, is a condition in which the blood vessels have persistently raised pressure. Blood is carried from the heart to all parts of the body in the vessels. Each time the heart beats, it pumps blood into the vessels.

Blood pressure is created by the force of blood pushing against the walls of blood vessels (arteries) as it is pumped by the heart. The higher the pressure, the harder the heart has to pump.

During the course of management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure, kidney function and electrolyte balance at regular intervals to avoid any untoward side effects.

OLKEM TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. Consult your doctor before taking.

OLKEM TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breastmilk to the baby. Consult your doctor for advice.

Safety and efficacy in pediatric patients is not established. Consult your doctor before taking. OLKEM TRIO 12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients of 65 years and above. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking OLKEM TRIO 12.5MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned side effects persists for a longer duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How OLKEM TRIO 12.5MG TABLET Works

OLKEM TRIO 12.5MG TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing the blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels to relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction. Olmesartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (substance produced in your body which causes narrowing of blood vessels).

introduction:
Introduction About TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET

TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension
usesDetails:
Uses Of TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET
Hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET Works

TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

Always follow your doctor’s advice for the best results

Studies have shown that the combination of amlodipine and telmisartan may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET as it could make your dizzier.
TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having kidney problems.
TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver problems.
Do not take TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine and Telmisartan.

TELLZY AM 40MG TABLET should not be used in patients with severely decreased blood pressure. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from other heart problems such as heart attack, severe hypertensive crisis, etc,
It is not known whether the combination of amlodipine and telmisartan is safe for use in children aged below 18 years. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Have edema (swelling of hands and legs)

name: TELPLUS Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About TELPLUS TABLET

TELPLUS TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

TELPLUS TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking TELPLUS TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

TELPLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking TELPLUS TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.
uses: It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TELPLUS TABLET
It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
mechanismOfAction:
How TELPLUS TABLET Works

TELPLUS TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.
usageInstructions: Take TELPLUS TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow TELPLUS TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken with or without food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent blood levels.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to a sudden rise in blood pressure.
Regularly monitor your blood pressure to ensure the medication is working effectively.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of TELPLUS TABLET

Like all medicines, TELPLUS TABLET may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them

Most Common Side Effects of TELPLUS TABLET are:
Dizziness, headache
Peripheral edema (swelling of ankles, hands and legs)
Flushing
Upper respiratory tract infection including pharyngitis and sinusitis
Hyperkalaemia (increased potassium levels in the blood)
Slow heart rate
Low blood pressure
Stomach upset
Back or muscle pain, muscle spasms
Changes in taste

Stop taking TELPLUS TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Anaphylactic reaction
Angioedema (swelling underneath the skin)
Acute renal failure

warnings.details: TELPLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor for advice.
TELPLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness after taking TELPLUS TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELPLUS TABLET as it may cause low blood pressure while standing up from sitting or lying position (orthostatic hypotension).

TELPLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic renal insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function, bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis of the artery to a single functioning kidney. Consult your doctor before taking it.

TELPLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, cholestasis, biliary obstructive disorders. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver impairment and elevated liver enzymes. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TELPLUS TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan, Cilnidipine or calcium channel antagonists such as amlodipine, nifedipine.

TELPLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with advanced aortic stenosis. It should be used with caution in patients with aortic or mitral stenosis, obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, angina, ischaemic cardiopathy or ischaemic cardiovascular disease and congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking it.
TELPLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
TELPLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking TELPLUS TABLET.

Others

TELPLUS TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Primary aldosteronism

Before taking TELPLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Volume and/or sodium depletion by diuretic therapy, dietary salt restriction, diarrhoea or vomiting
Diabetes
Peripheral edema
Metabolic acidosis, cellular lysis (such as acute limb ischemia, rhabdomyolysis, extended trauma)

Potassium supplements, salt substitutes and potassium-sparing medicines (Ex. spironolactone) (used to manage fluid retention without potassium loss in the urine)

Trimethoprim, rifampicin, erythromycin (used to manage bacterial infection)

Heparin (used to manage or manage blood clots)
Phenytoin, barbiturates such as phenobarbital, pentobarbital (used to manage seizures)
Narcotics such as morphine (used to manage severe pain)

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of TELPLUS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. introduction:
Introduction About COVAMLO TABLET

COVAMLO TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensive agents. It is used primarily in the management of hypertension (to lower blood pressure) in stage 2 hypertensive patients. This medicine is used in adults and children the age of 6 years and above.

Hypertension is a condition where pressure is exerted on the walls of the blood vessels inside the body, making the heart difficult to pump blood out to other parts of the body. This leads to symptoms such as early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heart rhythms, vision changes, and buzzing in the ears. More severe forms may cause chest pain and muscle tremors. If left unmanageed, hypertension can cause persistent chest pain (also called angina), heart attacks, heart failure, and an irregular heartbeat, which can also get life-threatening.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to the medicine or any ingredients present in it, or if you have, liver, kidney or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects are headache, muscle cramps, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

It acts by widening of the blood vessels as a result it enhances the blood flow to all parts of the body easily, thereby causing reduction in blood pressure level.

introduction:
Introduction About TELMIGET LN TABLET

TELMIGET LN TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

TELMIGET LN TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking TELMIGET LN TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

TELMIGET LN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking TELMIGET LN TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELMIGET LN TABLET Works

TELMIGET LN TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.

name: VALENTAS 50 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About VALENTAS 50 TABLET

VALENTAS 50 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. VALENTAS 50 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking VALENTAS 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. VALENTAS 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking VALENTAS 50 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking VALENTAS 50 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages long-term heart failure in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of VALENTAS 50 TABLET
 Manages long-term heart failure in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How VALENTAS 50 TABLET Works

VALENTAS 50 TABLET helps to manage long-term heart failure, where sacubitril works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body and valsartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by blocking a substance called angiotensin-II (causing blood vessels to tighten) which is produced in the body and thus lowers the blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use VALENTAS 50 TABLET

Take VALENTAS 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow VALENTAS 50 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: TRIOLMESAR CH 40 Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET

TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine, Chlorthalidone and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to manage heart failure or stroke and can protect the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

It can also reduce the chances of fluid retention (edema) in the body that occurs due to some kidney or liver diseases. Take this medicine preferably in the mornings with food. While taking TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET, do not drink alcohol/grapefruit juice or go for a low-salt diet, as they may make further reduce your blood pressure. Consult your doctor for the best diet that can suit your health condition.

Before taking TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol levels, dehydration, or very low blood sodium, potassium or magnesium levels as a precaution.

TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves or cardiogenic shock. It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Do not take TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET are headache, dizziness, tiredness, weakness, high blood uric acid levels, low blood sodium or magnesium levels, diabetes, high blood potassium levels, low blood pressure, impotence in men, sore throat, runny nose, cough, flu-like symptoms, urinary tract infections and increased blood cholesterol levels. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET Works

TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET relaxes the blood vessels supplying various organs (such as heart, kidney, brain or others) which allows the blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also removes the excess fluids and electrolytes (sodium and water) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing edema and blood thickness. Collectively, these actions improve blood flow, reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump more blood with less pressure.
usageDetails:

Always take TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET is preferably taken during the mornings with food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk and harm the nursing infant. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems (such as kidney stones, renal artery stenosis, dialysis). It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver diseases. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Chlorthalidone or Olmesartan.

TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems such as heart failure, aortic stenosis (narrowing of arteries) or cardiogenic shock (inability of heart to pump blood). It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart, heart failure, irregular heartbeat, coronary heart disease or problems related with heart muscle or valves). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetes related kidney problems
Have abnormally very low blood pressure
Are not passing urine at all
Have low blood potassium levels (hypokalemia)
Have low blood sodium levels (signs include tiredness, confusion, muscle twitching, fits or lack of consciousness)
High blood calcium levels
Have gout
Have Addison’s disease (a problem in adrenal gland)

Before taking TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Severe uncontrollable increase in blood pressure (hypertensive crisis)
Have diabetes
Have high blood cholesterol levels
Have high blood potassium levels
Are undergoing any surgery (including dental surgery)
Are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Are on a low-salt diet
Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in adrenal gland)
Are undergoing any major surgery

Use in pediatrics:

TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years. It should be used in children and adolescents (aged between 6-17 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration.

Use in geriatrics:

TRIOLMESAR CH 40 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About CORTEL M 25MG TABLET

CORTEL M 25MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take CORTEL M 25MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.
uses: High blood pressure (hypertension)

usageInstructions: The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.

warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, CORTEL M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

CORTEL M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking CORTEL M 25MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking CORTEL M 25MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CORTEL M 25MG TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

CORTEL M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking CORTEL M 25MG TABLET.

CORTEL M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking CORTEL M 25MG TABLET.
CORTEL M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

CORTEL M 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking CORTEL M 25MG TABLET.

CORTEL M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking CORTEL M 25MG TABLET.

CORTEL M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking CORTEL M 25MG TABLET.

CORTEL M 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking CORTEL M 25MG TABLET.

Others

CORTEL M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking CORTEL M 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About CRESAR AM 40/5MG TABLET

CRESAR AM 40/5MG TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take CRESAR AM 40/5MG TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking CRESAR AM 40/5MG TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking CRESAR AM 40/5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take CRESAR AM 40/5MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking CRESAR AM 40/5MG TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CRESAR AM 40/5MG TABLET Works

CRESAR AM 40/5MG TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About TELSAANBETA 50MG TABLET

TELSAANBETA 50MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take TELSAANBETA 50MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

Introduction About ARBITEL TRIO 25 TABLET

ARBITEL TRIO 25 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol, and Telmisartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking ARBITEL TRIO 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration, or gout as a precaution.

ARBITEL TRIO 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ARBITEL TRIO 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines, such as:

Medicines used to manage advanced renal cell carcinoma (Ex. aldesleukin)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Medicines used for bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin)
Medicines used to manage hypertension (Ex. aliskiren, propranolol, amlodipine, diltiazem, verapamil, propafenone, captopril, enalapril, losartan, valsartan, clonidine, moxonidine, methyldopa, rilmenidine)
Medicines used for psychosis (Ex. risperidone, thioridazine, quetiapine, olanzapine)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (such as insulin, metformin, glimepiride, teneligliptin, and pioglitazone)
Cimetidine (a medicine used to manage stomach ulcers)
Medicines used to manage an uneven heartbeat (such as digoxin, disopyramide, quinidine, or amiodarone)
Medicines used for pain and inflammation (such as ibuprofen, indomethacin, sulindac, and diclofenac)
Medicines used to manage depression (such as fluoxetine, paroxetine, bupropion, and lithium)
Ritonavir (a medicine used to manage HIV infection)
Antihistamines (used to manage allergic reactions) such as diphenhydramine
Medicines used to manage malaria (such as hydroxychloroquine, mefloquine)
Terbinafine (a medicine used to manage fungal infection)
Adrenaline (a medicine used to stimulate heart functions)
Phenylpropanolamine (a medicine used to reduce the swelling of the nasal mucosa)
Beta blockers used for glaucoma (such as timolol, pindolol, and labetalol)
Ergotamine (a medicine used for migraine headache)
Medicines used to manage angina (such as nitroglycerin)
Anaesthetics (used to cause numbness or loss of sensation) such as lidocaine, sevoflurane, and halothane
Alpha blockers (used to manage high blood pressure and benign prostatic hyperplasia) such as prazosin, tamsulosin, terazosin, and doxazosin
Antacids (medicines used to neutralize stomach acid) such as aluminium hydroxide, magaldrate
Potassium supplements or potassium-sparing diuretics such as spironolactone, triamterene, or amiloride (used to retain or increase potassium levels in the body)
Heparin (a medicine used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. trimethoprim)
Medicines used to suppress immune functions (such as ciclosporin, tacrolimus)
Diuretics (used to reduce edema and blood pressure) such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more ARBITEL TRIO 25 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately. Overdosage may cause low blood pressure, decreased heartbeat, problems breathing, vomiting, feeling faint, and fits.

introduction:
Introduction About METORAY XL 25 TABLET

METORAY XL 25 TABLET is used in the management of high blood pressure, angina pectoris (chest pain), heart failure, arrhythmias or palpitations, heart attacks and migraine headaches. It contains Metoprolol which is a beta-blocker that works by controlling heart functions and reduces strain on the heart.

Take METORAY XL 25 TABLET only under medical supervision. It is usually taken with or immediately after meals. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor as a precaution.

Avoid alcohol consumption while taking this medicine as it lowers blood pressure. It is not recommended for use in patients with asthma, COPD, severe bradycardia, second or third-degree heart block, cardiogenic shock, cardiac failure, sick sinus syndrome (unless a permanent pacemaker is present) and unmanaged pheochromocytoma.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, stroke, liver or kidney disease or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

Low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, headache, cold hands and feet are some of the common side effects associated with the use metoprolol. These side effects are usually manageable. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How METORAY XL 25 TABLET Works

In hypertension, METORAY XL 25 TABLET works by blocking the effect of adrenaline on the heart and decreasing cardiac output, also reducing the outflow of sympathetic neurons, and suppressing renin activity (normally responsible for the increase in blood pressure). Together, these actions lower blood pressure effectively.

In angina pectoris, METORAY XL 25 TABLET works by blocking adrenaline effects on the heart and decreases the heart rate, blood pressure, and extent of heart contraction. It also reduces the oxygen requirements of the heart, providing relief from angina.

In heart failure, METORAY XL 25 TABLET slows down the heart rate and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood around the body.

It is usually recommended to take metoprolol with or immediately after a meal to enhance absorption and reduce side effects like dizziness
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine
Take the tablet at the same time each day, as this helps maintain consistent levels of the medication in your body
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember, but if it's almost time for your next dose, skip the missed one. Do not double the dose
Do not stop taking metoprolol abruptly, as it can worsen your condition. Always follow your doctor’s advice when discontinuing
Always consult your healthcare provider for personalized instructions

introduction:
Introduction About AMLODAC T TABLET

AMLODAC T TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take AMLODAC T TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking AMLODAC T TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMLODAC T TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take AMLODAC T TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking AMLODAC T TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLODAC T TABLET Works

AMLODAC T TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About DILNIP TM 50 TABLET

DILNIP TM 50 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol, and Telmisartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking DILNIP TM 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration, or gout as a precaution.

DILNIP TM 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

DILNIP TM 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as heart block, uncontrollable heart failure, sick sinus syndrome, or a very slow or uneven heartbeat). It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as a recent heart attack, angina attack, enlarged heart muscles, or surgery in the heart within the last 4 months). DILNIP TM 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About TACTILE 3D TABLET

TACTILE 3D TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take TACTILE 3D TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking TACTILE 3D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking TACTILE 3D TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of TACTILE 3D TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How TACTILE 3D TABLET Works

TACTILE 3D TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicines before taking TACTILE 3D TABLET:

NSAIDs: Can reduce the blood pressure-lowering effect of TACTILE 3D TABLET, potentially leading to less control over hypertension.
Lithium: May increase the risk of lithium toxicity, requiring close monitoring of blood levels.
Other Antihypertensive Medications: Can enhance blood pressure-lowering effects, increasing the risk of hypotension.
Potassium Supplements: Risk of hyperkalemia, leading to potentially dangerous heart-related issues.
B. Other Drug-Drug interactions:
Direct renin inhibitor (Ex. Aliskiren)
Antimanic (Ex. Lithium)
Cardiac glycosides (Ex. Digoxin)
Antidiabetic drugs (Ex. glimepiride, insulin)
Antihyperlipidemics (Ex. Cholestyramine and Colestipol)
Phosphodiesterase inhibitors (Ex. Sildenafil)
Statins (Ex. Simvastatin)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. cyclosporine or tacrolimus)
C. Drug-food interactions:
High Potassium Foods: Should be consumed cautiously to prevent excessive potassium levels, which may lead to heart complications.
Alcohol: Can enhance dizziness and low blood pressure, increasing the risk of fainting.

More Information
Diet and Lifestyle Tips for TACTILE 3D TABLET Users:
Limit Salt Intake: Excessive sodium can elevate blood pressure, so aim to keep salt intake low.
Focus on Whole Foods: Include fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your daily meals.
Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.
Increase Potassium-Rich Foods: Foods like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes help balance potassium levels.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration, which can exacerbate dizziness.
Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.
Manage Stress: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, yoga, or meditation.
Avoid Smoking and Excessive Alcohol: Both can interfere with the effectiveness of blood pressure medication.
Monitor Blood Pressure Regularly: Keep track of your readings and share them with your doctor.
Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to support overall health.

These tips can complement your treatment and help manage hypertension effectively. Always consult your doctor for personalized advice.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOPRES TL TABLET

AMLOPRES TL TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take AMLOPRES TL TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking AMLOPRES TL TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMLOPRES TL TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take AMLOPRES TL TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking AMLOPRES TL TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPRES TL TABLET Works

AMLOPRES TL TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET

CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain and muscle tremors (shakiness).

CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney and heart disease. CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.

mechanismOfAction:
How CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET Works

CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction. Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body which causes the narrowing of blood vessels).

Consult your doctor for advice.

Others

Gout or uric acid calculi
Addison’s disease

CETANIL TRIO 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET

TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.
uses: It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
