It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
mechanismOfAction:
How TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET Works

TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.

Swallow TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken with or without food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent blood levels.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to a sudden rise in blood pressure.
Regularly monitor your blood pressure to ensure the medication is working effectively.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.

warnings.details: TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor for advice.
TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness after taking TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET as it may cause low blood pressure while standing up from sitting or lying position (orthostatic hypotension).

TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic renal insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function, bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis of the artery to a single functioning kidney. Consult your doctor before taking it.

TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, cholestasis, biliary obstructive disorders. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver impairment and elevated liver enzymes. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan, Cilnidipine or calcium channel antagonists such as amlodipine, nifedipine.

TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with advanced aortic stenosis. It should be used with caution in patients with aortic or mitral stenosis, obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, angina, ischaemic cardiopathy or ischaemic cardiovascular disease and congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking it.
TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking TELPRES LN 40MG TABLET.

Others

Volume and/or sodium depletion by diuretic therapy, dietary salt restriction, diarrhoea or vomiting
Diabetes
Peripheral edema
Metabolic acidosis, cellular lysis (such as acute limb ischemia, rhabdomyolysis, extended trauma)

Introduction About OLKEM TRIO 40MG TABLET

OLKEM TRIO 40MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage essential hypertension.

Hypertension also known as high or raised blood pressure, is a condition in which the blood vessels have persistently raised pressure. Blood is carried from the heart to all parts of the body in the vessels. Each time the heart beats, it pumps blood into the vessels.

Blood pressure is created by the force of blood pushing against the walls of blood vessels (arteries) as it is pumped by the heart. The higher the pressure, the harder the heart has to pump.

During the course of management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure, kidney function and electrolyte balance at regular intervals to avoid any untoward side effects.

OLKEM TRIO 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. Consult your doctor before taking.

OLKEM TRIO 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breastmilk to the baby. Consult your doctor for advice.

Safety and efficacy in pediatric patients is not established. Consult your doctor before taking. OLKEM TRIO 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients of 65 years and above. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking OLKEM TRIO 40MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned side effects persists for a longer duration.

mechanismOfAction:
How OLKEM TRIO 40MG TABLET Works

OLKEM TRIO 40MG TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing the blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels to relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction. Olmesartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (substance produced in your body which causes narrowing of blood vessels).

introduction:
Introduction About VYMADA 200MG TABLET

VYMADA 200MG Tablet is a prescription medicine that combines Sacubitril and Valsartan, belonging to the class of angiotensin receptor-neprilysin inhibitors (ARNI). It is recommended for patients with chronic heart failure (NYHA Class II–IV) with reduced ejection fraction to help lower the chances of cardiovascular death and hospital admissions. By improving heart function and reducing stress on the heart, VYMADA 200MG Tablet supports better long-term outcomes in individuals already on standard heart failure therapies.

VYMADA 200MG Tablet can be taken with or without food, preferably at the same time each day for consistent results. The dosage and frequency will be decided by your doctor based on your health condition and response to the medicine. It is important to continue taking the tablet regularly as prescribed and avoid missing doses to achieve the best outcomes. Do not discontinue the medication on your own, even if you feel better, as ongoing use helps maintain heart function and lowers the chances of future health risks.

Common side effects of VYMADA 200MG Tablet may include low blood pressure (hypotension), changes in kidney function, increased potassium levels (hyperkalemia), cough, nausea, and dizziness. To minimize dizziness linked with a drop in blood pressure, rise slowly when moving from a sitting or lying position. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects persist, become bothersome, or if you notice other unusual symptoms.

Before using VYMADA 200MG Tablet, inform your doctor if you are taking any medicines for blood pressure, heart conditions, kidney problems, or liver disorders. Share a complete list of your ongoing medications, as some may interact with this tablet. VYMADA 200MG Tablet should not be used during pregnancy and is not recommended while breastfeeding. During therapy, your doctor may suggest regular monitoring of blood pressure, kidney function, and overall health status to ensure safe and effective use.

mechanismOfAction:
How VYMADA 200MG TABLET Works

VYMADA 200MG Tablet combines Sacubitril and Valsartan to support heart health by enhancing natural protective pathways and reducing excessive strain on the heart.

ARNI Technology in Vymada

As an angiotensin receptor–neprilysin inhibitor (ARNI), VYMADA 200MG Tablet brings together the dual actions of blocking harmful effects of angiotensin II and boosting beneficial heart-protective peptides.

Sacubitril and Valsartan Effects
Sacubitril increases levels of natriuretic peptides, promoting vasodilation and easing fluid overload.
Valsartan blocks angiotensin II receptors, helping arteries relax and lowering the stress on the heart.
How Vymada Supports Heart Function

By reducing excessive pressure, improving circulation, and helping the heart pump more effectively, VYMADA 200MG Tablet contributes to better overall cardiac performance.

Natriuretic Peptides and Heart Health

Natriuretic peptides are natural body chemicals that widen blood vessels, reduce fluid buildup, and improve cardiovascular balance. VYMADA helps enhance their action, contributing to improved heart efficiency.

Role of Neprilysin Inhibition in Cardiac Care

Neprilysin normally breaks down natriuretic peptides. Sacubitril inhibits neprilysin activity, allowing these peptides to stay active longer and provide continuous cardiovascular support.

introduction:
Introduction About OLMARK A 20MG TABLET

OLMARK A 20MG TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OLMARK A 20MG TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OLMARK A 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLMARK A 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How OLMARK A 20MG TABLET Works

OLMARK A 20MG TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIOLSAR 40MG TABLET

TRIOLSAR 40MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine, Chlorthalidone and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to manage heart failure or stroke and can protect the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

It can also reduce the chances of fluid retention (edema) in the body that occurs due to some kidney or liver diseases. Take this medicine preferably in the mornings with food. While taking TRIOLSAR 40MG TABLET, do not drink alcohol/grapefruit juice or go for a low-salt diet, as they may make further reduce your blood pressure. Consult your doctor for the best diet that can suit your health condition.

Before taking TRIOLSAR 40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol levels, dehydration, or very low blood sodium, potassium or magnesium levels as a precaution.

TRIOLSAR 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves or cardiogenic shock. It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Do not take TRIOLSAR 40MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking TRIOLSAR 40MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, tiredness, weakness, high blood uric acid levels, low blood sodium or magnesium levels, diabetes, high blood potassium levels, low blood pressure, impotence in men, sore throat, runny nose, cough, flu-like symptoms, urinary tract infections and increased blood cholesterol levels. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TRIOLSAR 40MG TABLET Works

TRIOLSAR 40MG TABLET relaxes the blood vessels supplying various organs (such as heart, kidney, brain or others) which allows the blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also removes the excess fluids and electrolytes (sodium and water) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing edema and blood thickness. Collectively, these actions improve blood flow, reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump more blood with less pressure.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking TRIOLSAR 40MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

Introduction About CARDEXA 50 TABLET

CARDEXA 50 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol, and Telmisartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking CARDEXA 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration, or gout as a precaution.

CARDEXA 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About METOSARTAN CH 50/6.25 TABLET

METOSARTAN CH 50/6.25 TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

METOSARTAN CH 50/6.25 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.METOSARTAN CH 50/6.25 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

METOSARTAN CH 50/6.25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking METOSARTAN CH 50/6.25 TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How METOSARTAN CH 50/6.25 TABLET Works

METOSARTAN CH 50/6.25 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

How to use METOSARTAN CH 50/6.25 TABLET

Take METOSARTAN CH 50/6.25 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. The correct dosage and duration of medicine to be taken will be prescribed by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET

TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine, Hydrochlorothiazide and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

During management with TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, muscle cramps and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET
Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET Works

TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET

Take TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET at the same time each day. TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Continue to take TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

warnings.details: TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the growing fetus. Therefore, inform your doctor before taking TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby. If you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET, stop taking it and consult your doctor immediately.
TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (such as kidney transplant, narrowing of renal arteries). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, biliary obstruction). It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Olmesartan or Hydrochlorothiazide.

TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with serious heart problem (such as heart failure or heart attack). It should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as irregular heart rhythm and problems with heart muscle or valves). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have diabetes related kidney problems

Before taking TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in adrenal gland)
Have low blood pressure
Are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Are on a low-salt diet
Have diabetes
Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)
Have unstable angina (a type of chest pain)
Have narrowing of arteries
Have gout (painful joints)
Have had skin cancer

Use in pediatrics:

TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

TRIOLMESAR 40 TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About SACURISE 50 TABLET

What is SACURISE 50 Tablet?

SACURISE 50 Tablet is a combination of Sacubitril (24 mg) and Valsartan (26 mg), medications that assist in managing chronic heart conditions by helping relax blood vessels and improving heart pumping efficiency. This combination helps support better blood flow and reduces strain on the heart for individuals with heart function concerns.

Monitor blood pressure and kidney function regularly during use. Discuss all existing health conditions and medications with your healthcare provider before starting SACURISE 50 Tablet.

Before taking SACURISE 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. It is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

The most common side effects of taking SACURISE 50 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

MET XL TRIO 50 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol, and Telmisartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking MET XL TRIO 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration, or gout as a precaution.

introduction:
Introduction About SACU V 50 TABLET

SACU V 50 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. SACU V 50 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking SACU V 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. SACU V 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking SACU V 50 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking SACU V 50 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages long-term heart failure in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of SACU V 50 TABLET
 Manages long-term heart failure in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How SACU V 50 TABLET Works

SACU V 50 TABLET helps to manage long-term heart failure, where sacubitril works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body and valsartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by blocking a substance called angiotensin-II (causing blood vessels to tighten) which is produced in the body and thus lowers the blood pressure.

Take SACU V 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow SACU V 50 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TSART TRIO 12.5MG TABLET

TSART TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs.  It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness).

TSART TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. TSART TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. TSART TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. TSART TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

TSART TRIO 12.5MG TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking TSART TRIO 12.5MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.

Lower the risk of stroke and heart attack

Manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure) in adults
Lower the risk of stroke and heart attack
mechanismOfAction:
How TSART TRIO 12.5MG TABLET Works

TSART TRIO 12.5MG TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction. Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body which causes the narrowing of blood vessels).

introduction:
Introduction About TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET

TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. Essential hypertension (primary hypertension) occurs when you have abnormally high blood pressure that's not the result of a medical condition. It is characterized by symptoms such as blurred vision, severe headache, chest pain, dizziness, light-headedness and nose bleeds.

TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney and heart problems. Avoid eating or drinking grapefruit juice while taking TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET as it may potentiate the risk of side effects. Prior to management with TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET or during the course of management, your doctor may want you to take several tests to understand your health condition.

TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding woman. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged less than 18 years) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).   

The common side effects of taking TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, loss of appetite, stomach upset and skin rashes. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

Manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET Works

TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles and chlorthalidone works by promoting the excretion of excess fluid and certain electrolytes (such as sodium and chloride) from the body by increasing the amount of urine produced by the kidneys. Telmisartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by managing the binding of certain substance called angiotensin-II (substance produced in the body which causes narrowing of blood vessels). All these actions together effectively control high blood pressure.

How to use TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET

Take TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TRITELSAR 40MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TELSAR BISO 2.5 TABLET

TELSAR BISO 2.5 TABLET is used to manage hypertension, angina (chest pain) and heart failure in adults. It is a combination of Bisoprolol and Telmisartan which works by relaxing your blood vessels supplying the heart which in turn reduces strain on the heart. It is also used to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events such as heart attack or stroke in adults who are known to have a reduced or blocked blood supply to the heart or legs and had a stroke or with a high risk of diabetes.

Your doctor may check your kidney function test, blood pressure and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your body prior to the management or at regular intervals during management with this medicine. TELSAR BISO 2.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (flow of bile from liver stops or slows). TELSAR BISO 2.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having diabetes, kidney disease, heart problems and raised aldosterone levels.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELSAR BISO 2.5 TABLET Works

TELSAR BISO 2.5 TABLET contains two medicines namely, bisoprolol and telmisartan. Bisoprolol works by blocking beta-1 receptors in the heart, which slows the heart rate, reduces the force of the heart's contractions, and lowers blood pressure. This helps the heart work more efficiently and reduces its workload, making bisoprolol effective for high blood pressure, chest pain (angina), and heart failure.

Telmisartan is an Angiotensin Receptor Blocker. It works by blocking the angiotensin receptor in the body which helps in keeping the blood vessels relaxed, thus lowering the strain on heart and enables heart to pump blood more easily.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNY O 20MG TABLET

CILNY O 20MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Before taking CILNY O 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

CILNY O 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking CILNY O 20MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with CILNY O 20MG TABLET.

During management with CILNY O 20MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking CILNY O 20MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILNY O 20MG TABLET Works

CILNY O 20MG TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Olmesartan. Olmesartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Cilnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Take CILNY O 20MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take CILNY O 20MG TABLET at the same time each day. CILNY O 20MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take CILNY O 20MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About NEWTEL BETA TABLET

NEWTEL BETA TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take NEWTEL BETA TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

Therefore, NEWTEL BETA TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

NEWTEL BETA TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking NEWTEL BETA TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking NEWTEL BETA TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NEWTEL BETA TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

NEWTEL BETA TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking NEWTEL BETA TABLET.

NEWTEL BETA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking NEWTEL BETA TABLET.
NEWTEL BETA TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

NEWTEL BETA TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking NEWTEL BETA TABLET.

NEWTEL BETA TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking NEWTEL BETA TABLET.

NEWTEL BETA TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking NEWTEL BETA TABLET.

NEWTEL BETA TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking NEWTEL BETA TABLET.

Others

NEWTEL BETA TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)

Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET

TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine, Hydrochlorothiazide and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

During management with TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, muscle cramps and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET
Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET Works

TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET

Take TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET at the same time each day. TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Continue to take TRIPIN OM 40MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

Introduction About VENPRES M 50 TABLET

VENPRES M 50 TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take VENPRES M 50 TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

How VENPRES M 50 TABLET Works

VENPRES M 50 TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.

The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

Therefore, VENPRES M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

VENPRES M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking VENPRES M 50 TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking VENPRES M 50 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking VENPRES M 50 TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

VENPRES M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking VENPRES M 50 TABLET.

VENPRES M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking VENPRES M 50 TABLET.
VENPRES M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

VENPRES M 50 TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking VENPRES M 50 TABLET.

VENPRES M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking VENPRES M 50 TABLET.

VENPRES M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking VENPRES M 50 TABLET.

VENPRES M 50 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking VENPRES M 50 TABLET.

Others

VENPRES M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking VENPRES M 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About TELDAWN LNB 25 TABLET

TELDAWN LNB 25 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol, and Telmisartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking TELDAWN LNB 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration, or gout as a precaution.

TELDAWN LNB 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TELDAWN LNB 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines, such as:

Medicines used to manage advanced renal cell carcinoma (Ex. aldesleukin)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Medicines used for bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin)
Medicines used to manage hypertension (Ex. aliskiren, propranolol, amlodipine, diltiazem, verapamil, propafenone, captopril, enalapril, losartan, valsartan, clonidine, moxonidine, methyldopa, rilmenidine)
Medicines used for psychosis (Ex. risperidone, thioridazine, quetiapine, olanzapine)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (such as insulin, metformin, glimepiride, teneligliptin, and pioglitazone)
Cimetidine (a medicine used to manage stomach ulcers)
Medicines used to manage an uneven heartbeat (such as digoxin, disopyramide, quinidine, or amiodarone)
Medicines used for pain and inflammation (such as ibuprofen, indomethacin, sulindac, and diclofenac)
Medicines used to manage depression (such as fluoxetine, paroxetine, bupropion, and lithium)
Ritonavir (a medicine used to manage HIV infection)
Antihistamines (used to manage allergic reactions) such as diphenhydramine
Medicines used to manage malaria (such as hydroxychloroquine, mefloquine)
Terbinafine (a medicine used to manage fungal infection)
Adrenaline (a medicine used to stimulate heart functions)
Phenylpropanolamine (a medicine used to reduce the swelling of the nasal mucosa)
Beta blockers used for glaucoma (such as timolol, pindolol, and labetalol)
Ergotamine (a medicine used for migraine headache)
Medicines used to manage angina (such as nitroglycerin)
Anaesthetics (used to cause numbness or loss of sensation) such as lidocaine, sevoflurane, and halothane
Alpha blockers (used to manage high blood pressure and benign prostatic hyperplasia) such as prazosin, tamsulosin, terazosin, and doxazosin
Antacids (medicines used to neutralize stomach acid) such as aluminium hydroxide, magaldrate
Potassium supplements or potassium-sparing diuretics such as spironolactone, triamterene, or amiloride (used to retain or increase potassium levels in the body)
Heparin (a medicine used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. trimethoprim)
Medicines used to suppress immune functions (such as ciclosporin, tacrolimus)
Diuretics (used to reduce edema and blood pressure) such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more TELDAWN LNB 25 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately. Overdosage may cause low blood pressure, decreased heartbeat, problems breathing, vomiting, feeling faint, and fits.

introduction:
Introduction About OLMESAR A 40MG TABLET

OLMESAR A 40MG TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OLMESAR A 40MG TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OLMESAR A 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLMESAR A 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

usesDetails:
Uses Of OLMESAR A 40MG TABLET
It is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone
mechanismOfAction:
How OLMESAR A 40MG TABLET Works

OLMESAR A 40MG TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

OLMESAR A 40MG TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function are required in such patients.

introduction:
Introduction About TELPLUS TRIO TABLET

TELPLUS TRIO TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

TELPLUS TRIO TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking TELPLUS TRIO TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

TELPLUS TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking TELPLUS TRIO TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.
uses: It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)

Uses Of TELPLUS TRIO TABLET
It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
mechanismOfAction:
How TELPLUS TRIO TABLET Works

TELPLUS TRIO TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.

Swallow TELPLUS TRIO TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken with or without food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent blood levels.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to a sudden rise in blood pressure.
Regularly monitor your blood pressure to ensure the medication is working effectively.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.

Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness after taking TELPLUS TRIO TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELPLUS TRIO TABLET as it may cause low blood pressure while standing up from sitting or lying position (orthostatic hypotension).

TELPLUS TRIO TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic renal insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function, bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis of the artery to a single functioning kidney. Consult your doctor before taking it.

TELPLUS TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, cholestasis, biliary obstructive disorders. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver impairment and elevated liver enzymes. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take TELPLUS TRIO TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan, Cilnidipine or calcium channel antagonists such as amlodipine, nifedipine.

TELPLUS TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with advanced aortic stenosis. It should be used with caution in patients with aortic or mitral stenosis, obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, angina, ischaemic cardiopathy or ischaemic cardiovascular disease and congestive heart failure. TELPLUS TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
TELPLUS TRIO TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking TELPLUS TRIO TABLET.

Introduction About AZMARDA 100MG TABLET

AZMARDA 100MG TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. AZMARDA 100MG TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking AZMARDA 100MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. AZMARDA 100MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking AZMARDA 100MG TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking AZMARDA 100MG TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ACMETEL AMH TABLET

ACMETEL AMH TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take ACMETEL AMH TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking ACMETEL AMH TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking ACMETEL AMH TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of ACMETEL AMH TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACMETEL AMH TABLET Works

ACMETEL AMH TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The recommended dosage is determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to treatment.

Take this medicine at the same time each day to maintain a steady level of medication in your body.
Avoid Nighttime Doses: As this medicine contains a diuretic, avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent excessive urination at night.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
If it’s close to the time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one.
Taking more than the prescribed dose may lead to serious symptoms such as severe dizziness, fainting, or a significant drop in blood pressure.
In case of suspected overdose, seek immediate medical attention or visit the nearest emergency room.
Stopping this medication suddenly can cause your blood pressure to rise significantly, increasing the risk of heart attack or stroke.
Always consult your doctor before discontinuing the medication. They may gradually reduce your dose if necessary.
Stay hydrated to prevent side effects like muscle cramps, dry mouth, or weakness.
Follow your doctor’s advice on lifestyle changes such as a low-salt diet, regular exercise, and stress management to improve the effectiveness of the medication.

It is also used with caution if you have severe congestive heart failure and volume depletion due to the increased risk of developing oliguria, progressive azotemia, or acute renal failure on this medication.

Diet and Lifestyle Tips for ACMETEL AMH TABLET Users:
Limit Salt Intake: Excessive sodium can elevate blood pressure, so aim to keep salt intake low.
Focus on Whole Foods: Include fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your daily meals.
Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.
Increase Potassium-Rich Foods: Foods like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes help balance potassium levels.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration, which can exacerbate dizziness.
Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.
Manage Stress: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, yoga, or meditation.
Avoid Smoking and Excessive Alcohol: Both can interfere with the effectiveness of blood pressure medication.
Monitor Blood Pressure Regularly: Keep track of your readings and share them with your doctor.
Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to support overall health.

Introduction About ARNICOR 50 TABLET

ARNICOR 50 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. ARNICOR 50 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking ARNICOR 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. ARNICOR 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking ARNICOR 50 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking ARNICOR 50 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About TELMAXX 25MG TABLET

TELMAXX 25MG TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels which is characterized by symptoms such as severe headache, nose bleeding, fatigue, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

Your doctor might advise you to take kidney function tests (to assess the function of your kidney), monitoring of blood pressure and regular blood tests to check the electrolytes such as potassium levels in the blood. TELMAXX 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with bronchospastic lung diseases such as asthma, emphysema or other lung infections, severe liver problems, impaired kidney function, heart disease such as severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock and planned for non-cardiac surgery.

Before taking TELMAXX 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands), diabetes, low blood pressure due to dehydration or have undergone kidney transplant surgery. TELMAXX 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TELMAXX 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The common side effects associated with the use of TELMAXX 25MG TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About TELSKY CN TABLET

TELSKY CN TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

TELSKY CN TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking TELSKY CN TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

TELSKY CN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking TELSKY CN TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELSKY CN TABLET Works

TELSKY CN TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About TRICINOD 10/12.5MG TABLET

TRICINOD 10/12.5MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs.  It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness).

TRICINOD 10/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. TRICINOD 10/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. TRICINOD 10/12.5MG TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. TRICINOD 10/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

TRICINOD 10/12.5MG TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking TRICINOD 10/12.5MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.
