mechanismOfAction:
How TELMED AH 40MG TABLET Works

TELMED AH 40MG TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
If it’s close to the time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one.
Taking more than the prescribed dose may lead to serious symptoms such as severe dizziness, fainting, or a significant drop in blood pressure.
In case of suspected overdose, seek immediate medical attention or visit the nearest emergency room.
Stopping this medication suddenly can cause your blood pressure to rise significantly, increasing the risk of heart attack or stroke.
Always consult your doctor before discontinuing the medication. They may gradually reduce your dose if necessary.
Stay hydrated to prevent side effects like muscle cramps, dry mouth, or weakness.

Diet and Lifestyle Tips for TELMED AH 40MG TABLET Users:
Limit Salt Intake: Excessive sodium can elevate blood pressure, so aim to keep salt intake low.
Focus on Whole Foods: Include fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your daily meals.
Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.
Increase Potassium-Rich Foods: Foods like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes help balance potassium levels.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration, which can exacerbate dizziness.
Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.
Manage Stress: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, yoga, or meditation.
Avoid Smoking and Excessive Alcohol: Both can interfere with the effectiveness of blood pressure medication.
Monitor Blood Pressure Regularly: Keep track of your readings and share them with your doctor.
Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to support overall health.

These tips can complement your treatment and help manage hypertension effectively. Always consult your doctor for personalized advice.

Introduction About NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET

NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Before taking NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET.

During management with NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET Works

NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Olmesartan. Olmesartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Cilnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

How to use NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET

Take NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET at the same time each day. NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take NEXOVAS O 20MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

Introduction About CILNEP TRIO TABLET

CILNEP TRIO TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs.  It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness).

CILNEP TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. CILNEP TRIO TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. CILNEP TRIO TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. CILNEP TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CILNEP TRIO TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CILNEP TRIO TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.

How CILNEP TRIO TABLET Works

CILNEP TRIO TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction. Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body which causes the narrowing of blood vessels).

Introduction About NEXOVAS T TABLET

NEXOVAS T Tablet combines Cilnidipine (10 mg) and Telmisartan (40 mg) support healthy blood pressure levels by relaxing and widening blood vessels. This dual-action approach helps improve circulation and reduce strain on the heart.

Cilnidipine blocks calcium entry into blood vessel muscles, promoting vessel widening and reducing tension. Telmisartan blocks the effects of a hormone that narrows blood vessels, leading to improved blood flow and reduced cardiac workload.

Take the tablet whole with water, preferably at the same time each day for consistent effects. Do not crush or chew the tablet to ensure proper release of active ingredients. Regular monitoring by your healthcare provider is important for optimal management. Complement medication with lifestyle habits such as a balanced diet low in salt and fat, regular physical activity, and avoiding smoking.

Inform your healthcare provider of any existing kidney or liver issues before starting NEXOVAS T. Avoid alcohol consumption while taking this medication, as it may increase dizziness or low blood pressure. Inform the provider about all current medications to manage interactions. Pregnant or breastfeeding individuals should seek medical advice prior to use.

The most common effects may include dizziness, headache, swelling in the feet or ankles, fatigue, and mild stomach discomfort. If side effects persist or cause concern, consult a healthcare provider promptly.

How NEXOVAS T TABLET Works

Cilnidipine blocks calcium entry into blood vessel muscles, promoting vessel widening and reducing tension. Telmisartan blocks the effects of a hormone that narrows blood vessels, leading to improved blood flow and reduced cardiac workload.

Importance of Vasodilation in Blood Pressure Control
Vasodilation plays a crucial role in controlling blood pressure by relaxing and widening blood vessels, which helps reduce the resistance the heart faces when pumping blood
When blood vessels dilate, the diameter increases, allowing blood to flow more freely and lowering the overall pressure within the arterial system. This process significantly contributes to maintaining a healthy blood pressure range and reducing the workload on the heart
Vasodilation helps counteract this by relaxing the smooth muscle lining the vessel walls, improving circulation and oxygen delivery to tissues
Maintaining vasodilation not only helps control blood pressure but also protects vital organs such as the heart, brain, and kidneys from damage caused by high pressure. It contributes to overall cardiovascular health and reduces the risk of complications like stroke and heart attack

More Information
Explain why these habits matter in conjunction with the tablet for holistic wellness
Enhance Medication Effectiveness: Healthy habits such as a balanced diet and regular exercise complement NEXOVAS T Tablet by helping to naturally regulate blood pressure and reduce cardiovascular strain
Reduce Side Effects: Avoiding alcohol and smoking minimizes additional vascular stress and potential interaction risks, improving medication tolerance and decreasing side effect incidence
Support Cardiovascular Health: Low-sodium diets and physical activity improve blood vessel elasticity and heart function, augmenting the tablet’s vasodilatory and antihypertensive effects
Promote Weight Management: Maintaining a healthy weight reduces the workload on the heart and blood vessels, enhancing overall blood pressure control alongside the medication
Improve Compliance and Outcomes: Lifestyle adjustments encourage patient engagement and adherence, leading to sustained blood pressure management and better long-term health outcomes.
Manages Comorbidities: Managing stress, diet, and activity lowers risks of diabetes and kidney issues, conditions that can complicate hypertension and affect treatment response
How NEXOVAS T differs from single-component drugs or other combination therapies, emphasizing the dual mechanism benefits?
NEXOVAS T Tablet differs from single-component drugs and other combination therapies primarily due to its dual mechanism of action, combining Cilnidipine and Telmisartan. Cilnidipine, a unique dual L- and N-type calcium channel blocker, relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting calcium influx and also reduces sympathetic nerve activity, resulting in less peripheral edema compared to traditional L-type blockers like amlodipine. Telmisartan, an angiotensin II receptor blocker, complements this by managing hormone-mediated vessel constriction, leading to effective and sustained blood pressure reduction
This combination provides enhanced efficacy through synergistic effects on vascular relaxation and hormonal regulation, targeting multiple pathways involved in hypertension. Compared to single drugs, it offers superior blood pressure control, reduced side effects such as pedal edema, and added organ protection benefits, including renal and cardiovascular support.
NEXOVAS T demonstrates better tolerability, potentially improving patient adherence and outcomes in diverse populations, especially those with metabolic or renal concerns.
In summary, NEXOVAS T's dual-action approach targets both neural and hormonal contributors to hypertension, delivering comprehensive blood pressure management with an improved safety profile, distinguishing it from monotherapies and standard fixed-dose combinations

introduction:
Introduction About ARBITEL AM 40MG TABLET

ARBITEL AM 40MG TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take ARBITEL AM 40MG TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking ARBITEL AM 40MG TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ARBITEL AM 40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take ARBITEL AM 40MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking ARBITEL AM 40MG TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How ARBITEL AM 40MG TABLET Works

ARBITEL AM 40MG TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About TSART M 40/25MG TABLET

TSART M 40/25MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take TSART M 40/25MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

Consult your doctor for advice before taking TSART M 40/25MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About TELEFIX TRIO TABLET

TELEFIX TRIO TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take TELEFIX TRIO TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking TELEFIX TRIO TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking TELEFIX TRIO TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of TELEFIX TRIO TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELEFIX TRIO TABLET Works

TELEFIX TRIO TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

Take this medicine at the same time each day to maintain a steady level of medication in your body.
Avoid Nighttime Doses: As this medicine contains a diuretic, avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent excessive urination at night.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
If it’s close to the time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one.
Taking more than the prescribed dose may lead to serious symptoms such as severe dizziness, fainting, or a significant drop in blood pressure.
In case of suspected overdose, seek immediate medical attention or visit the nearest emergency room.
Stopping this medication suddenly can cause your blood pressure to rise significantly, increasing the risk of heart attack or stroke.
Always consult your doctor before discontinuing the medication. They may gradually reduce your dose if necessary.
Stay hydrated to prevent side effects like muscle cramps, dry mouth, or weakness.
Follow your doctor’s advice on lifestyle changes such as a low-salt diet, regular exercise, and stress management to improve the effectiveness of the medication.

Limit Salt Intake: Excessive sodium can elevate blood pressure, so aim to keep salt intake low.
Focus on Whole Foods: Include fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your daily meals.
Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.

Introduction About TELISTA TRIO CL TABLET

TELISTA TRIO CL TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs.  It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness).

TELISTA TRIO CL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. TELISTA TRIO CL TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. TELISTA TRIO CL TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. TELISTA TRIO CL TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

TELISTA TRIO CL TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking TELISTA TRIO CL TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET

TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine, Chlorthalidone and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to manage heart failure or stroke and can protect the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

It can also reduce the chances of fluid retention (edema) in the body that occurs due to some kidney or liver diseases. Take this medicine preferably in the mornings with food. While taking TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET, do not drink alcohol/grapefruit juice or go for a low-salt diet, as they may make further reduce your blood pressure. Consult your doctor for the best diet that can suit your health condition.

Before taking TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol levels, dehydration, or very low blood sodium, potassium or magnesium levels as a precaution.

TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves or cardiogenic shock. It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Do not take TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, tiredness, weakness, high blood uric acid levels, low blood sodium or magnesium levels, diabetes, high blood potassium levels, low blood pressure, impotence in men, sore throat, runny nose, cough, flu-like symptoms, urinary tract infections and increased blood cholesterol levels. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET Works

TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET relaxes the blood vessels supplying various organs (such as heart, kidney, brain or others) which allows the blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also removes the excess fluids and electrolytes (sodium and water) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing edema and blood thickness. Collectively, these actions improve blood flow, reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump more blood with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET

Always take TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET is preferably taken during the mornings with food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking TRIOLSAR 20MG TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET

ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET is a combination of Azelnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage stage II hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) and stroke. During management with ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea. Avoid taking grapefruit juice while taking this medicine as it may reduce the risk of side effects.

ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET Works

ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Azelnidipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Azelnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Take ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET at the same time each day. ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking ZEBLONG T 80 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About ARNICOR 200 TABLET

ARNICOR 200 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. ARNICOR 200 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking ARNICOR 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. ARNICOR 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking ARNICOR 200 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking ARNICOR 200 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages long-term heart failure in adults

mechanismOfAction:
How ARNICOR 200 TABLET Works

ARNICOR 200 TABLET helps to manage long-term heart failure, where sacubitril works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body and valsartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by blocking a substance called angiotensin-II (causing blood vessels to tighten) which is produced in the body and thus lowers the blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ARNICOR 200 TABLET

Take ARNICOR 200 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow ARNICOR 200 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Avoid driving or handling any machines while taking ARNICOR 200 TABLET because it may cause dizziness or tiredness.
ARNICOR 200 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe kidney disease and with narrowed kidney artery. Consult your doctor before taking ARNICOR 200 TABLET.

ARNICOR 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease and it should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking ARNICOR 200 TABLET.

Vomiting or diarrhea

name: Telmed Beta 25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET

TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

Protects Organs: Prevents damage to vital organs like the brain, heart, and kidneys caused by prolonged high blood pressure.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET Works

TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageInstructions: The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET.

TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET.
TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET.

TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET.

TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET.

TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET.

Others

TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking TELMED BETA 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About ARNISAC 100 TABLET

ARNISAC 100 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. ARNISAC 100 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking ARNISAC 100 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. ARNISAC 100 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking ARNISAC 100 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking ARNISAC 100 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About MET XL 3D 25/6.25MG TABLET

MET XL 3D 25/6.25MG TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

MET XL 3D 25/6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.MET XL 3D 25/6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

MET XL 3D 25/6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking MET XL 3D 25/6.25MG TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of MET XL 3D 25/6.25MG TABLET
Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How MET XL 3D 25/6.25MG TABLET Works

MET XL 3D 25/6.25MG TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

name: TELMIKIND LN Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TELMIKIND LN TABLET

TELMIKIND LN TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

TELMIKIND LN TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking TELMIKIND LN TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

TELMIKIND LN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking TELMIKIND LN TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.
uses: It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TELMIKIND LN TABLET
It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
mechanismOfAction:
How TELMIKIND LN TABLET Works

TELMIKIND LN TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.
usageInstructions: Take TELMIKIND LN TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow TELMIKIND LN TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken with or without food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent blood levels.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to a sudden rise in blood pressure.
Regularly monitor your blood pressure to ensure the medication is working effectively.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.

Introduction About TELSAR AMH 40 TABLET

TELSAR AMH 40 TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take TELSAR AMH 40 TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking TELSAR AMH 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking TELSAR AMH 40 TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of TELSAR AMH 40 TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELSAR AMH 40 TABLET Works

TELSAR AMH 40 TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

Introduction About TRILOSAR 6.25MG TABLET

TRILOSAR 6.25MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine, Chlorthalidone and Losartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to manage angina (chest pain), heart failure or stroke and can protect the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

It can also reduce the chances of fluid retention (edema) in the body that occurs due to some kidney or liver diseases. Take this medicine preferably in the mornings with food. While taking TRILOSAR 6.25MG TABLET, do not drink alcohol/grapefruit juice or go for a low-salt diet, as they may make further reduce your blood pressure. Consult your doctor for the best diet that can suit your health condition.

Before taking TRILOSAR 6.25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol levels, dehydration, or very low blood sodium, potassium or magnesium levels as a precaution.

TRILOSAR 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves or cardiogenic shock. It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Do not take TRILOSAR 6.25MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking TRILOSAR 6.25MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, sleepiness, tiredness, muscle cramps, low blood potassium or sodium levels, impotence in men and low sex drive. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

introduction:
Introduction About OLMIN A 40 TABLET

OLMIN A 40 TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OLMIN A 40 TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OLMIN A 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLMIN A 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How OLMIN A 40 TABLET Works

OLMIN A 40 TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About AZOVAS T 40 TABLET

AZOVAS T 40 TABLET is a combination of Azelnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage stage II hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, AZOVAS T 40 TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) and stroke. During management with AZOVAS T 40 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking AZOVAS T 40 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea. Avoid taking grapefruit juice while taking this medicine as it may reduce the risk of side effects.

AZOVAS T 40 TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking AZOVAS T 40 TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with AZOVAS T 40 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking AZOVAS T 40 TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How AZOVAS T 40 TABLET Works

AZOVAS T 40 TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Azelnidipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Azelnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Take AZOVAS T 40 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take AZOVAS T 40 TABLET at the same time each day. AZOVAS T 40 TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking AZOVAS T 40 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TELI TRIO TABLET

TELI TRIO TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take TELI TRIO TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking TELI TRIO TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking TELI TRIO TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of TELI TRIO TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELI TRIO TABLET Works

TELI TRIO TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.
usageInstructions: Take TELI TRIO TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The recommended dosage is determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to treatment.
TELI TRIO TABLET can be taken with or without meals.
Take this medicine at the same time each day to maintain a steady level of medication in your body.
Avoid Nighttime Doses: As this medicine contains a diuretic, avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent excessive urination at night.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
If it’s close to the time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one.
Taking more than the prescribed dose may lead to serious symptoms such as severe dizziness, fainting, or a significant drop in blood pressure.
In case of suspected overdose, seek immediate medical attention or visit the nearest emergency room.
Stopping this medication suddenly can cause your blood pressure to rise significantly, increasing the risk of heart attack or stroke.
Always consult your doctor before discontinuing the medication. They may gradually reduce your dose if necessary.
Stay hydrated to prevent side effects like muscle cramps, dry mouth, or weakness.
Follow your doctor’s advice on lifestyle changes such as a low-salt diet, regular exercise, and stress management to improve the effectiveness of the medication.

For pediatric use, alternative antihypertensive medications should be considered, and any treatment should be guided by a healthcare professional.

Diet and Lifestyle Tips for TELI TRIO TABLET Users:
Limit Salt Intake: Excessive sodium can elevate blood pressure, so aim to keep salt intake low.
Focus on Whole Foods: Include fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your daily meals.
Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.
Increase Potassium-Rich Foods: Foods like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes help balance potassium levels.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration, which can exacerbate dizziness.
Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.
Manage Stress: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, yoga, or meditation.
Avoid Smoking and Excessive Alcohol: Both can interfere with the effectiveness of blood pressure medication.
Monitor Blood Pressure Regularly: Keep track of your readings and share them with your doctor.
Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to support overall health.

These tips can complement your treatment and help manage hypertension effectively. Always consult your doctor for personalized advice.

introduction:
Introduction About VALENTAS 200 TABLET

VALENTAS 200 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. VALENTAS 200 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking VALENTAS 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. VALENTAS 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking VALENTAS 200 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking VALENTAS 200 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET

NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET Works

NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageInstructions: The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET.

NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET.
NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET.

NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET.

NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET.

NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET.

Others

NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking NEWTEL BETA 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET.

Liver
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Lungs
USE WITH CAUTION

ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET.

Heart Disease
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET.

Use In Pediatrics
CONTRAINDICATED

ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET.

Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION

ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET.

Others

ACMETEL MT 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

introduction:
Introduction About STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET

STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. Essential hypertension (primary hypertension) occurs when you have abnormally high blood pressure that's not the result of a medical condition. It is characterized by symptoms such as blurred vision, severe headache, chest pain, dizziness, light-headedness and nose bleeds.

STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney and heart problems. Avoid eating or drinking grapefruit juice while taking STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET as it may potentiate the risk of side effects. Prior to management with STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET or during the course of management, your doctor may want you to take several tests to understand your health condition.

STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding woman. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged less than 18 years) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).

The common side effects of taking STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, loss of appetite, stomach upset and skin rashes. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET Works

STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles and chlorthalidone works by promoting the excretion of excess fluid and certain electrolytes (such as sodium and chloride) from the body by increasing the amount of urine produced by the kidneys. Telmisartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by managing the binding of certain substance called angiotensin-II (substance produced in the body which causes narrowing of blood vessels). All these actions together effectively control high blood pressure.

Have gout
Have addison’s disease

Raised aldosterone levels
Diabetes (high blood sugar)

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to lower the blood pressure (Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, ramipril, verapamil, diltiazem, aliskiren, bosentan, methyldopa and guanethidine)     
Medicines that may increase blood potassium levels (Ex. amiloride, spironolactone)
Medicines used to manage pain and inflammation (Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Cyclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, and everolimus (used to manage organ rejection after transplant)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, amphotericin, telithromycin, rifampicin, rifabutin and trimethoprim)
Furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage oedema or high blood pressure)
Medicines used to suppress inflammation (Ex. prednisolone, betamethasone, dexamethasone and hydrocortisone)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. lithium, citalopram, fluoxetine, paroxetine, nefazodone and St. John’s wort (herbal medicine))  
Itraconazole, ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Antiviral medicines used to manage HIV infections (Ex. ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir, nevirapine)
Simvastatin, colestyramine (used to manage high cholesterol)
Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) (used to manage ulcerative colitis, crohn’s disease)
Cyclophosphamide or methotrexate (used in cancer management)
Salbutamol or formoterol (used to manage asthma)
Carbenoxolone (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Insulin, chlorpropamide or glibenclamide (medicine used to manage diabetes)
Atropine (used to manage symptoms of low heart rate)
Amantadine (used to manage parkinson’s disease or viral infections)
Allopurinol (used to manage gout)
Calcium salts or vitamin D (used for vitamin deficiency)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid eating or drinking grapefruit juice while taking STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET as it may potentiate the blood pressure lowering effect. Consult your doctor before taking STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of STAMLO TRIO 40/12.5 TABLET are low blood pressure, fast or slow heartbeat and dizziness.

Introduction About OLMETROL AM 20MG TABLET

OLMETROL AM 20MG TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OLMETROL AM 20MG TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OLMETROL AM 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLMETROL AM 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
