introduction:
Introduction About TELKONOL AH TABLET

TELKONOL AH TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take TELKONOL AH TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking TELKONOL AH TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking TELKONOL AH TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of TELKONOL AH TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELKONOL AH TABLET Works

TELKONOL AH TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

TELKONOL AH TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with mild liver problems. Such patients will be prescribed with a low dose and the dosage will be gradually increased. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

TELKONOL AH TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe obstructive coronary artery disease due to the increased risk of worsening angina and acute myocardial infarction. It is also used with caution if you have severe congestive heart failure and volume depletion due to the increased risk of developing oliguria, progressive azotemia, or acute renal failure on this medication.

TELKONOL AH TABLET is typically not recommended for use in pediatric patients due to a lack of established safety and efficacy data in children. This medication, which combines amlodipine and telmisartan, is primarily used for managing hypertension in adults. For pediatric use, alternative antihypertensive medications should be considered, and any treatment should be guided by a healthcare professional.
TELKONOL AH TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Limit Salt Intake: Excessive sodium can elevate blood pressure, so aim to keep salt intake low.
Focus on Whole Foods: Include fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your daily meals.
Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.
Increase Potassium-Rich Foods: Foods like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes help balance potassium levels.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration, which can exacerbate dizziness.
Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.
Manage Stress: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, yoga, or meditation.
Avoid Smoking and Excessive Alcohol: Both can interfere with the effectiveness of blood pressure medication.
Monitor Blood Pressure Regularly: Keep track of your readings and share them with your doctor.
Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to support overall health.

ARBITEL TRIO 50MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Metoprolol, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking ARBITEL TRIO 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, or gout as a precaution.

How ARBITEL TRIO 50MG TABLET Works

ARBITEL TRIO 50MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines, namely, metoprolol and cilnidipine. Metoprolol reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles.

Cilnidipine relaxes the blood vessels and allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels with less pressure. It also improves blood flow and oxygen supply to the heart muscles. Collectively, this medicine reduces the strain on the heart, improves heart functions, and manages the risks of heart attack or stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About TELMED AM TABLET

TELMED AM TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take TELMED AM TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking TELMED AM TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TELMED AM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take TELMED AM TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking TELMED AM TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension
usesDetails:

Hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How TELMED AM TABLET Works

TELMED AM TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by TELMED AM TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELMED AM TABLET as it could make your dizzier.
TELMED AM TABLET should be used with caution in patients having kidney problems.
TELMED AM TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver problems.

TELMED AM TABLET should not be used in patients with severely decreased blood pressure. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from other heart problems such as heart attack, severe hypertensive crisis, etc,
It is not known whether the combination of amlodipine and telmisartan is safe for use in children aged below 18 years. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

introduction:
Introduction About VYMATOR 50 TABLET

VYMATOR 50 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. VYMATOR 50 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking VYMATOR 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. VYMATOR 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking VYMATOR 50 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking VYMATOR 50 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages long-term heart failure in adults
usesDetails:

 Manages long-term heart failure in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How VYMATOR 50 TABLET Works

VYMATOR 50 TABLET helps to manage long-term heart failure, where sacubitril works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body and valsartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by blocking a substance called angiotensin-II (causing blood vessels to tighten) which is produced in the body and thus lowers the blood pressure.

Take VYMATOR 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow VYMATOR 50 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET

ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) or stroke. It can also be used to manage angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to low oxygen supply).

During management with ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET Works

ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, S(-)Amlodipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Take ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET at the same time each day. ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take ESLO TEL 2.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET

TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. Essential hypertension (primary hypertension) occurs when you have abnormally high blood pressure that's not the result of a medical condition. It is characterized by symptoms such as blurred vision, severe headache, chest pain, dizziness, light-headedness and nose bleeds.

TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney and heart problems. Avoid eating or drinking grapefruit juice while taking TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET as it may potentiate the risk of side effects. Prior to management with TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET or during the course of management, your doctor may want you to take several tests to understand your health condition.

TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding woman. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged less than 18 years) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).

The common side effects of taking TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, loss of appetite, stomach upset and skin rashes. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Manage essential hypertension

Manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET Works

TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles and chlorthalidone works by promoting the excretion of excess fluid and certain electrolytes (such as sodium and chloride) from the body by increasing the amount of urine produced by the kidneys. Telmisartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by managing the binding of certain substance called angiotensin-II (substance produced in the body which causes narrowing of blood vessels). All these actions together effectively control high blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET

Take TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TELMA ACT 40/5/12.5 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MET XL 3D 25/12.5 TABLET

MET XL 3D 25/12.5 TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

MET XL 3D 25/12.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.MET XL 3D 25/12.5 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

MET XL 3D 25/12.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. mechanismOfAction:
How MET XL 3D 25/12.5 TABLET Works

MET XL 3D 25/12.5 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About METOLAR TRIO 25 TABLET

METOLAR TRIO 25 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol, and Telmisartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking METOLAR TRIO 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration, or gout as a precaution.

METOLAR TRIO 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

METOLAR TRIO 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, or biliary obstruction). It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take METOLAR TRIO 25 TABLET if you are allergic to metoprolol, cilnidipine, or telmisartan.
METOLAR TRIO 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

METOLAR TRIO 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as heart block, uncontrollable heart failure, sick sinus syndrome, or a very slow or uneven heartbeat). It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as a recent heart attack, angina attack, enlarged heart muscles, or surgery in the heart within the last 4 months). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
METOLAR TRIO 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
METOLAR TRIO 25 TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Are in shock caused by poor blood circulation
Have poor blood circulation caused by blockage in the blood vessels
Have a very low blood pressure
Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in the blood)
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (tumor present in adrenal glands)
Have diabetes-related kidney problems
Have low potassium levels in blood
Have high calcium levels in blood

Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET

AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET Works

AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and anuria (low urine output). No dose adjustment is recommended for patients with mild to moderate kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with mild liver problems. Such patients will be prescribed with a low dose and the dosage will be gradually increased. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with a history of allergy or bronchial asthma due to increased risk of allergic reaction to the medication.

AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe obstructive coronary artery disease due to the increased risk of worsening angina and acute myocardial infarction. It is also used with caution if you have severe congestive heart failure and volume depletion due to the increased risk of developing oliguria, progressive azotemia, or acute renal failure on this medication.

AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET is typically not recommended for use in pediatric patients due to a lack of established safety and efficacy data in children. This medication, which combines amlodipine and telmisartan, is primarily used for managing hypertension in adults. For pediatric use, alternative antihypertensive medications should be considered, and any treatment should be guided by a healthcare professional.
AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicines before taking AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET:

NSAIDs: Can reduce the blood pressure-lowering effect of AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET, potentially leading to less control over hypertension.
Lithium: May increase the risk of lithium toxicity, requiring close monitoring of blood levels.
Other Antihypertensive Medications: Can enhance blood pressure-lowering effects, increasing the risk of hypotension.
Potassium Supplements: Risk of hyperkalemia, leading to potentially dangerous heart-related issues.
B. Other Drug-Drug interactions:
Direct renin inhibitor (Ex. Aliskiren)
Antimanic (Ex. Lithium)
Cardiac glycosides (Ex. Digoxin)
Antidiabetic drugs (Ex. glimepiride, insulin)
Antihyperlipidemics (Ex. Cholestyramine and Colestipol)
Phosphodiesterase inhibitors (Ex. Sildenafil)
Statins (Ex. Simvastatin)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. cyclosporine or tacrolimus)
C. Drug-food interactions:
High Potassium Foods: Should be consumed cautiously to prevent excessive potassium levels, which may lead to heart complications.
Alcohol: Can enhance dizziness and low blood pressure, increasing the risk of fainting.

Diet and Lifestyle Tips for AMLOPRES TRIO 40MG TABLET Users:
Limit Salt Intake: Excessive sodium can elevate blood pressure, so aim to keep salt intake low.
Focus on Whole Foods: Include fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your daily meals.
Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.
Increase Potassium-Rich Foods: Foods like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes help balance potassium levels.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration, which can exacerbate dizziness.
Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.
Manage Stress: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, yoga, or meditation.
Avoid Smoking and Excessive Alcohol: Both can interfere with the effectiveness of blood pressure medication.
Monitor Blood Pressure Regularly: Keep track of your readings and share them with your doctor.
Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to support overall health.

These tips can complement your treatment and help manage hypertension effectively. Always consult your doctor for personalized advice.

introduction:
Introduction About NODON T TABLET

NODON T TABLET is a combination of Nebivolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective. Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanaged, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, NODON T TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) or stroke. During management with NODON T TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Before taking NODON T TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

NODON T TABLET is not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking NODON T TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with NODON T TABLET. The most common side effects of taking NODON T TABLET are low blood pressure, headache, dizziness, high blood potassium levels, pins and needles, muscle pain, diarrhoea, constipation and erectile dysfunction. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking TELMIKIND LNB 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration, or gout as a precaution.

TELMIKIND LNB 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

Introduction About NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET

NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Before taking NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET.

During management with NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET Works

NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Olmesartan. Olmesartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Cilnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Take NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET at the same time each day. NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take NEXOVAS O 40MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

Addison’s disease

Diabetes
Low blood pressure

introduction:
Introduction About METOSARTAN CH 25 TABLET

METOSARTAN CH 25 TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

METOSARTAN CH 25 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.METOSARTAN CH 25 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

METOSARTAN CH 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking METOSARTAN CH 25 TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
usesDetails:

Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How METOSARTAN CH 25 TABLET Works

METOSARTAN CH 25 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

Take METOSARTAN CH 25 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. The correct dosage and duration of medicine to be taken will be prescribed by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DILNIP TM 25 TABLET

DILNIP TM 25 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol, and Telmisartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking DILNIP TM 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration, or gout as a precaution.

DILNIP TM 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

name: Olmax AM 40mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET

OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: It is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone
usesDetails:
Uses Of OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET
It is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone
mechanismOfAction:
How OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET Works

OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

warnings.details: It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.
It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely.
Do not drive or operate any tools or machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness, or headache after taking the medicine.
Avoid consuming alcohol while taking this medicine, as it could aggravate your dizziness and tiredness.

OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with impaired kidney function and should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems or with a surgical history of kidney transplant.

OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems (such as biliary obstruction, gallstones, and jaundice) and should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to Olmesartan, Amlodipine, or any other ingredients of this medicine.
OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease (such as aortic stenosis (narrowing of the aorta), cardiogenic shock, circulatory failure, or heart attack).
OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to a lack of safety data.

OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function are required in such patients.

Others

OLMAX AM 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Diabetes-related kidney problems
Severe hypotension (very low blood pressure)

Before taking this medicine, inform your physician if you:

Have severe vomiting and/or diarrhea
Are on a low-sodium diet
Have hyperkalemia (increased levels of potassium in the blood)
Have problems with the adrenal glands

Avoid eating grapefruit or consuming grapefruit juice while taking OLMEZEST AM 20MG TABLET, as it could lead to an increase in the levels of amlodipine in the blood, which may lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET

TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) or stroke. It can also be used to manage angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to low oxygen supply).

During management with TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET Works

TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, S(-)Amlodipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Take TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET at the same time each day. TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as irregular heart rhythm, heart failure, recent heart attack, and problems with heart muscle or valves). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

TEMSAN AM 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Introduction About OLMEZEST AZ 20 TABLET

OLMEZEST AZ 20 TABLET is used to manage severe hypertension and chronic heart failure. It contains a combination of medicines called Azelnidipine and Olmesartan, which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. Azelnidipine works by blocking calcium channels in blood vessels, which helps them relax and lower blood pressure. Olmesartan blocks a hormone that narrows blood vessels, also helping to reduce blood pressure.

Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your blood at regular intervals.

OLMEZEST AZ 20 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have impaired kidney function, jaundice (yellowing of the skin and eyes), or problems with drainage of the bile from the gallbladder (biliary obstruction, Ex. gallstones).

Inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, liver disease, heart failure, or problems with your heart valves or heart muscle before taking this medicine. It is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

The safety and effectiveness of OLMEZEST AZ 20 TABLET in newborns, infants, and children is not established. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients aged over 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking OLMEZEST AZ 20 TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, headache, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomachache, gastroenteritis, sore throat, runny or stuffy nose, bronchitis, flu-like symptoms, cough, pain, pain in the chest, back, bones or joints, infection of the urinary tract, blood in the urine, and swelling of ankles, feet, legs, hands, or arms. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET

ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) or stroke. It can also be used to manage angina pectoris (chest pain caused due to low oxygen supply).

During management with ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET Works

ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, S(-)Amlodipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

S(-)Amlodipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET

Take ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET at the same time each day. ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

Others

Have diabetes related kidney problems

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Other medicines used to manage elevated blood pressure (such as aliskiren, captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, verapamil, diltiazem, losartan, valsartan)

Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (used for pain relief) such as indomethacin, celecoxib, ibuprofen, aspirin
Heparin (a medicine used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin, clarithromycin, telithromycin, trimethoprim)
Medicines to suppress immune system (Ex. cyclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus and everolimus)
Dantrolene (a medicine used to manage muscle spasm)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. indinavir, ritonavir, saquinavir)
Medicines used to manage fungal infections (Ex. itraconazole, ketoconazole and fluconazole)
Digoxin (a medicine used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Simvastatin (a medicine used to lower blood cholesterol levels)
Baclofen (a medicine used for relaxing muscles)
Amifostine (a kidney protectant used along with chemotherapeutic agents)
Medicines used to manage mental disorders such as depression, psychosis, or anxiety (Ex. pimozide, amisulpride, haloperidol)
Corticosteroids (used to manage inflammation) Ex. prednisolone

B. Drug-Food interactions:

Do not eat grapefruit or drink grapefruit juice while taking ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of side effects.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took more ASOMEX TM 5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately. Overdosage may cause low blood pressure, abnormal heartbeat, and dizziness.

introduction:
Introduction About OZOCIL T TABLET

OZOCIL T TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure). Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the blood vessel walls is too high which is characterized by symptoms such as headache, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, feeling of overtiredness, nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety and chest pain.    

OZOCIL T TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.    

Before taking OZOCIL T TABLET, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, peripheral edema, metabolic acidosis, cellular lysis (such as acute limb ischemia, rhabdomyolysis, extended trauma) and heart, liver or kidney problems. 

OZOCIL T TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. OZOCIL T TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). It should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above).

The most common side effects of taking OZOCIL T TABLET are dizziness, headache, flushing, and rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About VENPRES AM TABLET

VENPRES AM TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take VENPRES AM TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking VENPRES AM TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About ACMETEL LN TABLET

ACMETEL LN TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

ACMETEL LN TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking ACMETEL LN TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

ACMETEL LN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking ACMETEL LN TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How ACMETEL LN TABLET Works

ACMETEL LN TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.

Swallow ACMETEL LN TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.

Regularly monitor your blood pressure to ensure the medication is working effectively.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.

warnings.details: ACMETEL LN TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor for advice.
ACMETEL LN TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness after taking ACMETEL LN TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ACMETEL LN TABLET as it may cause low blood pressure while standing up from sitting or lying position (orthostatic hypotension).

ACMETEL LN TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic renal insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function, bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis of the artery to a single functioning kidney. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ACMETEL LN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, cholestasis, biliary obstructive disorders. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver impairment and elevated liver enzymes. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ACMETEL LN TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan, Cilnidipine or calcium channel antagonists such as amlodipine, nifedipine.

ACMETEL LN TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with advanced aortic stenosis. It should be used with caution in patients with aortic or mitral stenosis, obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, angina, ischaemic cardiopathy or ischaemic cardiovascular disease and congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking it.
ACMETEL LN TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
ACMETEL LN TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking ACMETEL LN TABLET.

Others

ACMETEL LN TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Primary aldosteronism

Before taking ACMETEL LN TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Volume and/or sodium depletion by diuretic therapy, dietary salt restriction, diarrhoea or vomiting
Diabetes
Peripheral edema
Metabolic acidosis, cellular lysis (such as acute limb ischemia, rhabdomyolysis, extended trauma)

Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors (Ex. enalapril, lisinopril) angiotensin-II receptor antagonists drugs (Ex. losartan, irbesartan), diuretics (Ex. chlorthalidone, torsemide) and aliskiren (used to manage high blood pressure)

Phenytoin, barbiturates such as phenobarbital, pentobarbital (used to manage seizures)
Narcotics such as morphine (used to manage severe pain)

introduction:
Introduction About TELTAS H TABLET

TELTAS H TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It contains a combination of Hydrochlorothiazide+Telmisartan that works by removing excess fluids from the body and relaxing the blood vessels which reduces strain on the heart and reduces blood pressure.

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During management with TELTAS H TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking TELTAS H TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

TELTAS H TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking TELTAS H TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with TELTAS H TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking TELTAS H TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, low or high blood potassium levels, pins and needles, muscle pain, diarrhoea, dry mouth, erectile dysfunction and increased blood uric acid levels. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

introduction:
Introduction About OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET

OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine, Chlorthalidone and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to manage heart failure or stroke and can protect the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and type II diabetes mellitus.

It can also reduce the chances of fluid retention (edema) in the body that occurs due to some kidney or liver diseases. Take this medicine preferably in the mornings with food. While taking OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET, do not drink alcohol/grapefruit juice or go for a low-salt diet, as they may make further reduce your blood pressure. Consult your doctor for the best diet that can suit your health condition.

Before taking OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, high blood cholesterol levels, dehydration, or very low blood sodium, potassium or magnesium levels as a precaution.

OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with other severe heart problems such as narrowing of heart valves or cardiogenic shock. It is also not suitable for use in patients with severe hypotension (low blood pressure).

Do not take OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET if you are pregnant, think you may be pregnant or planning to have a baby or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor.

The most common side effects of taking OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET are headache, dizziness, tiredness, weakness, high blood uric acid levels, low blood sodium or magnesium levels, diabetes, high blood potassium levels, low blood pressure, impotence in men, sore throat, runny nose, cough, flu-like symptoms, urinary tract infections and increased blood cholesterol levels. Contact your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET Works

OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET relaxes the blood vessels supplying various organs (such as heart, kidney, brain or others) which allows the blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also removes the excess fluids and electrolytes (sodium and water) from the body in the form of urine which helps in reducing edema and blood thickness. Collectively, these actions improve blood flow, reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump more blood with less pressure.

It should be used with caution in patients having a history of recent heart, heart failure, irregular heartbeat, coronary heart disease or problems related with heart muscle or valves). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Have diabetes related kidney problems
Have abnormally very low blood pressure
Are not passing urine at all

OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children aged below 6 years. It should be used in children and adolescents (aged between 6-17 years) only if prescribed by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before administration.

OMEN ACT 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged above 65 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About TELMA AZ 40 TABLET

TELMA AZ 40 TABLET is a combination of Azelnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage stage II hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, TELMA AZ 40 TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) and stroke. During management with TELMA AZ 40 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking TELMA AZ 40 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea. Avoid taking grapefruit juice while taking this medicine as it may reduce the risk of side effects.

TELMA AZ 40 TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking TELMA AZ 40 TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with TELMA AZ 40 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking TELMA AZ 40 TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELMA AZ 40 TABLET Works

TELMA AZ 40 TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Azelnidipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Azelnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking TELMA AZ 40 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

Introduction About TELSARTAN M 50 TABLET

TELSARTAN M 50 TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels which is characterized by symptoms such as severe headache, nose bleeding, fatigue, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

Your doctor might advise you to take kidney function tests (to assess the function of your kidney), monitoring of blood pressure and regular blood tests to check the electrolytes such as potassium levels in the blood. TELSARTAN M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with bronchospastic lung diseases such as asthma, emphysema or other lung infections, severe liver problems, impaired kidney function, heart disease such as severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock and planned for non-cardiac surgery.

Before taking TELSARTAN M 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands), diabetes, low blood pressure due to dehydration or have undergone kidney transplant surgery. TELSARTAN M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TELSARTAN M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The common side effects associated with the use of TELSARTAN M 50 TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

CETANIL TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs.  It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness).

CETANIL TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. CETANIL TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. CETANIL TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. CETANIL TRIO 12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

CETANIL TRIO 12.5MG TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking CETANIL TRIO 12.5MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.

Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body which causes the narrowing of blood vessels).

introduction:
Introduction About TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET

TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels which is characterized by symptoms such as severe headache, nose bleeding, fatigue, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

Your doctor might advise you to take kidney function tests (to assess the function of your kidney), monitoring of blood pressure and regular blood tests to check the electrolytes such as potassium levels in the blood. TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with bronchospastic lung diseases such as asthma, emphysema or other lung infections, severe liver problems, impaired kidney function, heart disease such as severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock and planned for non-cardiac surgery.

Before taking TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands), diabetes, low blood pressure due to dehydration or have undergone kidney transplant surgery. TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The common side effects associated with the use of TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET Works

TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.

How to use TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET

Take TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to have the medicine at the same time daily. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TELSAR BETA 25 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NULONG OL 40MG TABLET

NULONG OL 40MG TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

Before taking NULONG OL 40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

NULONG OL 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe hypotension. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking NULONG OL 40MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with NULONG OL 40MG TABLET.

During management with NULONG OL 40MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

The most common side effects of taking NULONG OL 40MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of NULONG OL 40MG TABLET
Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How NULONG OL 40MG TABLET Works

NULONG OL 40MG TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Olmesartan. Olmesartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Cilnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use NULONG OL 40MG TABLET

Take NULONG OL 40MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take NULONG OL 40MG TABLET at the same time each day. NULONG OL 40MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Continue to take NULONG OL 40MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking NULONG OL 40MG TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.
NULONG OL 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as kidney transplant, narrowing of renal arteries). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

NULONG OL 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, biliary obstruction). It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take NULONG OL 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to Cilnidipine or Olmesartan.

NULONG OL 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as irregular heart rhythm, heart failure, recent heart attack, and problems with heart muscle or valves). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

NULONG OL 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have diabetes related kidney problems
Have severe hypotension (low blood pressure)

Before taking NULONG OL 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in adrenal gland)

Have diabetes

Have narrowing of arteries

NULONG OL 40MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

NULONG OL 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
