name: Asomex LT 2.5mg Tablet 15'S
introduction:
Introduction About ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET

ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET is a combination of S(-)Amlodipine and Losartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

It also helps in reducing the risk of heart attack, heart failure or stroke and can protect the function of kidneys particularly in patients who have both hypertension and diabetes.

During management with ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby and nursing infants. Stop taking ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with this medicine.

The most common side effects of taking ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET Works

ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. This improves blood supply to the vital organs of the body (such as heart, brain or kidneys). As a result, it reduces the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly across blood vessels with less pressure. It also protects kidney functions and reduces the risk of kidney damage among diabetic patients.

Take ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to take ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET at the same time each day. ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Continue to take ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with breathing problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with serious heart problem (such as heart failure or heart attack). Have cardiogenic shock (heart cannot pump blood suddenly)
Have diabetes related kidney problems

Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in adrenal gland)
Have low blood pressure
Are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)

Have diabetes
Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)
Have narrowing of arteries
Have had skin cancer
Have had gout in the past

ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

ASOMEX LT 2.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About OLMESAR PLUS 20 TABLET

OLMESAR PLUS 20 TABLET is used to manage severe hypertension and chronic heart failure. It contains a combination of medicines called Azelnidipine and Olmesartan, which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. Azelnidipine works by blocking calcium channels in blood vessels, which helps them relax and lower blood pressure. Olmesartan blocks a hormone that narrows blood vessels, also helping to reduce blood pressure.

Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your blood at regular intervals.

OLMESAR PLUS 20 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have impaired kidney function, jaundice (yellowing of the skin and eyes), or problems with drainage of the bile from the gallbladder (biliary obstruction, Ex. gallstones).

Inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, liver disease, heart failure, or problems with your heart valves or heart muscle before taking this medicine. It is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

The safety and effectiveness of OLMESAR PLUS 20 TABLET in newborns, infants, and children is not established. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients aged over 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking OLMESAR PLUS 20 TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, headache, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomachache, gastroenteritis, sore throat, runny or stuffy nose, bronchitis, flu-like symptoms, cough, pain, pain in the chest, back, bones or joints, infection of the urinary tract, blood in the urine, and swelling of ankles, feet, legs, hands, or arms. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

By blocking its action, olmesartan helps to lower blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About ARNIV 50 TABLET

ARNIV 50 TABLET is a combination medication containing Sacubitril and Valsartan. It is primarily used in the management of heart failure and hypertension. This innovative drug helps to improve heart function and manage high blood pressure, leading to better overall cardiovascular health.

ARNIV 50 TABLET can be taken with or without food. For optimal results, take it at the same time every day. Your doctor will determine the appropriate dose and frequency, which may vary based on your response to the medication. It is important to take the tablets consistently as prescribed and avoid missing any doses to achieve the best outcome. Even if you are feeling better, do not stop taking the medication, as it helps prevent future complications.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, lightheadedness, fatigue, low blood pressure, elevated potassium levels, angioedema (swelling under the skin) and cough. To help minimize the risk of dizziness caused by low blood pressure, try rising gradually from a sitting or lying position. If these or any other side effects become severe or persist, inform your doctor.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you are currently taking any other medications for blood pressure or heart conditions, or if you have kidney or liver disease. Additionally, make sure to share all other medications you are using, as they may interact with this medicine. This medication is not recommended during pregnancy and should be avoided while breastfeeding. While taking this medication, your doctor may recommend regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function.

mechanismOfAction:
How ARNIV 50 TABLET Works

ARNIV 50 TABLET, a combination of sacubitril and valsartan that works by improving heart function in patients with heart failure. Sacubitril is a neprilysin inhibitor that prevents the breakdown of natriuretic peptides, which help dilate blood vessels, reduce fluid retention, and lower blood pressure. Valsartan, an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), further supports this by blocking the effects of angiotensin II, a hormone that constricts blood vessels and raises blood pressure. Together, these two components help relax blood vessels, reduce fluid buildup, and ease the heart's workload, ultimately improving heart function and reducing symptoms of heart failure.

Standout Features of ARNIV 50 TABLET




ARNIV 50 TABLET

	

Sacubitril (24mg) + Valsartan (26mg)

	

- Sacubitril: Neprilysin inhibitor, enhances natriuretic peptides to reduce fluid retention and improve vascular tone.
- Valsartan: ARB, blocks angiotensin II receptors to lower blood pressure and reduce heart strain.

	

- Effective for heart failure with reduced ejection fraction (HFrEF).
- Reduces hospitalization rates for heart failure.
- Dual mechanism (neprilysin + ARB) for enhanced benefits.

	

- Hyperkalemia
- Hypotension
- Angioedema
- Dizziness
- Elevated creatinine

	

- Proven to reduce mortality in heart failure.
- More effective than traditional ARBs alone in reducing hospitalizations and cardiovascular death.

	

Dual action (sacubitril + valsartan), offering a broader and more comprehensive effect for heart failure management. Superior to standard ARBs/ACE inhibitors in reducing heart failure complications.




ACE Inhibitors

	

Captopril, Enalapril, Lisinopril, etc.

	

Inhibit the enzyme that converts angiotensin I to angiotensin II, helping to relax blood vessels and reduce blood pressure.

	

- Effective in lowering blood pressure.
- Prevents progression of heart failure and kidney disease.

	

- Persistent dry cough
- Hyperkalemia
- Hypotension
- Angioedema
- Fatigue

	

- Effective in reducing blood pressure and improving symptoms of heart failure.
- Generally lower risk of mortality in heart failure compared to ARNIV 50 TABLET.

	

Standard therapy for hypertension and heart failure but lacks the dual-action mechanism for heart failure that ARNIV 50 TABLET offers.




ARBs (Angiotensin II Receptor Blockers)

	

Losartan, Irbesartan, Olmesartan

	

Block the receptors for angiotensin II, lowering blood pressure and reducing heart strain.

	

- Effective in managing hypertension.
- Used when ACE inhibitors are not tolerated due to side effects.

	

- Hyperkalemia
- Dizziness
- Fatigue

	

- Similar in efficacy to ACE inhibitors for hypertension and heart failure.
- May not provide as comprehensive benefits for heart failure as ARNIV 50 TABLET.

	

Preferred for those who cannot tolerate ACE inhibitors, but lacks the added benefits of sacubitril (neprilysin inhibitor) for heart failure patients.




Beta-blockers

	

Metoprolol, Carvedilol, Bisoprolol

	

Block beta-adrenergic receptors, reducing heart rate and blood pressure, and improving heart efficiency.

	

- Effective in reducing heart rate and controlling hypertension.
- Helps improve heart function in heart failure (e.g., reduced arrhythmias, increased survival).

	

- Fatigue
- Dizziness
- Bradycardia (slow heart rate)
- Weight gain
- Cold extremities

	

- Particularly beneficial for heart failure patients with symptoms of left ventricular dysfunction and arrhythmias.
- More effective than ARNIV 50 TABLET for certain heart rhythm issues.

	

Effective for managing arrhythmias and post-heart attack recovery, but lacks the multi-faceted effect of ARNIV 50 TABLET for heart failure-related issues.

Introduction About TELISTA MCL 50 TABLET

TELISTA MCL 50 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) or uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking TELISTA MCL 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration or gout as a precaution.

TELISTA MCL 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

TELISTA MCL 50 TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About OLCURE AM 20 TABLET

OLCURE AM 20 TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OLCURE AM 20 TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OLCURE AM 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLCURE AM 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Uses Of OLCURE AM 20 TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How OLCURE AM 20 TABLET Works

OLCURE AM 20 TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

OLCURE AM 20 TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function are required in such patients.

name: STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5mg Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET

STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. Essential hypertension (primary hypertension) occurs when you have abnormally high blood pressure that's not the result of a medical condition. It is characterized by symptoms such as blurred vision, severe headache, chest pain, dizziness, light-headedness and nose bleeds.

STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney and heart problems. Avoid eating or drinking grapefruit juice while taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET as it may potentiate the risk of side effects. Prior to management with STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET or during the course of management, your doctor may want you to take several tests to understand your health condition.

STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding woman. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged less than 18 years) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).   

The common side effects of taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, loss of appetite, stomach upset and skin rashes. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.

How STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET Works

STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles and chlorthalidone works by promoting the excretion of excess fluid and certain electrolytes (such as sodium and chloride) from the body by increasing the amount of urine produced by the kidneys. Telmisartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by managing the binding of certain substance called angiotensin-II (substance produced in the body which causes narrowing of blood vessels). All these actions together effectively control high blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET

Take STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is not generally recommended for pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the baby. Consult your doctor before taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET.

STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. Your doctor may choose another management especially if you want to breast-feed when your baby is new-born or born prematurely. Consult your doctor before taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, tiredness, headache or feel sick after taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol with STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of low blood pressure.

STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney stones and it should be taken with caution in patients having kidney artery stenosis (narrowing of blood vessels to one or both the kidneys) and kidney transplant. Consult your doctor before taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET.

STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (flow of bile from liver stops or slows). It should be used with caution in patients having liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET.
STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Chlorthalidone and Telmisartan.

STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with cardiogenic shock (when the heart is unable to supply enough blood to the vital organs of the body), aortic stenosis (narrowed or blocked aortic valve), heart failure after heart attack. It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble or low blood pressure (due to dehydration problems, low-salt intake, diarrhoea, or vomiting). Before taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET consult with your doctor.
STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult child’s doctor for advice.
STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET

Others

STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are not passing urine at all
Have low levels of potassium, sodium and calcium in the blood
Have gout
Have addison’s disease

Before taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Raised aldosterone levels
Diabetes (high blood sugar)

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used to lower the blood pressure (Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, ramipril, verapamil, diltiazem, aliskiren, bosentan, methyldopa and guanethidine)     
Medicines that may increase blood potassium levels (Ex. amiloride, spironolactone)
Medicines used to manage pain and inflammation (Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen)
Heparin (used to manage blood clots)
Cyclosporin, tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, and everolimus (used to manage organ rejection after transplant)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, amphotericin, telithromycin, rifampicin, rifabutin and trimethoprim)
Furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage oedema or high blood pressure)
Medicines used to suppress inflammation (Ex. prednisolone, betamethasone, dexamethasone and hydrocortisone)
Medicines used to manage depression (Ex. lithium, citalopram, fluoxetine, paroxetine, nefazodone and St. John’s wort (herbal medicine))  
Itraconazole, ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Antiviral medicines used to manage HIV infections (Ex. ritonavir, indinavir, nelfinavir, nevirapine)
Simvastatin, colestyramine (used to manage high cholesterol)
Adrenocorticotropic hormone (ACTH) (used to manage ulcerative colitis, crohn’s disease)
Cyclophosphamide or methotrexate (used in cancer management)
Salbutamol or formoterol (used to manage asthma)
Carbenoxolone (used to manage stomach ulcers)
Insulin, chlorpropamide or glibenclamide (medicine used to manage diabetes)
Atropine (used to manage symptoms of low heart rate)
Amantadine (used to manage parkinson’s disease or viral infections)
Allopurinol (used to manage gout)
Calcium salts or vitamin D (used for vitamin deficiency)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid eating or drinking grapefruit juice while taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET as it may potentiate the blood pressure lowering effect. Consult your doctor before taking STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of STAMLO TRIO 80/12.5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, fast or slow heartbeat and dizziness.

introduction:
Introduction About TETAN AM 40MG TABLET

TETAN AM 40MG TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take TETAN AM 40MG TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking TETAN AM 40MG TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TETAN AM 40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take TETAN AM 40MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking TETAN AM 40MG TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TETAN AM 40MG TABLET Works

TETAN AM 40MG TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About TELMA LNC TABLET

TELMA LNC TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain and muscle tremors (shakiness).

TELMA LNC TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney and heart disease. TELMA LNC TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. TELMA LNC TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. TELMA LNC TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

TELMA LNC TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking TELMA LNC TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.

Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body which causes the narrowing of blood vessels).

Introduction About ZUVATAN 50 TABLET

ZUVATAN 50 TABLET is a combination medication containing Sacubitril and Valsartan. It is primarily used in the management of heart failure and hypertension. This innovative drug helps to improve heart function and manage high blood pressure, leading to better overall cardiovascular health.

ZUVATAN 50 TABLET can be taken with or without food. For optimal results, take it at the same time every day. Your doctor will determine the appropriate dose and frequency, which may vary based on your response to the medication. It is important to take the tablets consistently as prescribed and avoid missing any doses to achieve the best outcome. Even if you are feeling better, do not stop taking the medication, as it helps prevent future complications.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, lightheadedness, fatigue, low blood pressure, elevated potassium levels, angioedema (swelling under the skin) and cough. To help minimize the risk of dizziness caused by low blood pressure, try rising gradually from a sitting or lying position. If these or any other side effects become severe or persist, inform your doctor.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you are currently taking any other medications for blood pressure or heart conditions, or if you have kidney or liver disease. Additionally, make sure to share all other medications you are using, as they may interact with this medicine. This medication is not recommended during pregnancy and should be avoided while breastfeeding. While taking this medication, your doctor may recommend regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZUVATAN 50 TABLET Works

ZUVATAN 50 TABLET, a combination of sacubitril and valsartan that works by improving heart function in patients with heart failure. Sacubitril is a neprilysin inhibitor that prevents the breakdown of natriuretic peptides, which help dilate blood vessels, reduce fluid retention, and lower blood pressure. Valsartan, an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), further supports this by blocking the effects of angiotensin II, a hormone that constricts blood vessels and raises blood pressure. Together, these two components help relax blood vessels, reduce fluid buildup, and ease the heart's workload, ultimately improving heart function and reducing symptoms of heart failure.

What is TELMISAT AM 5 TABLET Tablet?

TELMISAT AM 5 TABLET is a prescription medicine used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension). It contains Telmisartan (40mg) and Amlodipine (5mg), which help to relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.

TELMISAT AM 5 TABLET helps to controls high blood pressure, reduces the risk of heart-related complications and improves blood circulation.

Take one TELMISAT AM 5 TABLET daily with or without food, as directed by your doctor. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.

Avoid alcohol while taking TELMISAT AM 5 TABLET. Inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease.

The most common side effects of taking TELMISAT AM 5 TABLET are dizziness, swelling in ankles or feet, headache or fatigue. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How TELMISAT AM 5 TABLET Works

1. Telmisartan (Angiotensin II Receptor Blocker - ARB):

Blocks Angiotensin II, a hormone that narrows blood vessels and increases blood pressure
When blocked, blood vessels stay relaxed and open, lowering blood pressure

2. Amlodipine (Calcium Channel Blocker - CCB):

Inhibits calcium from entering blood vessel muscles, stopping them from tightening
This helps blood vessels remain wide, allowing better blood flow and reducing pressure
Who should take TELMISAT AM 5 TABLET?
Patients with hypertension – helps control blood pressure and reduces complications
Individuals with Heart disease – reduces the risk of heart attack, stroke, and heart failure
People with poor blood circulation – helps widen blood vessels and improve oxygen flow

Obesity or sedentary lifestyle
Excessive salt or alcohol intake
Stress-related high blood pressure

name: TELMA BS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TELMA BS TABLET

TELMA BS TABLET is used to manage hypertension, angina (chest pain) and heart failure in adults. It is a combination of Bisoprolol and Telmisartan which works by relaxing your blood vessels supplying the heart which in turn reduces strain on the heart. It is also used to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events such as heart attack or stroke in adults who are known to have a reduced or blocked blood supply to the heart or legs and had a stroke or with a high risk of diabetes.

Your doctor may check your kidney function test, blood pressure and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your body prior to the management or at regular intervals during management with this medicine. TELMA BS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (flow of bile from liver stops or slows). TELMA BS TABLET should be used with caution in patients having diabetes, kidney disease, heart problems and raised aldosterone levels.

TELMA BS TABLET is not recommended for use in early pregnancy and must not be taken by women who are pregnant for more than 3 months and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TELMA BS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (up to the age of 18 years) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effect of taking TELMA BS TABLET is low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELMA BS TABLET Works

TELMA BS TABLET contains two medicines namely, bisoprolol and telmisartan. Bisoprolol works by blocking beta-1 receptors in the heart, which slows the heart rate, reduces the force of the heart's contractions, and lowers blood pressure. This helps the heart work more efficiently and reduces its workload, making bisoprolol effective for high blood pressure, chest pain (angina), and heart failure.

Telmisartan is an Angiotensin Receptor Blocker. It works by blocking the angiotensin receptor in the body which helps in keeping the blood vessels relaxed, thus lowering the strain on heart and enables heart to pump blood more easily.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking TELMA BS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Angiotensin converting enzyme inhibitors (Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, ramipril), angiotensin II receptor antagonists (Ex. candesartan, irbesartan) and aliskiren (medicines used to manage high blood pressure)
Digoxin (used to manage heart failure and abnormal heart rhythm)
 Medicines containing lithium (used to manage some types of depression)
Medicines that may increase blood potassium levels such as salt substitutes containing potassium
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs such as aspirin, ibuprofen (medicines used to manage pain and inflammation
Heparin (used to manage or manage blood clot)
Immunosuppressive agents such as ciclosporin or tacrolimus (used to manage organ rejection after transplant)
Antibiotic trimethoprim (medicine used to manage urinary tract infections)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide and potassium-sparing diuretics (Ex. amiloride, spironolactone) (used to manage oedema or high blood pressure)
Corticosteroids such as dexamethasone, hydrocortisone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)
Baclofen (used for muscle spasm)
Amifostine (medicine used in cancer chemotherapy)
Barbiturates such as phenobarbital, pentobarbital (used to manage seizures)
Antidepressants such as citalopram, fluoxetine, paroxetine (used to manage depression)
Narcotics such as morphine and codeine (used to manage moderate to severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of TELMA BS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. The most common symptoms of overdose are low blood pressure, fast or slow heartbeat, dizziness, elevated levels of creatinine and sudden kidney failure.

name: MET XL T 25 Tablet 20's
introduction:
Introduction About MET XL T 25 TABLET

MET XL T 25 TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take MET XL T 25 TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

mechanismOfAction:
How MET XL T 25 TABLET Works

MET XL T 25 TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageInstructions: The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking MET XL T 25 TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking MET XL T 25 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MET XL T 25 TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

MET XL T 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking MET XL T 25 TABLET.

MET XL T 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking MET XL T 25 TABLET.
MET XL T 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

MET XL T 25 TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking MET XL T 25 TABLET.

MET XL T 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking MET XL T 25 TABLET.

MET XL T 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking MET XL T 25 TABLET.

MET XL T 25 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking MET XL T 25 TABLET.

Others

MET XL T 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking MET XL T 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET

OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) and uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions or gout as a precaution.

OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe low blood pressure, uncontrollable heart failure or heart block. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow or fast heart rate, cold hands and feet, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, constipation, sore throat, cough, high blood cholesterol levels and swollen ankles. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevents heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) and arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)
usesDetails:

Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)

mechanismOfAction:
How OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET Works

OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and various other organs of the body. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump more blood with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET

Take OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.
OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as kidney transplant, narrowing of renal arteries). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, biliary obstruction). It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET if you are allergic to Metoprolol or Olmesartan.
OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as heart block, uncontrollable heart failure, sick sinus syndrome or a very slow or uneven heartbeat). It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as a recent heart attack, or angina attack, irregular heart rhythm, enlarged heart muscles, or surgery in the heart within the last 4 months). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are in shock caused due to poor blood circulation
Have poor blood circulation caused due to blockage in the blood vessels
Have a very low blood pressure
Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in blood)
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (tumor present in adrenal glands)
Have diabetes related kidney problems

Before taking OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Are prone to allergic reactions very often (such as even for insect bites)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased thyroid hormones in the body)
Have problems in blood circulation around the body (especially in fingers, arms and feet)
Have psoriasis (white scaly patches on the skin)
Are going to undergo an operation
Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in adrenal gland)
Are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)

Use in pediatrics:

OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

OLMEZEST BETA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About METOSARTAN CH 25/6.25 TABLET

METOSARTAN CH 25/6.25 TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

METOSARTAN CH 25/6.25 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.METOSARTAN CH 25/6.25 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

METOSARTAN CH 25/6.25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking METOSARTAN CH 25/6.25 TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of METOSARTAN CH 25/6.25 TABLET
Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How METOSARTAN CH 25/6.25 TABLET Works

METOSARTAN CH 25/6.25 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

Take METOSARTAN CH 25/6.25 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. The correct dosage and duration of medicine to be taken will be prescribed by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET

ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension
usesDetails:

Hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET Works

ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET as it could make your dizzier.
ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having kidney problems.
ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver problems.
Do not take ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine and Telmisartan.

ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET should not be used in patients with severely decreased blood pressure. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from other heart problems such as heart attack, severe hypertensive crisis, etc,
It is not known whether the combination of amlodipine and telmisartan is safe for use in children aged below 18 years. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
ARBITEL AM 80MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or more), especially if suffering from kidney problems.

Others

name: Olmy A 20mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About OLMY A 20MG TABLET

OLMY A 20MG TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OLMY A 20MG TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OLMY A 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLMY A 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How OLMY A 20MG TABLET Works

OLMY A 20MG TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely.
Do not drive or operate any tools or machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness, or headache after taking the medicine.
Avoid consuming alcohol while taking this medicine, as it could aggravate your dizziness and tiredness.

OLMY A 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with impaired kidney function and should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems or with a surgical history of kidney transplant.

OLMY A 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems (such as biliary obstruction, gallstones, and jaundice) and should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take OLMY A 20MG TABLET if you are allergic to Olmesartan, Amlodipine, or any other ingredients of this medicine.
OLMY A 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease (such as aortic stenosis (narrowing of the aorta), cardiogenic shock, circulatory failure, or heart attack).
OLMY A 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to a lack of safety data.

OLMY A 20MG TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function are required in such patients.

Others

OLMY A 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Diabetes-related kidney problems
Severe hypotension (very low blood pressure)

Before taking this medicine, inform your physician if you:

Have severe vomiting and/or diarrhea
Are on a low-sodium diet
Have hyperkalemia (increased levels of potassium in the blood)
Have problems with the adrenal glands

introduction:
Introduction About CTD T AM 12.5/80/5MG TABLET

CTD T AM 12.5/80/5MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. CTD T AM 12.5/80/5MG TABLET is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. Essential hypertension (primary hypertension) occurs when you have abnormally high blood pressure that's not the result of a medical condition. It is characterized by symptoms such as blurred vision, severe headache, chest pain, dizziness, light-headedness and nose bleeds.

CTD T AM 12.5/80/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney and heart problems. Avoid eating or drinking grapefruit juice while taking CTD T AM 12.5/80/5MG TABLET as it may potentiate the risk of side effects. Prior to management with CTD T AM 12.5/80/5MG TABLET or during the course of management, your doctor may want you to take several tests to understand your health condition.

CTD T AM 12.5/80/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding woman. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged less than 18 years) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).   

The common side effects of taking CTD T AM 12.5/80/5MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, loss of appetite, stomach upset and skin rashes. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Manage essential hypertension
usesDetails:

Manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How CTD T AM 12.5/80/5MG TABLET Works

CTD T AM 12.5/80/5MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles and chlorthalidone works by promoting the excretion of excess fluid and certain electrolytes (such as sodium and chloride) from the body by increasing the amount of urine produced by the kidneys. Telmisartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by managing the binding of certain substance called angiotensin-II (substance produced in the body which causes narrowing of blood vessels). All these actions together effectively control high blood pressure.

Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. clarithromycin, erythromycin, amphotericin, telithromycin, rifampicin, rifabutin and trimethoprim)

introduction:
Introduction About TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET

TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels which is characterized by symptoms such as severe headache, nose bleeding, fatigue, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

Your doctor might advise you to take kidney function tests (to assess the function of your kidney), monitoring of blood pressure and regular blood tests to check the electrolytes such as potassium levels in the blood. TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with bronchospastic lung diseases such as asthma, emphysema or other lung infections, severe liver problems, impaired kidney function, heart disease such as severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock and planned for non-cardiac surgery.

Before taking TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands), diabetes, low blood pressure due to dehydration or have undergone kidney transplant surgery. TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The common side effects associated with the use of TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET Works

TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET

Take TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to have the medicine at the same time daily. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.answer: A: Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure. However, if you are habitual of drinking alcohol, you must consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

faqs.question: Q: Is TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET safe to use in patients with kidney problems?
faqs.answer: A: TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELSARTAN M 25 TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About CLINDINOL TM TABLET

CLINDINOL TM TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

CLINDINOL TM TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking CLINDINOL TM TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

CLINDINOL TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking CLINDINOL TM TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.
uses: It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CLINDINOL TM TABLET
It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
mechanismOfAction:
How CLINDINOL TM TABLET Works

CLINDINOL TM TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.
usageInstructions: Take CLINDINOL TM TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow CLINDINOL TM TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken with or without food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent blood levels.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to a sudden rise in blood pressure.
Regularly monitor your blood pressure to ensure the medication is working effectively.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.

Side Effects Of CLINDINOL TM TABLET

Like all medicines, CLINDINOL TM TABLET may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them

Most Common Side Effects of CLINDINOL TM TABLET are:
Dizziness, headache
Peripheral edema (swelling of ankles, hands and legs)
Flushing

Hyperkalaemia (increased potassium levels in the blood)
Slow heart rate
Low blood pressure
Stomach upset
Back or muscle pain, muscle spasms

Stop taking CLINDINOL TM TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Anaphylactic reaction
Angioedema (swelling underneath the skin)
Acute renal failure

warnings.details: CLINDINOL TM TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor for advice.
CLINDINOL TM TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness after taking CLINDINOL TM TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CLINDINOL TM TABLET as it may cause low blood pressure while standing up from sitting or lying position (orthostatic hypotension).

CLINDINOL TM TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic renal insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function, bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis of the artery to a single functioning kidney. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CLINDINOL TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, cholestasis, biliary obstructive disorders. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver impairment and elevated liver enzymes. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CLINDINOL TM TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan, Cilnidipine or calcium channel antagonists such as amlodipine, nifedipine.

CLINDINOL TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with advanced aortic stenosis. It should be used with caution in patients with aortic or mitral stenosis, obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, angina, ischaemic cardiopathy or ischaemic cardiovascular disease and congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking it.
CLINDINOL TM TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
CLINDINOL TM TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking CLINDINOL TM TABLET.

Others

CLINDINOL TM TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Primary aldosteronism

Before taking CLINDINOL TM TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Volume and/or sodium depletion by diuretic therapy, dietary salt restriction, diarrhoea or vomiting
Diabetes
Peripheral edema
Metabolic acidosis, cellular lysis (such as acute limb ischemia, rhabdomyolysis, extended trauma)

name: SACU V 200 Tablet 7's
introduction:
Introduction About SACU V 200 TABLET

SACU V 200 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. SACU V 200 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking SACU V 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. SACU V 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking SACU V 200 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking SACU V 200 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Introduction About BENITOWA TM TABLET

BENITOWA TM TABLET is a combination of Benidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Calcium channel blockers and Angiotensin II receptor antagonists respectively. It is used to manage high blood pressure. Hypertension is a condition in which the force of the blood against the artery walls is high, generally characterized by symptoms such as severe headache, nose bleeding, weakness, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

During management, your doctor might advise you to get a regular blood pressure check with a kidney function test to assess your kidney function and blood pressure.

BENITOWA TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with diabetes, severe liver problems (such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction) and impaired kidney function.

Before taking BENITOWA TM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body), signs of high potassium level in the body (such as pounding heartbeat, shortness of breath, chest pain, nausea or vomiting), heart disease or scheduled for a surgery.

BENITOWA TM TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is also not recommended for use in children or adolescents aged below 18 years. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking BENITOWA TM TABLET are pounding heartbeat, headache, rash, itching and photosensitivity reaction. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects get worse.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking BENITOWA TM TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking BENITOWA TM TABLET since it may increase the risk of low blood pressure.

BENITOWA TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with impaired kidney function. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney diseases, renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) and in patients with a surgical history of kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking BENITOWA TM TABLET.

BENITOWA TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gallbladder) or any other severe liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking BENITOWA TM TABLET.
BENITOWA TM TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to benidipine, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.
BENITOWA TM TABLET should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble, cardiogenic shock. Consult your doctor for advice before taking BENITOWA TM TABLET.

Others

Before taking BENITOWA TM TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have elevated potassium in the blood
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Diabetes
Are scheduled for a surgery

Use in Paediatrics:

BENITOWA TM TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in Geriatrics:

BENITOWA TM TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking BENITOWA TM TABLET.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking BENITOWA TM TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine containing lithium (used to manage certain types of depression)
Aliskiren, diuretics such as torsemide, potassium-sparing diuretics (Ex. spironolactone), ACE inhibitors such as captopril, angiotensin II receptor antagonists such as irbesartan, azilsartan (used to manage high blood pressure)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (medicines used to manage pain and inflammation) Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen
Anticoagulants such as heparin (used to manage blood clot formation)
Immunosuppressive agents such as cyclosporin or tacrolimus (medicines used to manage organ rejection after organ transplant)
Antibiotics (medicines used to manage bacterial infections) Ex. trimethoprim
Digoxin (used to manage irregular heartbeat)
Medicines used to manage inflammation or pain such as corticosteroids Ex. dexamethasone
Baclofen (used to relax muscles in the body)
Amifostine (used to protect kidneys during chemotherapy)
Narcotics such as morphine (used to manage severe pain)
Antidepressants such as fluoxetine, paroxetine (used to manage depression)
Barbiturates such as phenobarbital (used to manage seizures)

B. Drug-Food Interactions:

Avoid consuming grapefruit juice while taking BENITOWA TM TABLET due to increased risk of low blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking it.

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of BENITOWA TM TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital.

introduction:
Introduction About STAMLO T TABLET

STAMLO T TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take STAMLO T TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking STAMLO T TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking STAMLO T TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take STAMLO T TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking STAMLO T TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How STAMLO T TABLET Works

STAMLO T TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

warnings.details: Studies have shown that telmisartan can harm the growing baby. Therefore, the combination of amlodipine and telmisartan is not preferrable for use in pregnant women. Women of childbearing potential must avoid getting pregnant while taking STAMLO T TABLET.
Studies have shown that the combination of amlodipine and telmisartan may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by STAMLO T TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking STAMLO T TABLET as it could make your dizzier.
STAMLO T TABLET should be used with caution in patients having kidney problems.
STAMLO T TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver problems.
Do not take STAMLO T TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine and Telmisartan.

STAMLO T TABLET should not be used in patients with severely decreased blood pressure. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from other heart problems such as heart attack, severe hypertensive crisis, etc,
It is not known whether the combination of amlodipine and telmisartan is safe for use in children aged below 18 years. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
STAMLO T TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or more), especially if suffering from kidney problems.

Others

Before taking STAMLO T TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Have edema (swelling of hands and legs)
Have high potassium levels in blood
Are on low-sodium diet
Are dehydrated due to vomiting, diarrhoea or high fever

name: TSART MCL 25 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TSART MCL 25 TABLET

TSART MCL 25 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) or uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking TSART MCL 25 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration or gout as a precaution.

TSART MCL 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
