Avoid consumption of alcohol with CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of low blood pressure.

CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney stones and it should be taken with caution in patients having kidney artery stenosis (narrowing of blood vessels to one or both the kidneys) and kidney transplant. Consult your doctor before taking CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET.

CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (flow of bile from liver stops or slows). It should be used with caution in patients having liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET.
CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Chlorthalidone and Telmisartan.

CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with cardiogenic shock (when the heart is unable to supply enough blood to the vital organs of the body), aortic stenosis (narrowed or blocked aortic valve), heart failure after heart attack. It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble or low blood pressure (due to dehydration problems, low-salt intake, diarrhoea, or vomiting). Before taking CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET consult with your doctor.
CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult child’s doctor for advice
CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET

Others

CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are not passing urine at all
Have low levels of potassium, sodium and calcium in the blood
Have gout
Have addison’s disease

Before taking CTD T AM 12.5/40/5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Raised aldosterone levels
Diabetes (high blood sugar)

introduction:
Introduction About TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET

TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET Works

TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageInstructions: The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET.

TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET.
TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET.

TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET.

TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET.

TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET.

Others

TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking TELISTA MT 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About TELPRES LN 80MG TABLET

TELPRES LN 80MG TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

TELPRES LN 80MG TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking TELPRES LN 80MG TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

TELPRES LN 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking TELPRES LN 80MG TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELPRES LN 80MG TABLET Works

TELPRES LN 80MG TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.

If you or anyone else accidentally take too much of TELPRES LN 80MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Introduction About METORAY XL 50 TABLET

METORAY XL 50 TABLET is used in the management of high blood pressure, angina pectoris (chest pain), heart failure, arrhythmias or palpitations, heart attacks and migraine headaches. It contains Metoprolol which is a beta-blocker that works by controlling heart functions and reduces strain on the heart.

Take METORAY XL 50 TABLET only under medical supervision. It is usually taken with or immediately after meals. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor as a precaution.

Avoid alcohol consumption while taking this medicine as it lowers blood pressure. It is not recommended for use in patients with asthma, COPD, severe bradycardia, second or third-degree heart block, cardiogenic shock, cardiac failure, sick sinus syndrome (unless a permanent pacemaker is present) and unmanaged pheochromocytoma.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you have diabetes, stroke, liver or kidney disease or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

Low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, headache, cold hands and feet are some of the common side effects associated with the use metoprolol. These side effects are usually manageable. However, consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How METORAY XL 50 TABLET Works

In hypertension, METORAY XL 50 TABLET works by blocking the effect of adrenaline on the heart and decreasing cardiac output, also reducing the outflow of sympathetic neurons, and suppressing renin activity (normally responsible for the increase in blood pressure). Together, these actions lower blood pressure effectively.

In angina pectoris, METORAY XL 50 TABLET works by blocking adrenaline effects on the heart and decreases the heart rate, blood pressure, and extent of heart contraction. It also reduces the oxygen requirements of the heart, providing relief from angina.

In heart failure, METORAY XL 50 TABLET slows down the heart rate and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood around the body.

introduction:
Introduction About OLMEVAC AM 40 TABLET

OLMEVAC AM 40 TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OLMEVAC AM 40 TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OLMEVAC AM 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLMEVAC AM 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How OLMEVAC AM 40 TABLET Works

OLMEVAC AM 40 TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

OLMEVAC AM 40 TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function are required in such patients.

Are on a low-sodium diet

name: TELMISAT H Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About TELMISAT H TABLET

TELMISAT H TABLET is a combination of Telmisartan and Hydrochlorothiazide that is used for the management of hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering high blood pressure, it helps reduce the risk of strokes, heart attacks, and kidney problems.

You can take TELMISAT H TABLET with or without food. The dosage will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medication. It is best to take it at the same time every day. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you start feeling better. This medicine contains a diuretic (water pill) that increases urination, so it is advisable not to take it within four hours of bedtime. For maximum benefit, use it regularly. Since high blood pressure often has no symptoms, stopping the medication can increase your risk of heart attack or stroke.

Common side effects of this medication include dizziness, fatigue, headache, electrolyte imbalances, dehydration, feeling tired, nausea, shortness of breath, and heartbeat changes. Frequent urination is not a side effect of this medicine. It is the purpose of this medicine as frequent urination helps control your blood pressure. You may experience other possible side effects, but most are rare. Make sure you read the leaflet that comes with your medicines and tell your doctor if you are bothered by side effects or they do not go away. It may be possible to adjust your dose or try a different medicine.

Avoid using potassium supplements or salt substitutes unless advised by your doctor. This medication is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Consult your doctor before taking it if you have kidney or liver disease, heart issues, or diabetes. Consuming alcohol can further lower your blood pressure and may increase the risk of side effects.
uses: Hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TELMISAT H TABLET
Hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How TELMISAT H TABLET Works

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that works by blocking the action of a hormone called angiotensin II, which normally causes blood vessels to constrict (tighten). By inhibiting this hormone, Telmisartan helps to relax and widen blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood and lowering blood pressure, Hydrochlorothiazide is a diuretic (often called a "water pill") that helps reduce the amount of water in the body by increasing urination, which lowers the volume of fluid circulating in the bloodstream. This also helps lower blood pressure.

Together, these two ingredients work to reduce blood pressure effectively, making it easier for the heart to pump blood and reducing the risk of complications related to hypertension, like strokes or heart attacks.

However, the doctor may rarely prescribe it in some life-threatening situations if the benefits are more than the potential risks. Please consult your doctor.

TELMISAT H TABLET is not recommended for use while breastfeeding. Limited human studies indicate that the medication may transfer into breast milk and potentially harm the infant. Please consult your doctor.

Consuming alcohol while taking this medication can enhance its blood pressure-lowering effects such as dizziness or fainting. It is advisable to avoid alcohol.

TELMISAT H TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, biliary obstruction) and should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Please consult your doctor.
Do not take TELMISAT H TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan or Hydrochlorothiazide or any other ingredients of this medicine.
TELMISAT H TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as irregular heart rhythm, problems with heart muscle or valves). Please consult your doctor before taking it.
TELMISAT H TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your pediatrician before giving it.
TELMISAT H TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Dosage adjustment and careful monitoring are required in such patients. Consult and inform your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About MET XL 3D 50/6.25 TABLET

MET XL 3D 50/6.25 TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

MET XL 3D 50/6.25 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.MET XL 3D 50/6.25 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

MET XL 3D 50/6.25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking MET XL 3D 50/6.25 TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease

mechanismOfAction:
How MET XL 3D 50/6.25 TABLET Works

MET XL 3D 50/6.25 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

Take MET XL 3D 50/6.25 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. The correct dosage and duration of medicine to be taken will be prescribed by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TELSAR BISO 5 TABLET

TELSAR BISO 5 TABLET is used to manage hypertension, angina (chest pain) and heart failure in adults. It is a combination of Bisoprolol and Telmisartan which works by relaxing your blood vessels supplying the heart which in turn reduces strain on the heart. It is also used to reduce the risk of cardiovascular events such as heart attack or stroke in adults who are known to have a reduced or blocked blood supply to the heart or legs and had a stroke or with a high risk of diabetes.

Your doctor may check your kidney function test, blood pressure and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your body prior to the management or at regular intervals during management with this medicine. TELSAR BISO 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (flow of bile from liver stops or slows). TELSAR BISO 5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients having diabetes, kidney disease, heart problems and raised aldosterone levels.

TELSAR BISO 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in early pregnancy and must not be taken by women who are pregnant for more than 3 months and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. TELSAR BISO 5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (up to the age of 18 years) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effect of taking TELSAR BISO 5 TABLET is low blood pressure. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Management of hypertension (high blood pressure), angina and heart failure

mechanismOfAction:
How TELSAR BISO 5 TABLET Works

TELSAR BISO 5 TABLET contains two medicines namely, bisoprolol and telmisartan. Bisoprolol works by blocking beta-1 receptors in the heart, which slows the heart rate, reduces the force of the heart's contractions, and lowers blood pressure. This helps the heart work more efficiently and reduces its workload, making bisoprolol effective for high blood pressure, chest pain (angina), and heart failure.

Telmisartan is an Angiotensin Receptor Blocker. It works by blocking the angiotensin receptor in the body which helps in keeping the blood vessels relaxed, thus lowering the strain on heart and enables heart to pump blood more easily.

name: OMNITROL 20 AM Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About OMNITROL 20 AM TABLET

OMNITROL 20 AM TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OMNITROL 20 AM TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OMNITROL 20 AM TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OMNITROL 20 AM TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How OMNITROL 20 AM TABLET Works

OMNITROL 20 AM TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About CTD MT 6.25/50/40 TABLET

CTD MT 6.25/50/40 TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

CTD MT 6.25/50/40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.CTD MT 6.25/50/40 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

CTD MT 6.25/50/40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking CTD MT 6.25/50/40 TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of CTD MT 6.25/50/40 TABLET
Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How CTD MT 6.25/50/40 TABLET Works

CTD MT 6.25/50/40 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

Take CTD MT 6.25/50/40 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. The correct dosage and duration of medicine to be taken will be prescribed by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About AZMARDA 200MG TABLET

AZMARDA 200MG TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. AZMARDA 200MG TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking AZMARDA 200MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. AZMARDA 200MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking AZMARDA 200MG TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking AZMARDA 200MG TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
uses: Manages long-term heart failure in adults
usesDetails:
Uses Of AZMARDA 200MG TABLET
 Manages long-term heart failure in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How AZMARDA 200MG TABLET Works

AZMARDA 200MG TABLET helps to manage long-term heart failure, where sacubitril works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body and valsartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by blocking a substance called angiotensin-II (causing blood vessels to tighten) which is produced in the body and thus lowers the blood pressure.
usageDetails:

Take AZMARDA 200MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow AZMARDA 200MG TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET

TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET.

TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET.
TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET.

TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET.

TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET.

TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET.

Others

TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking TELWAVE M 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About TAH 80MG TABLET

TAH 80MG TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take TAH 80MG TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking TAH 80MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking TAH 80MG TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of TAH 80MG TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How TAH 80MG TABLET Works

TAH 80MG TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

Diet and Lifestyle Tips for TAH 80MG TABLET Users:
Limit Salt Intake: Excessive sodium can elevate blood pressure, so aim to keep salt intake low.
Focus on Whole Foods: Include fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your daily meals.
Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.
Increase Potassium-Rich Foods: Foods like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes help balance potassium levels.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration, which can exacerbate dizziness.
Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.
Manage Stress: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, yoga, or meditation.

introduction:
Introduction About ARNISAC 50 TABLET

ARNISAC 50 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. ARNISAC 50 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking ARNISAC 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. ARNISAC 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking ARNISAC 50 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking ARNISAC 50 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

name: OLMEZEST AZ 40 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About OLMEZEST AZ 40 TABLET

OLMEZEST AZ 40 TABLET is used to manage severe hypertension and chronic heart failure. It contains a combination of medicines called Azelnidipine and Olmesartan, which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. Azelnidipine works by blocking calcium channels in blood vessels, which helps them relax and lower blood pressure. Olmesartan blocks a hormone that narrows blood vessels, also helping to reduce blood pressure.

Your doctor may check your kidney function, blood pressure, and the amount of electrolytes (Ex. potassium) in your blood at regular intervals.

OLMEZEST AZ 40 TABLET is not recommended for use if you have impaired kidney function, jaundice (yellowing of the skin and eyes), or problems with drainage of the bile from the gallbladder (biliary obstruction, Ex. gallstones).

Inform your doctor if you have kidney disease, liver disease, heart failure, or problems with your heart valves or heart muscle before taking this medicine. It is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women.

The safety and effectiveness of OLMEZEST AZ 40 TABLET in newborns, infants, and children is not established. This medicine should be used with caution in elderly patients aged over 65 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking it.

The most common side effects of taking OLMEZEST AZ 40 TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, headache, nausea, indigestion, diarrhea, stomachache, gastroenteritis, sore throat, runny or stuffy nose, bronchitis, flu-like symptoms, cough, pain, pain in the chest, back, bones or joints, infection of the urinary tract, blood in the urine, and swelling of ankles, feet, legs, hands, or arms. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How OLMEZEST AZ 40 TABLET Works

Azelnidipine is a calcium channel blocker. It works by relaxing the blood vessels, making it easier for blood to flow. This helps lower high blood pressure. Olmesartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It prevents a substance called angiotensin II from tightening the blood vessels. By blocking its action, olmesartan helps to lower blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About TELSAR CHM 25 TABLET

TELSAR CHM 25 TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

TELSAR CHM 25 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.TELSAR CHM 25 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

TELSAR CHM 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking TELSAR CHM 25 TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of TELSAR CHM 25 TABLET
Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How TELSAR CHM 25 TABLET Works

TELSAR CHM 25 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

Take TELSAR CHM 25 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. The correct dosage and duration of medicine to be taken will be prescribed by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About NEBILOCK H TABLET

NEBILOCK H TABLET is a combination of Hydrochlorothiazide and Nebivolol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure).

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, NEBILOCK H TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) or stroke. During management with NEBILOCK H TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking NEBILOCK H TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney or heart problems (such as angina). You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, diabetes, thyroid problems, poor blood circulation, psoriasis or dehydration as a precaution.

NEBILOCK H TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as heart failure or heart block). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are headache, dizziness, tiredness, tingling sensation, diarrhoea, constipation, shortness of breath and swollen hands or feet. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How NEBILOCK H TABLET Works

NEBILOCK H TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It contains two medicines namely, nebivolol and hydrochlorothiazide. Nebivolol works by blocking the actions of certain chemical messengers (such as adrenaline) in the body that increases heart rate and blood pressure.

Hydrochlorothiazide works by reducing the thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions improve blood flow, reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump more blood with less pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use NEBILOCK H TABLET

Take NEBILOCK H TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take NEBILOCK H TABLET at the same time each day. NEBILOCK H TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Continue to take NEBILOCK H TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in blood)
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma

Have Raynaud’s disease (poor blood circulation to fingers and toes)
Have leg pain, tension or weakness (intermittent claudication)

Have psoriasis (white scaly patches on the skin)
Are going to undergo an operation
Are severely dehydrated
Have low sodium, potassium or magnesium levels in the blood

NEBILOCK H TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

NEBILOCK H TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About METOLAR TRIO 50 TABLET

METOLAR TRIO 50 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol, and Telmisartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking METOLAR TRIO 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration, or gout as a precaution.

METOLAR TRIO 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking METOLAR TRIO 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines, such as:

Medicines used to manage advanced renal cell carcinoma (Ex. aldesleukin)
Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)
Medicines used for bacterial infections (Ex. erythromycin)
Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin)
Medicines used to manage hypertension (Ex. aliskiren, propranolol, amlodipine, diltiazem, verapamil, propafenone, captopril, enalapril, losartan, valsartan, clonidine, moxonidine, methyldopa, rilmenidine)
Medicines used for psychosis (Ex. risperidone, thioridazine, quetiapine, olanzapine)
Medicines used to manage diabetes (such as insulin, metformin, glimepiride, teneligliptin, and pioglitazone)
Cimetidine (a medicine used to manage stomach ulcers)
Medicines used to manage an uneven heartbeat (such as digoxin, disopyramide, quinidine, or amiodarone)
Medicines used for pain and inflammation (such as ibuprofen, indomethacin, sulindac, and diclofenac)
Medicines used to manage depression (such as fluoxetine, paroxetine, bupropion, and lithium)
Ritonavir (a medicine used to manage HIV infection)
Antihistamines (used to manage allergic reactions) such as diphenhydramine
Medicines used to manage malaria (such as hydroxychloroquine, mefloquine)

Adrenaline (a medicine used to stimulate heart functions)
Phenylpropanolamine (a medicine used to reduce the swelling of the nasal mucosa)
Beta blockers used for glaucoma (such as timolol, pindolol, and labetalol)
Ergotamine (a medicine used for migraine headache)
Medicines used to manage angina (such as nitroglycerin)
Anaesthetics (used to cause numbness or loss of sensation) such as lidocaine, sevoflurane, and halothane

Antacids (medicines used to neutralize stomach acid) such as aluminium hydroxide, magaldrate
Potassium supplements or potassium-sparing diuretics such as spironolactone, triamterene, or amiloride (used to retain or increase potassium levels in the body)
Heparin (a medicine used to manage or manage blood clots)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (Ex. trimethoprim)
Medicines used to suppress immune functions (such as ciclosporin, tacrolimus)
Diuretics (used to reduce edema and blood pressure) such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide

If you or anyone else accidentally took more METOLAR TRIO 50 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately. Overdosage may cause low blood pressure, decreased heartbeat, problems breathing, vomiting, feeling faint, and fits.

introduction:
Introduction About AZTEL MT 50 TABLET

AZTEL MT 50 TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels which is characterized by symptoms such as severe headache, nose bleeding, fatigue, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

Your doctor might advise you to take kidney function tests (to assess the function of your kidney), monitoring of blood pressure and regular blood tests to check the electrolytes such as potassium levels in the blood. AZTEL MT 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with bronchospastic lung diseases such as asthma, emphysema or other lung infections, severe liver problems, impaired kidney function, heart disease such as severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock and planned for non-cardiac surgery.

Before taking AZTEL MT 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands), diabetes, low blood pressure due to dehydration or have undergone kidney transplant surgery. AZTEL MT 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. AZTEL MT 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The common side effects associated with the use of AZTEL MT 50 TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

How AZTEL MT 50 TABLET Works

AZTEL MT 50 TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.

Take AZTEL MT 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to have the medicine at the same time daily. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of AZTEL MT 50 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

faqs.question: Q: What is AZTEL MT 50 TABLET used for?
faqs.answer: A: AZTEL MT 50 TABLET is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels. It is characterized by severe headache, nose bleeding, weakness, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

faqs.question: Q: What happens if you take more AZTEL MT 50 TABLET than your required dose?
faqs.answer: A: If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of AZTEL MT 50 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are low blood pressure, fast or slow heartbeat, dizziness, heart block, heart failure, bronchospasm (constriction of lung muscles), hypoxia (lack of oxygen supply to body cells), higher levels of creatinine in the blood, sudden kidney failure, impairment of consciousness or nausea, vomiting and coma.

faqs.question: Q: What side effects are seen with AZTEL MT 50 TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The common side effects associated with the use of AZTEL MT 50 TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat and rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

faqs.question: Q: Who should avoid taking AZTEL MT 50 TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: AZTEL MT 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are having asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, lung infections, cholestasis or biliary obstruction, impaired kidney function, severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock, decompensated cardiac failure or sick sinus syndrome. It is also not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (aged below18 years). Consult your doctor before taking AZTEL MT 50 TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: Is AZTEL MT 50 TABLET safe to use in children?
faqs.answer: A: AZTEL MT 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). If AZTEL MT 50 TABLET is accidentally ingested by a child or adolescent, go to the hospital immediately and consult the doctor for further management.

faqs.question: Q: Can I drink alcohol while taking AZTEL MT 50 TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking AZTEL MT 50 TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure. However, if you are habitual of drinking alcohol, you must consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

faqs.question: Q: Is AZTEL MT 50 TABLET safe to use in patients with kidney problems?
faqs.answer: A: AZTEL MT 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking AZTEL MT 50 TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET

ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

mechanismOfAction:
How ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET Works

ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageInstructions: The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET.

ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET.
ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET.

ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET.

ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET.

ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking ARBITEL MT 50MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About SACURISE 200 TABLET

SACURISE 200 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. SACURISE 200 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking SACURISE 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. SACURISE 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking SACURISE 200 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking SACURISE 200 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

How SACURISE 200 TABLET Works

SACURISE 200 TABLET helps to manage long-term heart failure, where sacubitril works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body and valsartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by blocking a substance called angiotensin-II (causing blood vessels to tighten) which is produced in the body and thus lowers the blood pressure.

name: TELMISAFE AM 40mg Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET

TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension
usesDetails:

Hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET Works

TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, as this could affect your blood pressure management
Always follow your doctor’s advice for the best results

warnings.details: Studies have shown that telmisartan can harm the growing baby. Therefore, the combination of amlodipine and telmisartan is not preferrable for use in pregnant women. Women of childbearing potential must avoid getting pregnant while taking TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET.
Studies have shown that the combination of amlodipine and telmisartan may pass through breast milk. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.
Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET as it could make your dizzier.
TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having kidney problems.
TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients having liver problems.
Do not take TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine and Telmisartan.

TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET should not be used in patients with severely decreased blood pressure. It should be used with caution in patients suffering from other heart problems such as heart attack, severe hypertensive crisis, etc,
It is not known whether the combination of amlodipine and telmisartan is safe for use in children aged below 18 years. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
TELMISAFE AM 40MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or more), especially if suffering from kidney problems.

Others

Have diabetes
Have edema (swelling of hands and legs)
Have high potassium levels in blood
Are on low-sodium diet

name: TLS H Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TLS H TABLET

TLS H TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It contains a combination of Hydrochlorothiazide+Telmisartan that works by removing excess fluids from the body and relaxing the blood vessels which reduces strain on the heart and reduces blood pressure.

Take this medicine as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food. During management with TLS H TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking TLS H TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

TLS H TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking TLS H TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with TLS H TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking TLS H TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, low or high blood potassium levels, pins and needles, muscle pain, diarrhoea, dry mouth, erectile dysfunction and increased blood uric acid levels. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Management of Hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TLS H TABLET
Management of Hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How TLS H TABLET Works

TLS H TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.
usageInstructions: Take TLS H TABLET as directed by your physician
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
Try to take TLS H TABLET at the same time each day.
TLS H TABLET can be taken with or without food.
Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
Continue to take TLS H TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

TLS H TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or handle any heavy tools or machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness after taking TLS H TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TLS H TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

TLS H TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (such as kidney transplant, narrowing of renal arteries).

TLS H TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, biliary obstruction). It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems.
Do not take TLS H TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan or Hydrochlorothiazide or any other ingredients of this medicine.
TLS H TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as irregular heart rhythm, problems with heart muscle or valves).
TLS H TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years).
TLS H TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients.

Others

TLS H TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have diabetes related kidney problems
Have low potassium levels in blood
Have high calcium levels in blood

Before taking TLS H TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in adrenal gland)
Have low blood pressure
Are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Are on a low-salt diet
Have diabetes
Have gout (painful joints)
Have had skin cancer
Have an auto-immune disease condition affecting the skin (such as SLS)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery

During management with NUSAR AM 2.5MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. introduction:
Introduction About STARPRESS 3D 50/12.5 TABLET

STARPRESS 3D 50/12.5 TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

STARPRESS 3D 50/12.5 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.STARPRESS 3D 50/12.5 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

STARPRESS 3D 50/12.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking STARPRESS 3D 50/12.5 TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How STARPRESS 3D 50/12.5 TABLET Works

STARPRESS 3D 50/12.5 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About TELCURE BETA 50MG TABLET

TELCURE BETA 50MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take TELCURE BETA 50MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.
