Do not drive or operate any tools or machines if you experience dizziness, sleepiness, or headache after taking the medicine.
Avoid consuming alcohol while taking this medicine, as it could aggravate your dizziness and tiredness.

OLSERTAIN AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with impaired kidney function and should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems or with a surgical history of kidney transplant.

OLSERTAIN AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems (such as biliary obstruction, gallstones, and jaundice) and should be used with caution in patients with liver disease.
Do not take OLSERTAIN AM TABLET if you are allergic to Olmesartan, Amlodipine, or any other ingredients of this medicine.
OLSERTAIN AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease (such as aortic stenosis (narrowing of the aorta), cardiogenic shock, circulatory failure, or heart attack).
OLSERTAIN AM TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to a lack of safety data.

OLSERTAIN AM TABLET should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). Proper dose adjustments and careful monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function are required in such patients.

Others

OLSERTAIN AM TABLET is not recommended for use if you have:

Diabetes-related kidney problems
Severe hypotension (very low blood pressure)

Before taking this medicine, inform your physician if you:

Have severe vomiting and/or diarrhea
Are on a low-sodium diet
Have hyperkalemia (increased levels of potassium in the blood)
Have problems with the adrenal glands

Introduction About MACSART CC TABLET

MACSART CC TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs.  It is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension. Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtiredness), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness).

MACSART CC TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. MACSART CC TABLET is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken when more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to the baby if used after 3 months of pregnancy. MACSART CC TABLET is not suitable for use by breastfeeding women. MACSART CC TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

MACSART CC TABLET and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking MACSART CC TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, and chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned symptoms are not improving.

Before taking OLMEPRAX AM 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLMEPRAX AM 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How OLMEPRAX AM 40 TABLET Works

OLMEPRAX AM 40 TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking the medicine, inform your doctor if you are taking any of these medicines:

Diuretics (Ex. spironolactone)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, aspirin, diclofenac)

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of OLMEPRAX AM 40 TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital right away. Overdosage symptoms include low blood pressure, dizziness, and a fast or slow heartbeat.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNEP TM TABLET

CILNEP TM TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) or uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking CILNEP TM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration or gout as a precaution.

CILNEP TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

If you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with CILNEP TM TABLET, stop taking it and consult your doctor immediately.
CILNEP TM TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if your ability is affected by CILNEP TM TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CILNEP TM TABLET as it may make you feel dizzier and drowsier.

CILNEP TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems. It should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (such as kidney transplant, narrowing of renal arteries). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

CILNEP TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, biliary obstruction). It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CILNEP TM TABLET if you are allergic to Metoprolol, Cilnidipine or to Telmisartan.
CILNEP TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

CILNEP TM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as heart block, uncontrollable heart failure, sick sinus syndrome or a very slow or uneven heartbeat). It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as a recent heart attack, or angina attack, enlarged heart muscles, or surgery in the heart within the last 4 months). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

CILNEP TM TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are in shock caused due to poor blood circulation
Have poor blood circulation caused due to blockage in the blood vessels
Have a very low blood pressure
Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in blood)
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (tumor present in adrenal glands)
Have diabetes related kidney problems
Have low potassium levels in blood
Have high calcium levels in blood

Before taking CILNEP TM TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are prone to allergic reactions very often (such as even for insect bites)
Have problems in blood circulation around the body (especially in fingers, arms and feet)
Have diabetes
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased thyroid hormones in the body)
Are severely dehydrated
Have low sodium, potassium, or magnesium levels in the blood
Have gout
Have psoriasis (white scaly patches on the skin)
Have edema (swelling of body parts)
Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in adrenal gland)
Are on a low-salt diet
Have had skin cancer
Have an auto-immune disease condition affecting the skin (such as SLS)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery

Use in pediatrics:

CILNEP TM TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

CILNEP TM TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Medicines used to manage epilepsy (Ex. carbamazepine, phenytoin, phenobarbital)

Medicines used to manage tuberculosis (Ex. rifampicin)

Medicines used for pain and inflammation (such as ibuprofen, indomethacin, sulindac, diclofenac)
Medicines used to manage depression (such as fluoxetine, paroxetine, bupropion, lithium)

Medicines used to manage malaria (such as hydroxychloroquine, mefloquine)

Phenylpropanolamine (a medicine used to reduce the swelling of the nasal mucosa)
Beta blockers used for glaucoma (such as timolol, pindolol, labetalol)
Ergotamine (a medicine used for migraine headache)
Medicines used to manage angina (such as nitroglycerin)
Anaesthetics (used to cause numbness or loss of sensation) such as lidocaine, sevoflurane, halothane

name: Cilnipres Trio 6.25mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET

CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage essential hypertension.

Hypertension also known as high or raised blood pressure, is a condition in which the blood vessels have persistently raised pressure. Blood is carried from the heart to all parts of the body in the vessels. Each time the heart beats, it pumps blood into the vessels.

Blood pressure is created by the force of blood pushing against the walls of blood vessels (arteries) as it is pumped by the heart. The higher the pressure, the harder the heart has to pump.

During the course of management your doctor might regularly monitor your blood pressure, kidney function and electrolyte balance at regular intervals to avoid any untoward side effects.

CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver, kidney, and heart disease. Consult your doctor before taking.

CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breastmilk to the baby. Consult your doctor for advice.

Safety and efficacy in pediatric patients is not established. Consult your doctor before taking. CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients of 65 years and above. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET are dizziness, nausea, headache, constipation, fever, chills. Consult your doctor if the above-mentioned side effects persists for a longer duration.
uses: Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET
Used to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET Works

CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing excretion of sodium (which is necessary for constriction of blood vessels) and water from the body causing the blood vessels to relax and Cilnidipine makes the blood vessels to relax and thus lowers the blood pressure by blocking the calcium entry in blood vessels which is necessary for the smooth muscle contraction. Olmesartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (substance produced in your body which causes narrowing of blood vessels).
usageDetails:
How to use CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET

Take CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Valsartan, captopril, aliskiren (used to lower blood pressure)
Digoxin (medicine used to manage heart failure and abnormal heart rhythm)
Cimetidine (medicine used for stomach ulcer)
Rifampicin (medicine used to manage tuberculosis)
Itraconazole, miconazole (medicines used to manage fungal infections)
Medicines that may increase blood potassium levels such as salt substitutes containing potassium, potassium-sparing diuretics (Ex. amiloride, spironolactone)
Lithium (used to manage mood swings and some types of depression)
Medicines used to manage pain and inflammation (Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen)
Colesevelam (lowers the level of cholesterol in your blood)
Antacids like aluminium hydroxide, magnesium hydroxide (used for indigestion, heartburn)

B. Drug - Food interaction:

Avoid drinking grapefruit juice while taking CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET as it may increase the levels of this medicine n body.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of CILNIPRES TRIO 6.25MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdosage includes low blood pressure, dizziness, nausea, sleepiness, and electrolyte disturbances associated with cardiac arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat) and muscle stiffness.

name: TELDAWN BETA 40/50 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET

TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels which is characterized by symptoms such as severe headache, nose bleeding, fatigue, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

Your doctor might advise you to take kidney function tests (to assess the function of your kidney), monitoring of blood pressure and regular blood tests to check the electrolytes such as potassium levels in the blood. TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with bronchospastic lung diseases such as asthma, emphysema or other lung infections, severe liver problems, impaired kidney function, heart disease such as severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock and planned for non-cardiac surgery.

Before taking TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands), diabetes, low blood pressure due to dehydration or have undergone kidney transplant surgery. TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The common side effects associated with the use of TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Manage high blood pressure (hypertension)
usesDetails:
Uses Of TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET
Manage high blood pressure (hypertension)
mechanismOfAction:
How TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET Works

TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET

Take TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to have the medicine at the same time daily. faqs.answer: A: TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels. It is characterized by severe headache, nose bleeding, weakness, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

faqs.question: Q: What happens if you take more TELDAWN BETA 40/50 TABLET than your required dose?

introduction:
Introduction About AZTEL CT 40/12.5 TABLET

AZTEL CT 40/12.5 TABLET is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) in affected individuals when monotherapy with chlorthalidone or telmisartan becomes inadequate to control the condition. It is also used as initial therapy in patients who are indicated for multiple drug therapy to control high blood pressure. It is a combination of Chlorthalidone and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics and Angiotensin II receptor blockers, respectively.

AZTEL CT 40/12.5 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chlorthalidone, telmisartan, and/or any sulphonamide-derived medicines. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from anuria and severe liver impairment. Before taking the medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver problems, kidney problems and/or heart problems (such as congestive heart failure).

AZTEL CT 40/12.5 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women since it passes through breast milk. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 to 18 years) and in elders (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects are back pain, sore throat, nausea, abdominal pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

How AZTEL CT 40/12.5 TABLET Works

AZTEL CT 40/12.5 TABLET helps to lower blood pressure, where telmisartan works by blocking angiotensin (a hormone responsible for regulating blood pressure and maintaining fluid balance in the body) which leads to relaxation of blood vessels and Chlorthalidone works by removing extra water and certain electrolytes from the body which leads to relaxation of blood pressure and improved blood flow thus reducing high blood pressure in affected individuals.

introduction:
Introduction About OLMO M 25 TABLET

OLMO M 25 TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) and uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking OLMO M 25 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions or gout as a precaution.

OLMO M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe low blood pressure, uncontrollable heart failure or heart block. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow or fast heart rate, cold hands and feet, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, constipation, sore throat, cough, high blood cholesterol levels and swollen ankles. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.
uses: Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
Prevents heart attack, stroke, angina (chest pain) and arrhythmia (uneven heartbeat)

How OLMO M 25 TABLET Works

OLMO M 25 TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and various other organs of the body. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump more blood with less pressure.

Take OLMO M 25 TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking this medicine without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About TELMED AH 80MG TABLET

TELMED AH 80MG TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take TELMED AH 80MG TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking TELMED AH 80MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking TELMED AH 80MG TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of TELMED AH 80MG TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELMED AH 80MG TABLET Works

TELMED AH 80MG TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

introduction:
Introduction About CORTEL 3D TABLET

CORTEL 3D TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive drugs. Introduction About STARPRESS 3D TABLET

STARPRESS 3D TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

STARPRESS 3D TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.STARPRESS 3D TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

STARPRESS 3D TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking STARPRESS 3D TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.

Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About TELONG DUO TABLET

TELONG DUO TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take TELONG DUO TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking TELONG DUO TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TELONG DUO TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take TELONG DUO TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking TELONG DUO TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How TELONG DUO TABLET Works

TELONG DUO TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About CTD MT 12.5/25/40 TABLET

CTD MT 12.5/25/40 TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

CTD MT 12.5/25/40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.CTD MT 12.5/25/40 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

CTD MT 12.5/25/40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking CTD MT 12.5/25/40 TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease

mechanismOfAction:
How CTD MT 12.5/25/40 TABLET Works

CTD MT 12.5/25/40 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNIPRES T 80MG TABLET

CILNIPRES T 80MG TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

CILNIPRES T 80MG TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking CILNIPRES T 80MG TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

CILNIPRES T 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking CILNIPRES T 80MG TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.

mechanismOfAction:
How CILNIPRES T 80MG TABLET Works

CILNIPRES T 80MG TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET

TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is a combination of Chlorthalidone, Amlodipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is used to manage essential hypertension in adults. Essential hypertension (primary hypertension) occurs when you have abnormally high blood pressure that's not the result of a medical condition. It is characterized by symptoms such as blurred vision, severe headache, chest pain, dizziness, light-headedness and nose bleeds.

TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having severe liver, kidney and heart problems. Avoid eating or drinking grapefruit juice while taking TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET as it may potentiate the risk of side effects. Prior to management with TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET or during the course of management, your doctor may want you to take several tests to understand your health condition.

TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding woman. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged less than 18 years) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age).   

The common side effects of taking TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, loss of appetite, stomach upset and skin rashes. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the side effect worsens.
uses: Manage essential hypertension
usesDetails:
Uses Of TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET
Manage essential hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET Works

TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET helps to reduce high blood pressure, where amlodipine works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving the flow of blood to the heart muscles and chlorthalidone works by promoting the excretion of excess fluid and certain electrolytes (such as sodium and chloride) from the body by increasing the amount of urine produced by the kidneys. Telmisartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by managing the binding of certain substance called angiotensin-II (substance produced in the body which causes narrowing of blood vessels). All these actions together effectively control high blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET

Take TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is not generally recommended for pregnant women as it may cause serious harm to the baby. Consult your doctor before taking TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET.

TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through breast milk. Your doctor may choose another management especially if you want to breast-feed when your baby is new-born or born prematurely. Consult your doctor before taking TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel dizziness, tiredness, headache or feel sick after taking TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol with TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET as it may increase the risk of low blood pressure.

TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with kidney stones and it should be taken with caution in patients having kidney artery stenosis (narrowing of blood vessels to one or both the kidneys) and kidney transplant. Consult your doctor before taking TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET.

TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (flow of bile from liver stops or slows). It should be used with caution in patients having liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET.
TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to Amlodipine, Chlorthalidone and Telmisartan.

TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with cardiogenic shock (when the heart is unable to supply enough blood to the vital organs of the body), aortic stenosis (narrowed or blocked aortic valve), heart failure after heart attack. It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble or low blood pressure (due to dehydration problems, low-salt intake, diarrhoea, or vomiting). Before taking TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET consult with your doctor.
TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult child’s doctor for advice.
TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET

Others

TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are not passing urine at all
Have low levels of potassium, sodium and calcium in the blood
Have gout
Have addison’s disease

Before taking TRITELSAR HS 80MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Raised aldosterone levels
Diabetes (high blood sugar)

introduction:
Introduction About HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET

HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension
usesDetails:
Uses Of HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET
Hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET Works

HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

Always follow your doctor’s advice for the best results

Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by HYTEL AM FORTE TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET

ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.

Uses Of ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET

mechanismOfAction:
How ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET Works

ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.

warnings.details: ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor for advice.
ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET is not recommended for use in breast-feeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.
Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness after taking ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET as it may cause low blood pressure while standing up from sitting or lying position (orthostatic hypotension).

ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic renal insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function, bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis of the artery to a single functioning kidney. Consult your doctor before taking it.

ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, cholestasis, biliary obstructive disorders. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver impairment and elevated liver enzymes. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan, Cilnidipine or calcium channel antagonists such as amlodipine, nifedipine.

ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with advanced aortic stenosis. It should be used with caution in patients with aortic or mitral stenosis, obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, angina, ischaemic cardiopathy or ischaemic cardiovascular disease and congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking it.
ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET.

Others

ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Primary aldosteronism

Before taking ERITEL LN 20/80 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Volume and/or sodium depletion by diuretic therapy, dietary salt restriction, diarrhoea or vomiting
Diabetes
Peripheral edema
Metabolic acidosis, cellular lysis (such as acute limb ischemia, rhabdomyolysis, extended trauma)

introduction:
Introduction About LNDIP TM 50 TABLET

LNDIP TM 50 TABLET is a combination of Cilnidipine, Metoprolol, and Telmisartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina), or an uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking LNDIP TM 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, low blood pressure, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions, dehydration, or gout as a precaution.

LNDIP TM 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems apart from hypertension (such as uncontrollable heart failure or heart block). Do not take this medicine without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow heart rate, cold hands and feet, racing heartbeat, swelling of ankles or other body parts, flushing, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhea, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects worsen.

LNDIP TM 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, or biliary obstruction). It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take LNDIP TM 50 TABLET if you are allergic to metoprolol, cilnidipine, or telmisartan.
LNDIP TM 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

LNDIP TM 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as heart block, uncontrollable heart failure, sick sinus syndrome, or a very slow or uneven heartbeat). It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as a recent heart attack, angina attack, enlarged heart muscles, or surgery in the heart within the last 4 months). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
LNDIP TM 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.
LNDIP TM 50 TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Are in shock caused by poor blood circulation
Have poor blood circulation caused by blockage in the blood vessels
Have a very low blood pressure
Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in the blood)
Have unmanaged phaeochromocytoma (tumor present in adrenal glands)
Have diabetes-related kidney problems
Have low potassium levels in blood
Have high calcium levels in blood

Before taking LNDIP TM 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Are prone to allergic reactions very often (such as even for insect bites)
Have problems in blood circulation around the body (especially in fingers, arms, and feet)

Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in the adrenal gland)
Are on a low-salt diet
Have had skin cancer
Have an auto-immune disease condition affecting the skin (such as SLS)
Are scheduled for any upcoming surgery

introduction:
Introduction About TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET

TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

How TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET Works

TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
The recommended dosage is determined by your doctor based on your medical condition and response to treatment.
TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET can be taken with or without meals.
Take this medicine at the same time each day to maintain a steady level of medication in your body.
Avoid Nighttime Doses: As this medicine contains a diuretic, avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent excessive urination at night.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember.
If it’s close to the time for your next dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.
Do not double the dose to make up for a missed one.
Taking more than the prescribed dose may lead to serious symptoms such as severe dizziness, fainting, or a significant drop in blood pressure.
In case of suspected overdose, seek immediate medical attention or visit the nearest emergency room.
Stopping this medication suddenly can cause your blood pressure to rise significantly, increasing the risk of heart attack or stroke.
Always consult your doctor before discontinuing the medication. They may gradually reduce your dose if necessary.
Stay hydrated to prevent side effects like muscle cramps, dry mouth, or weakness.
Follow your doctor’s advice on lifestyle changes such as a low-salt diet, regular exercise, and stress management to improve the effectiveness of the medication.

TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease and anuria (low urine output). No dose adjustment is recommended for patients with mild to moderate kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.

TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. It should be used with caution in patients with mild liver problems. Such patients will be prescribed with a low dose and the dosage will be gradually increased. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe obstructive coronary artery disease due to the increased risk of worsening angina and acute myocardial infarction. It is also used with caution if you have severe congestive heart failure and volume depletion due to the increased risk of developing oliguria, progressive azotemia, or acute renal failure on this medication.

TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET is typically not recommended for use in pediatric patients due to a lack of established safety and efficacy data in children. This medication, which combines amlodipine and telmisartan, is primarily used for managing hypertension in adults. For pediatric use, alternative antihypertensive medications should be considered, and any treatment should be guided by a healthcare professional.
TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions
A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicines before taking TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET:

NSAIDs: Can reduce the blood pressure-lowering effect of TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET, potentially leading to less control over hypertension.
Lithium: May increase the risk of lithium toxicity, requiring close monitoring of blood levels.
Other Antihypertensive Medications: Can enhance blood pressure-lowering effects, increasing the risk of hypotension.
Potassium Supplements: Risk of hyperkalemia, leading to potentially dangerous heart-related issues.
B. Other Drug-Drug interactions:
Direct renin inhibitor (Ex. Aliskiren)
Antimanic (Ex. Lithium)
Cardiac glycosides (Ex. Digoxin)
Antidiabetic drugs (Ex. glimepiride, insulin)
Antihyperlipidemics (Ex. Cholestyramine and Colestipol)
Phosphodiesterase inhibitors (Ex. Sildenafil)
Statins (Ex. Simvastatin)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. cyclosporine or tacrolimus)
C. Drug-food interactions:
High Potassium Foods: Should be consumed cautiously to prevent excessive potassium levels, which may lead to heart complications.
Alcohol: Can enhance dizziness and low blood pressure, increasing the risk of fainting.

Diet and Lifestyle Tips for TELSAR AMH 80 TABLET Users:
Limit Salt Intake: Excessive sodium can elevate blood pressure, so aim to keep salt intake low.
Focus on Whole Foods: Include fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your daily meals.
Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.
Increase Potassium-Rich Foods: Foods like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes help balance potassium levels.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration, which can exacerbate dizziness.
Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.
Manage Stress: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, yoga, or meditation.
Avoid Smoking and Excessive Alcohol: Both can interfere with the effectiveness of blood pressure medication.
Monitor Blood Pressure Regularly: Keep track of your readings and share them with your doctor.
Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to support overall health.

These tips can complement your treatment and help manage hypertension effectively. Always consult your doctor for personalized advice.

For pediatric use, alternative antihypertensive medications should be considered, and any treatment should be guided by a healthcare professional.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Inform your physician if you are taking any of the following medicines before taking TELMIMAC AH TABLET:

NSAIDs: Can reduce the blood pressure-lowering effect of TELMIMAC AH TABLET, potentially leading to less control over hypertension.
Lithium: May increase the risk of lithium toxicity, requiring close monitoring of blood levels.

Direct renin inhibitor (Ex. Aliskiren)
Antimanic (Ex. Lithium)

Phosphodiesterase inhibitors (Ex. Sildenafil)
Statins (Ex. Simvastatin)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. cyclosporine or tacrolimus)
C. Drug-food interactions:
High Potassium Foods: Should be consumed cautiously to prevent excessive potassium levels, which may lead to heart complications.
Alcohol: Can enhance dizziness and low blood pressure, increasing the risk of fainting.

More Information
Diet and Lifestyle Tips for TELMIMAC AH TABLET Users:
Limit Salt Intake: Excessive sodium can elevate blood pressure, so aim to keep salt intake low.
Focus on Whole Foods: Include fresh fruits, vegetables, and whole grains in your daily meals.
Reduce Processed Foods: Minimize foods high in preservatives, trans fats, and artificial sweeteners.
Increase Potassium-Rich Foods: Foods like bananas, spinach, and sweet potatoes help balance potassium levels.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water to prevent dehydration, which can exacerbate dizziness.
Exercise Regularly: Aim for at least 30 minutes of moderate activity most days of the week.
Manage Stress: Practice relaxation techniques such as deep breathing, yoga, or meditation.
Avoid Smoking and Excessive Alcohol: Both can interfere with the effectiveness of blood pressure medication.
Monitor Blood Pressure Regularly: Keep track of your readings and share them with your doctor.
Get Enough Sleep: Aim for 7-8 hours of quality sleep to support overall health.

These tips can complement your treatment and help manage hypertension effectively. Always consult your doctor for personalized advice.

introduction:
Introduction About SARTEL BETA PLUS 50 TABLET

SARTEL BETA PLUS 50 TABLET contains Chlorthalidone, Telmisartan and Metoprolol which belong to the group of medicines called Antihypertensives. It is used to manage essential hypertension with stable coronary artery disease. High blood pressure that is not caused by any other condition is called essential hypertension.

Symptoms of essential hypertension include early morning headaches, nosebleeds, an irregular heartbeat, vision changes, buzzing in the ears, fatigue (feeling overtired), nausea, vomiting, confusion, anxiety, chest pain, and muscle tremors (shakiness). Stable coronary artery disease is characterised by chest pain, discomfort, tightness, and pressure and is caused by any blockage in the blood vessels of the heart caused by physical exertion.

SARTEL BETA PLUS 50 TABLET should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver, kidney, or heart disease.SARTEL BETA PLUS 50 TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, if you think you might become pregnant, or in breastfeeding women.

SARTEL BETA PLUS 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents up to the age of 18 years, and it should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years and above. The common side effects of taking SARTEL BETA PLUS 50 TABLET are low blood pressure, diarrhoea, constipation, tiredness, headache, dizziness, and sleepiness. Consult your doctor if the symptom worsens.
uses: Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
usesDetails:
Uses Of SARTEL BETA PLUS 50 TABLET
Manage hypertension with stable coronary artery disease
mechanismOfAction:
How SARTEL BETA PLUS 50 TABLET Works

SARTEL BETA PLUS 50 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.

Take SARTEL BETA PLUS 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. The correct dosage and duration of medicine to be taken will be prescribed by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About VALSAC 50 TABLET

VALSAC 50 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. VALSAC 50 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking VALSAC 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. VALSAC 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking VALSAC 50 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking VALSAC 50 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

 Manages long-term heart failure in adults
mechanismOfAction:
How VALSAC 50 TABLET Works

VALSAC 50 TABLET helps to manage long-term heart failure, where sacubitril works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body and valsartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by blocking a substance called angiotensin-II (causing blood vessels to tighten) which is produced in the body and thus lowers the blood pressure.

Take VALSAC 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow VALSAC 50 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

CTD MT 12.5/50/40 TABLET effectively reduces the blood pressure and workload in the heart, where Chlorthalidone acts by enhancing the excretion of sodium and water from the body and Telmisartan acts by blocking the effects of Angiotensin II (a substance produced in your body that causes narrowing of blood vessels). Metoprolol acts by blocking the beta-1 receptors and reducing the effects of stress hormones in the heart, leading to a low heart rate and a fall in blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use CTD MT 12.5/50/40 TABLET

Take CTD MT 12.5/50/40 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine, do not crush, or chew the medicine. The correct dosage and duration of medicine to be taken will be prescribed by your doctor depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET

TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels which is characterized by symptoms such as severe headache, nose bleeding, fatigue, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

Your doctor might advise you to take kidney function tests (to assess the function of your kidney), monitoring of blood pressure and regular blood tests to check the electrolytes such as potassium levels in the blood. TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with bronchospastic lung diseases such as asthma, emphysema or other lung infections, severe liver problems, impaired kidney function, heart disease such as severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock and planned for non-cardiac surgery.

Before taking TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands), diabetes, low blood pressure due to dehydration or have undergone kidney transplant surgery. TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The common side effects associated with the use of TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET Works

TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET

Take TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to have the medicine at the same time daily. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET.

Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)

Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before taking TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Lithium, fluoxetine, paroxetine and antidepressants such as amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Medicines that may increase blood potassium levels such as potassium-sparing diuretics (medicines used to manage high blood pressure) Ex. Spironolactone
Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors (Ex. Captopril, enalapril) angiotensin II receptor antagonists (Ex. Irbesartan), diuretics (Ex. Furosemide), diltiazem, clonidine, verapamil and aliskiren (medicines used to manage high blood pressure)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (medicines used to manage pain and inflammation) Ex. Aspirin, ibuprofen
Anticoagulants (medicines used to manage blood clot formation) Ex. Heparin
Immunosuppressives (medicines used to manage organ rejection after transplant) Ex. Cyclosporin or tacrolimus
Antibiotics (medicines used to manage bacterial infections) Ex. Trimethoprim
Medicines used to manage inflammation or pain such as corticosteroids Ex. Dexamethasone
Baclofen (used to relax muscle in the body)
Amifostine (used to manage certain cancers)
Barbiturates such as phenobarbital (used to manage seizures)
Narcotics such as morphine (used to manage severe pain)
Quinidine, propafenone and digoxin (used to manage irregular heartbeat)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Overdosage symptoms of TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET are low blood pressure, fast or slow heartbeat, dizziness, heart block, heart failure, bronchospasm (constriction of lung muscles), hypoxia (lack of oxygen supply to body cells), higher levels of creatinine in the blood, sudden kidney failure, impairment of consciousness, nausea, vomiting and coma.

faqs.question: Q: Who should avoid taking TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are having asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, lung infections, cholestasis or biliary obstruction, impaired kidney function, severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock, decompensated cardiac failure or sick sinus syndrome. It is also not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (aged below18 years). Consult your doctor before taking TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: Is TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET safe to use in children?
faqs.answer: A: TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). If TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET is accidentally ingested by a child or adolescent, go to the hospital immediately and consult the doctor for further management.

faqs.question: Q: Can I drink alcohol while taking TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure. However, if you are habitual of drinking alcohol, you must consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

faqs.question: Q: Is TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET safe to use in patients with kidney problems?
faqs.answer: A: TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELMIMAC M 25MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About MET XL T 50 TABLET

MET XL T 50 TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take MET XL T 50 TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

mechanismOfAction:
How MET XL T 50 TABLET Works

MET XL T 50 TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageInstructions: The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, MET XL T 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

MET XL T 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking MET XL T 50 TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking MET XL T 50 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MET XL T 50 TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

MET XL T 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking MET XL T 50 TABLET.

MET XL T 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking MET XL T 50 TABLET.
MET XL T 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

MET XL T 50 TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking MET XL T 50 TABLET.

MET XL T 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking MET XL T 50 TABLET.

MET XL T 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking MET XL T 50 TABLET.

MET XL T 50 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking MET XL T 50 TABLET.

Others

MET XL T 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking MET XL T 50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood
