introduction:
Introduction About TELMED AZ 40 TABLET

TELMED AZ 40 TABLET is a combination of Azelnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage stage II hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, TELMED AZ 40 TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) and stroke. During management with TELMED AZ 40 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking TELMED AZ 40 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea. Avoid taking grapefruit juice while taking this medicine as it may reduce the risk of side effects.

TELMED AZ 40 TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking TELMED AZ 40 TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with TELMED AZ 40 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking TELMED AZ 40 TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELMED AZ 40 TABLET Works

TELMED AZ 40 TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Azelnidipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Azelnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

TELMIPACK CL 40/10MG TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

TELMIPACK CL 40/10MG TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking TELMIPACK CL 40/10MG TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

TELMIPACK CL 40/10MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking TELMIPACK CL 40/10MG TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. mechanismOfAction:
How TELMIPACK CL 40/10MG TABLET Works

TELMIPACK CL 40/10MG TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.

introduction:
Introduction About TELTAS M 25 TABLET

TELTAS M 25 TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take TELTAS M 25 TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

How TELTAS M 25 TABLET Works

TELTAS M 25 TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageInstructions: The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, TELTAS M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

TELTAS M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking TELTAS M 25 TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking TELTAS M 25 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELTAS M 25 TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

TELTAS M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELTAS M 25 TABLET.

TELTAS M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TELTAS M 25 TABLET.
TELTAS M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TELTAS M 25 TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking TELTAS M 25 TABLET.

TELTAS M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELTAS M 25 TABLET.

TELTAS M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking TELTAS M 25 TABLET.

TELTAS M 25 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking TELTAS M 25 TABLET.

Others

TELTAS M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking TELTAS M 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

Introduction About VINVES 50 TABLET

VINVES 50 TABLET is a combination medication containing Sacubitril and Valsartan. It is primarily used in the management of heart failure and hypertension. This innovative drug helps to improve heart function and manage high blood pressure, leading to better overall cardiovascular health.

VINVES 50 TABLET can be taken with or without food. For optimal results, take it at the same time every day. Your doctor will determine the appropriate dose and frequency, which may vary based on your response to the medication. It is important to take the tablets consistently as prescribed and avoid missing any doses to achieve the best outcome. Even if you are feeling better, do not stop taking the medication, as it helps prevent future complications.

Common side effect of this medication includes dizziness, lightheadedness, fatigue, low blood pressure, elevated potassium levels, angioedema (swelling under the skin) and cough. To help minimize the risk of dizziness caused by low blood pressure, try rising gradually from a sitting or lying position. If these or any other side effects become severe or persist, inform your doctor.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you are currently taking any other medications for blood pressure or heart conditions, or if you have kidney or liver disease. Additionally, make sure to share all other medications you are using, as they may interact with this medicine. This medication is not recommended during pregnancy and should be avoided while breastfeeding. While taking this medication, your doctor may recommend regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function.

How VINVES 50 TABLET Works

VINVES 50 TABLET, a combination of sacubitril and valsartan that works by improving heart function in patients with heart failure. Sacubitril is a neprilysin inhibitor that prevents the breakdown of natriuretic peptides, which help dilate blood vessels, reduce fluid retention, and lower blood pressure. Valsartan, an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), further supports this by blocking the effects of angiotensin II, a hormone that constricts blood vessels and raises blood pressure. Together, these two components help relax blood vessels, reduce fluid buildup, and ease the heart's workload, ultimately improving heart function and reducing symptoms of heart failure.

introduction:
Introduction About ARBLOCK AM TABLET

ARBLOCK AM TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take ARBLOCK AM TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking ARBLOCK AM TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking ARBLOCK AM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take ARBLOCK AM TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking ARBLOCK AM TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

Hypertension
mechanismOfAction:
How ARBLOCK AM TABLET Works

ARBLOCK AM TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by ARBLOCK AM TABLET.

Introduction About TELVILITE 40 AM TABLET
What is TELVILITE 40 AM TABLET Tablet?

TELVILITE 40 AM TABLET is a prescription medicine used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension). It contains Telmisartan (40mg) and Amlodipine (5mg), which help to relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.

TELVILITE 40 AM TABLET helps to controls high blood pressure, reduces the risk of heart-related complications and improves blood circulation.

Take one TELVILITE 40 AM TABLET daily with or without food, as directed by your doctor. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.

Avoid alcohol while taking TELVILITE 40 AM TABLET. Inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease.

The most common side effects of taking TELVILITE 40 AM TABLET are dizziness, swelling in ankles or feet, headache or fatigue. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELVILITE 40 AM TABLET Works

1. Telmisartan (Angiotensin II Receptor Blocker - ARB):

Blocks Angiotensin II, a hormone that narrows blood vessels and increases blood pressure
When blocked, blood vessels stay relaxed and open, lowering blood pressure

2. Amlodipine (Calcium Channel Blocker - CCB):

Inhibits calcium from entering blood vessel muscles, stopping them from tightening
This helps blood vessels remain wide, allowing better blood flow and reducing pressure
Who should take TELVILITE 40 AM TABLET?
Patients with hypertension – helps control blood pressure and reduces complications
Individuals with Heart disease – reduces the risk of heart attack, stroke, and heart failure
People with poor blood circulation – helps widen blood vessels and improve oxygen flow

Adults (18-65 years) – commonly prescribed for hypertension management
Elderly (65+ years) – used under medical supervision due to possible sensitivity to medication
Individuals with risk factors:
Family history of hypertension or heart disease
Diabetes or high cholesterol
Obesity or sedentary lifestyle
Excessive salt or alcohol intake
Stress-related high blood pressure

High Risk Group - Why It is risky?

Pregnant women

	

Telmisartan can harm the unborn baby, cause low amniotic fluid, and lead to birth defects. Avoid use, especially in the second and third trimester




Breastfeeding mothers

	

The medication may pass into breast milk, potentially affecting the baby’s blood pressure and kidney function. Consult a doctor before use.




Individuals with Low blood pressure (hypotension)

	

TELVILITE 40 AM TABLET lowers blood pressure, which can cause dizziness, fainting, or shock in people with already low BP




Kidney Disease Patients

	

Telmisartan affects kidney function, and Amlodipine may cause fluid retention, worsening kidney disease




Severe Heart Failure Patients

	

Can lead to excessive BP drop, irregular heartbeat, or worsened heart failure symptoms




Liver Disease Patients

	

The drug is metabolized in the liver, and damaged liver function can lead to toxic buildup




High Potassium (Hyperkalemia) Patients

	

Telmisartan can increase potassium levels, leading to dangerous heart rhythm problems




Patients on Certain Medications

Introduction About TELMIJUB CH 40 TABLET

TELMIJUB CH 40 TABLET is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) in affected individuals when monotherapy with chlorthalidone or telmisartan becomes inadequate to control the condition. It is also used as initial therapy in patients who are indicated for multiple drug therapy to control high blood pressure. It is a combination of Chlorthalidone and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Diuretics and Angiotensin II receptor blockers, respectively.

TELMIJUB CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who are allergic to chlorthalidone, telmisartan, and/or any sulphonamide-derived medicines. It is also not recommended for use in patients suffering from anuria and severe liver impairment. Before taking the medicine, inform your doctor if you have liver problems, kidney problems and/or heart problems (such as congestive heart failure).

TELMIJUB CH 40 TABLET is not recommended for use during pregnancy and in women planning for pregnancy. It is also not recommended for use in breastfeeding women since it passes through breast milk. It should be used with caution in children and adolescents (aged 6 to 18 years) and in elders (aged 65 years and above). The most common side effects are back pain, sore throat, nausea, abdominal pain, indigestion, diarrhoea, and/or headache. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms worsen.

Introduction About VENPRES AMH 80 TABLET

VENPRES AMH 80 TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take VENPRES AMH 80 TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking VENPRES AMH 80 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking VENPRES AMH 80 TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of VENPRES AMH 80 TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How VENPRES AMH 80 TABLET Works

VENPRES AMH 80 TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

How to use TELMINORM BXL

Take TELMINORM BXL as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Dosage and Administration
The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
Missed Dosage instructions for TELMINORM BXL:
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Overdosage instructions for TELMINORM BXL:
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.
In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, TELMINORM BXL is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

TELMINORM BXL is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking TELMINORM BXL. Consult your doctor before taking TELMINORM BXL.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELMINORM BXL since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

TELMINORM BXL is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELMINORM BXL.

TELMINORM BXL is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TELMINORM BXL.
TELMINORM BXL is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TELMINORM BXL should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking TELMINORM BXL.

TELMINORM BXL is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELMINORM BXL.

TELMINORM BXL is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking TELMINORM BXL.

TELMINORM BXL should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking TELMINORM BXL.

Others

TELMINORM BXL is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking TELMINORM BXL, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About AMLIP TL TABLET

AMLIP TL TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take AMLIP TL TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking AMLIP TL TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMLIP TL TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take AMLIP TL TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking AMLIP TL TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLIP TL TABLET Works

AMLIP TL TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

Do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by AMLIP TL TABLET.

AMLIP TL TABLET should be used with caution in patients having kidney problems.

Others

name: TELVILITE 40 H Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About TELVILITE 40 H TABLET

TELVILITE 40 H TABLET is a combination of Telmisartan and Hydrochlorothiazide that is used for the management of hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering high blood pressure, it helps reduce the risk of strokes, heart attacks, and kidney problems.

You can take TELVILITE 40 H TABLET with or without food. The dosage will depend on your condition and how you respond to the medication. It is best to take it at the same time every day. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you start feeling better. This medicine contains a diuretic (water pill) that increases urination, so it is advisable not to take it within four hours of bedtime. For maximum benefit, use it regularly. Since high blood pressure often has no symptoms, stopping the medication can increase your risk of heart attack or stroke.

Common side effects of this medication include dizziness, fatigue, headache, electrolyte imbalances, dehydration, feeling tired, nausea, shortness of breath, and heartbeat changes. Frequent urination is not a side effect of this medicine. It is the purpose of this medicine as frequent urination helps control your blood pressure. You may experience other possible side effects, but most are rare. Make sure you read the leaflet that comes with your medicines and tell your doctor if you are bothered by side effects or they do not go away. It may be possible to adjust your dose or try a different medicine.

Avoid using potassium supplements or salt substitutes unless advised by your doctor. This medication is not recommended during pregnancy or breastfeeding. Consult your doctor before taking it if you have kidney or liver disease, heart issues, or diabetes. Consuming alcohol can further lower your blood pressure and may increase the risk of side effects.

Uses Of TELVILITE 40 H TABLET
Hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How TELVILITE 40 H TABLET Works

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that works by blocking the action of a hormone called angiotensin II, which normally causes blood vessels to constrict (tighten). By inhibiting this hormone, Telmisartan helps to relax and widen blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood and lowering blood pressure, Hydrochlorothiazide is a diuretic (often called a "water pill") that helps reduce the amount of water in the body by increasing urination, which lowers the volume of fluid circulating in the bloodstream. This also helps lower blood pressure.

Together, these two ingredients work to reduce blood pressure effectively, making it easier for the heart to pump blood and reducing the risk of complications related to hypertension, like strokes or heart attacks.

However, the doctor may rarely prescribe it in some life-threatening situations if the benefits are more than the potential risks. Please consult your doctor.

TELVILITE 40 H TABLET is not recommended for use while breastfeeding. Limited human studies indicate that the medication may transfer into breast milk and potentially harm the infant. Please consult your doctor.
Do not drive or operate machines if you experience dizziness or drowsiness.
Consuming alcohol while taking this medication can enhance its blood pressure-lowering effects such as dizziness or fainting. It is advisable to avoid alcohol.

TELVILITE 40 H TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney problems and should be used with caution in patients with other kidney problems (such as kidney transplant, narrowing of renal arteries). Please consult your doctor.

TELVILITE 40 H TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, biliary obstruction) and should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Please consult your doctor.
Do not take TELVILITE 40 H TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan or Hydrochlorothiazide or any other ingredients of this medicine.
TELVILITE 40 H TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart problems (such as irregular heart rhythm, problems with heart muscle or valves). Please consult your doctor before taking it.
TELVILITE 40 H TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age). Consult your pediatrician before giving it.
TELVILITE 40 H TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Dosage adjustment and careful monitoring are required in such patients. Consult and inform your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About TELMISOOR AM TABLET

TELMISOOR AM TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take TELMISOOR AM TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking TELMISOOR AM TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TELMISOOR AM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take TELMISOOR AM TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking TELMISOOR AM TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Hypertension

mechanismOfAction:
How TELMISOOR AM TABLET Works

TELMISOOR AM TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About CILNITAB T 40 TABLET

CILNITAB T 40 TABLET is used in adults to manage essential hypertension (high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, making it easier for the heart to pump blood. By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of serious complications such as heart attacks and strokes.

CILNITAB T 40 TABLET can be taken with or without food, but it is best to take it at the same time each day as directed by your doctor. The dosage will depend on your medical condition and response to the treatment. It is important to continue taking CILNITAB T 40 TABLET even if you feel fine, as it helps lower the risk of long-term complications. For better results, complement the therapy with lifestyle changes such as regular exercise, quitting smoking, and following a low-salt, low-fat diet.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues or are severely dehydrated. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek medical advice before use. Regular monitoring of blood pressure and kidney function may be necessary during treatment to ensure the medication is working effectively.

CILNITAB T 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, advanced aortic stenosis (narrowing of the valve in the large blood vessel branching off the heart (aorta) and primary aldosteronism.

The most common side effects of taking CILNITAB T 40 TABLET are swelling in the ankles or feet (edema), headache, dizziness, sleepiness, fatigue, changes in taste, and stomach upset. Since it may cause dizziness, avoid driving or performing tasks that require focus until you know how it affects you. If side effects persist or cause discomfort, consult your doctor.
uses: It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
usesDetails:
Uses Of CILNITAB T 40 TABLET
It is used to manage essential high blood pressure (hypertension)
mechanismOfAction:
How CILNITAB T 40 TABLET Works

CILNITAB T 40 TABLET contains a combination of two medicines namely, Cilnidipine and Telmisartan respectively.

Cilnidipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by blocking calcium entry into the smooth muscle cells of blood vessels. This action relaxes and widens the blood vessels, reducing resistance to blood flow and thereby lowering blood pressure. Additionally, cilnidipine also acts on the nerves controlling blood vessels, reducing stress-related constriction, which further helps to maintain steady blood pressure levels.
Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB). It inhibits the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict and increases blood pressure. By blocking this effect, telmisartan relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow, effectively lowering blood pressure.

Together, cilnidipine and telmisartan provide a dual mechanism to relax and widen blood vessels, enhancing blood circulation and reducing the risk of heart-related complications like heart attack and stroke.
usageInstructions: Take CILNITAB T 40 TABLET as advised by your physician.
Swallow CILNITAB T 40 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
This medication can be taken with or without food, but it is important to take it at the same time every day to maintain consistent blood levels.
Follow your doctor’s instructions regarding the dose and duration of use based on your health condition.
Do not skip doses or stop taking the medication without consulting your doctor, even if you feel well, as this can lead to a sudden rise in blood pressure.
Regularly monitor your blood pressure to ensure the medication is working effectively.
If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember unless it is close to the time for your next dose; in such cases, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular schedule.

Do not drive or handle any machines if you experience dizziness after taking CILNITAB T 40 TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CILNITAB T 40 TABLET as it may cause low blood pressure while standing up from sitting or lying position (orthostatic hypotension).

CILNITAB T 40 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with chronic renal insufficiency. It should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function, bilateral renal artery stenosis or stenosis of the artery to a single functioning kidney. Consult your doctor before taking it.

CILNITAB T 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment, cholestasis, biliary obstructive disorders. It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver impairment and elevated liver enzymes. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take CILNITAB T 40 TABLET if you are allergic to Telmisartan, Cilnidipine or calcium channel antagonists such as amlodipine, nifedipine.

CILNITAB T 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with advanced aortic stenosis. It should be used with caution in patients with aortic or mitral stenosis, obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, angina, ischaemic cardiopathy or ischaemic cardiovascular disease and congestive heart failure. Consult your doctor before taking it.
CILNITAB T 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.
CILNITAB T 40 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking CILNITAB T 40 TABLET.

Others

CILNITAB T 40 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Primary aldosteronism

Before taking CILNITAB T 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Volume and/or sodium depletion by diuretic therapy, dietary salt restriction, diarrhoea or vomiting
Diabetes
Peripheral edema
Metabolic acidosis, cellular lysis (such as acute limb ischemia, rhabdomyolysis, extended trauma)

introduction:
Introduction About TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET

TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine, Hydrochlorothiazide and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

During management with TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure, electrolyte levels and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid eating grapefruit or drinking grapefruit juice while taking TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET as it may severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea.

TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, muscle cramps and swollen ankles. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

Manage Hypertension (high blood pressure)
mechanismOfAction:
How TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET Works

TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes your blood vessels and improves blood flow across them. It also reduces thickness of the blood by removing excess fluids from the body in the form of urine. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Take TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Try to take TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET at the same time each day. TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET can be taken with or without food.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

Continue to take TRIOLVANCE 40MG TABLET for the stipulated duration instructed by your doctor without any interruption to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About XETEL 50 ER TABLET

XETEL 50 ER TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels which is characterized by symptoms such as severe headache, nose bleeding, fatigue, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

Your doctor might advise you to take kidney function tests (to assess the function of your kidney), monitoring of blood pressure and regular blood tests to check the electrolytes such as potassium levels in the blood. XETEL 50 ER TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with bronchospastic lung diseases such as asthma, emphysema or other lung infections, severe liver problems, impaired kidney function, heart disease such as severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock and planned for non-cardiac surgery.

Before taking XETEL 50 ER TABLET, inform your doctor if you have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands), diabetes, low blood pressure due to dehydration or have undergone kidney transplant surgery. XETEL 50 ER TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. XETEL 50 ER TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The common side effects associated with the use of XETEL 50 ER TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How XETEL 50 ER TABLET Works

XETEL 50 ER TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageDetails:
How to use XETEL 50 ER TABLET

Take XETEL 50 ER TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Try to have the medicine at the same time daily. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of XETEL 50 ER TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About OLMIXTRO AM 40 TABLET

OLMIXTRO AM 40 TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with OLMIXTRO AM 40 TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking OLMIXTRO AM 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. OLMIXTRO AM 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. How OLMIXTRO AM 40 TABLET Works

OLMIXTRO AM 40 TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking the medicine, inform your doctor if you are taking any of these medicines:

Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors (Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, ramipril) or aliskiren
Potassium-containing medicines (Ex. potassium supplements, salt substitutes containing potassium (Ex. losartan potassium)
Diuretics (Ex. spironolactone)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, aspirin, diclofenac)
Antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide or magnesium hydroxide)
Bile acid sequestrants (Ex. colesevelam, simvastatin)
Anti-viral agents (Ex. ritonavir, nelfinavir, or indinavir)
Antifungal agents (Ex. ketoconazole or itraconazole)
Immunosuppressants (Ex. tacrolimus, sirolimus, temsirolimus, everolimus, and cyclosporin)
Anticoagulants (Ex. heparin)
Anti-manic agents (Ex. Lithium)
Calcium-channel blockers (Ex. Diltiazem, Verapamil)
Antibiotics (Ex. Rifampicin, Erythromycin or Clarithromycin)
St. John’s wort
Skeletal muscle relaxants (Ex. Dantrolene)

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Avoid eating grapefruit or consuming grapefruit juice while taking OLMIXTRO AM 40 TABLET, as it could lead to an increase in the levels of amlodipine in the blood, which may lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure.

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of OLMIXTRO AM 40 TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital right away. Overdosage symptoms include low blood pressure, dizziness, and a fast or slow heartbeat.

Introduction About TELQUE AMH 40 TABLET

TELQUE AMH 40 TABLET is a triple-combination oral formulation containing Telmisartan (40mg), Amlodipine (5mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5mg). It is generally prescribed for managing blood pressure in individuals who may benefit from the complementary actions of these three ingredients. This combination works by supporting fluid balance, easing vascular tension, and encouraging optimal blood flow.

TELQUE AMH 40 TABLET can be taken with or without food. Your dosage will depend on your medical condition and how you respond to management. Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in your body. It is important to continue taking this medication until your doctor advises otherwise. Since this medicine contains a diuretic (water pill), it increases urination. To avoid disturbing your sleep, it’s best not to take it within four hours of bedtime. For best results, use this medication regularly, even if you feel fine. High blood pressure often has no symptoms, but stopping the medicine suddenly can raise your risk of heart attack or stroke.

The most common side effects of this medicine include headache, dizziness, tiredness, taste change, fatigue, flu-like symptoms, diarrhea, and sinusitis. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms bother you, worsen, or persist. Be sure to drink plenty of fluids while taking the medication to help manage muscle weakness, dry mouth, and excessive thirst.

TELQUE AMH 40 TABLET is generally advised for individuals who have experienced suboptimal outcomes with monotherapy or dual therapy, require effective management of both systolic and diastolic blood pressure, and benefit from a simplified, once-daily combination formulation to enhance adherence and management outcomes.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek their doctor's advice before taking this medicine. Additionally, make sure to tell your doctor about any other medications you are currently taking, particularly those for high blood pressure or heart conditions. Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolyte levels, and blood sugar is recommended to ensure the medication is working effectively.

How TELQUE AMH 40 TABLET Works

The tablet combines three different classes of ingredients that support cardiovascular goals by addressing multiple factors in blood pressure regulation. Each component has a distinct mechanism:

Understanding the Role of Telmisartan:

Telmisartan is part of the ARB (angiotensin receptor blocker) family. It supports relaxation of blood vessels by limiting the effects of specific hormones that cause narrowing.

What Amlodipine Contributes:

Amlodipine is a calcium channel regulator that allows smoother blood flow by acting on the muscle walls of the arteries.

Hydrochlorothiazide and Fluid Regulation:

This diuretic component helps eliminate excess salt and fluid from the body, aiding in pressure balance without compromising volume control.

Why This Triple Mechanism Matters:

When used together under professional guidance, this combination may be helpful for individuals requiring multi-pronged support in managing their cardiovascular profile.

moreInfo:
More Information
A. Why TELQUE AMH 40 TABLET Preferred Choice Over Other Antihypertensive Medications?

TELQUE AMH 40 TABLET is a fixed-dose combination therapy used to manage high blood pressure effectively. It combines three well-established antihypertensive agents such as Telmisartan (40 mg), Amlodipine (5 mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5 mg) in a single tablet. This formulation offers multiple advantages over monotherapy or dual therapy options.

1. Triple-Drug Combination for Comprehensive Control

Mechanism: Targets different physiological pathways—vasodilation, fluid elimination, and renin-angiotensin system blockade.
Benefit: Enhances efficacy in patients with moderate to severe hypertension or those not controlled with monotherapy.

2. Improved Patient Compliance

Formulation: Single daily dose.
Benefit: Reduces pill burden, increases adherence, and simplifies treatment plans.

3. 24-Hour Blood Pressure Control

Pharmacokinetics: Long-acting agents ensure stable blood pressure throughout the day and night.
Benefit: Reduces early morning surges and associated cardiovascular risks.

4. Organ Protection

Telmisartan: Offers proven cardiovascular and renal protective effects, particularly in patients with:
Type 2 diabetes
Chronic kidney disease
Left ventricular hypertrophy

5. Lower Incidence of Side Effects

Balanced Dosing: Moderate doses of each component reduce the likelihood of dose-dependent side effects.
Electrolyte Stability: Telmisartan may counteract the potassium-lowering effects of hydrochlorothiazide.

6. Reduced Need for Additional Medications

Clinical Outcome: Many patients achieve target BP goals with this single tablet.
Benefit: Cost-effective and reduces complexity of management.

7. Evidence-Based Components

Each drug is individually supported by strong clinical evidence for blood pressure reduction and cardiovascular risk mitigation.

Conclusion

TELQUE AMH 40 TABLET is an effective, convenient, and well-tolerated option for managing hypertension, especially in patients requiring multi-drug therapy. It enhances blood pressure control, offers organ protection, and promotes management adherence, making it a preferred option under medical guidance.

Introduction About TELGARD M 25 TABLET

TELGARD M 25 TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensives. It is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels which is characterized by symptoms such as severe headache, nose bleeding, fatigue, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

Your doctor might advise you to take kidney function tests (to assess the function of your kidney), monitoring of blood pressure and regular blood tests to check the electrolytes such as potassium levels in the blood. TELGARD M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with bronchospastic lung diseases such as asthma, emphysema or other lung infections, severe liver problems, impaired kidney function, heart disease such as severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock and planned for non-cardiac surgery.

Before taking TELGARD M 25 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands), diabetes, low blood pressure due to dehydration or have undergone kidney transplant surgery. TELGARD M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. TELGARD M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). The common side effects associated with the use of TELGARD M 25 TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat or rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELGARD M 25 TABLET.
TELGARD M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Consult your doctor before taking TELGARD M 25 TABLET.

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)

Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

faqs.question: Q: What is TELGARD M 25 TABLET used for?
faqs.answer: A: TELGARD M 25 TABLET is used to manage hypertension. Hypertension is an abnormal condition in which blood pressure rises higher than normal limits in the blood vessels. It is characterized by severe headache, nose bleeding, weakness, disturbed vision, chest pain and shortness of breath.

faqs.question: Q: What happens if you take more TELGARD M 25 TABLET than your required dose?
faqs.answer: A: If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of TELGARD M 25 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are low blood pressure, fast or slow heartbeat, dizziness, heart block, heart failure, bronchospasm (constriction of lung muscles), hypoxia (lack of oxygen supply to body cells), higher levels of creatinine in the blood, sudden kidney failure, impairment of consciousness or nausea, vomiting and coma.

faqs.question: Q: What side effects are seen with TELGARD M 25 TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The common side effects associated with the use of TELGARD M 25 TABLET are low blood pressure, tiredness, dizziness, depression, diarrhoea, shortness of breath, slow heartbeat and rash. Consult your doctor if any of the side effect worsens.

faqs.question: Q: Who should avoid taking TELGARD M 25 TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: TELGARD M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are having asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease, lung infections, cholestasis or biliary obstruction, impaired kidney function, severely low heart rate, heart block, cardiogenic shock, decompensated cardiac failure or sick sinus syndrome. It is also not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women, children and adolescents (aged below18 years). Consult your doctor before taking TELGARD M 25 TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: Is TELGARD M 25 TABLET safe to use in children?
faqs.answer: A: TELGARD M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). If TELGARD M 25 TABLET is accidentally ingested by a child or adolescent, go to the hospital immediately and consult the doctor for further management.

faqs.question: Q: Can I drink alcohol while taking TELGARD M 25 TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELGARD M 25 TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure. However, if you are habitual of drinking alcohol, you must consult your doctor before taking this medicine.

faqs.answer: A: TELGARD M 25 TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. introduction:
Introduction About AMLOPRES TL 80MG TABLET

AMLOPRES TL 80MG TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take AMLOPRES TL 80MG TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking AMLOPRES TL 80MG TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking AMLOPRES TL 80MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take AMLOPRES TL 80MG TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking AMLOPRES TL 80MG TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOPRES TL 80MG TABLET Works

AMLOPRES TL 80MG TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

name: TELINOR AMH Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About TELINOR AMH TABLET

TELINOR AMH TABLET is a triple-combination oral formulation containing Telmisartan (40mg), Amlodipine (5mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5mg). It is generally prescribed for managing blood pressure in individuals who may benefit from the complementary actions of these three ingredients. This combination works by supporting fluid balance, easing vascular tension, and encouraging optimal blood flow.

TELINOR AMH TABLET can be taken with or without food. Your dosage will depend on your medical condition and how you respond to management. Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in your body. It is important to continue taking this medication until your doctor advises otherwise. Since this medicine contains a diuretic (water pill), it increases urination. To avoid disturbing your sleep, it’s best not to take it within four hours of bedtime. For best results, use this medication regularly, even if you feel fine. High blood pressure often has no symptoms, but stopping the medicine suddenly can raise your risk of heart attack or stroke.

The most common side effects of this medicine include headache, dizziness, tiredness, taste change, fatigue, flu-like symptoms, diarrhea, and sinusitis. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms bother you, worsen, or persist. Be sure to drink plenty of fluids while taking the medication to help manage muscle weakness, dry mouth, and excessive thirst.

TELINOR AMH TABLET is generally advised for individuals who have experienced suboptimal outcomes with monotherapy or dual therapy, require effective management of both systolic and diastolic blood pressure, and benefit from a simplified, once-daily combination formulation to enhance adherence and management outcomes.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek their doctor's advice before taking this medicine. Additionally, make sure to tell your doctor about any other medications you are currently taking, particularly those for high blood pressure or heart conditions. Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolyte levels, and blood sugar is recommended to ensure the medication is working effectively.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELINOR AMH TABLET Works

The tablet combines three different classes of ingredients that support cardiovascular goals by addressing multiple factors in blood pressure regulation. Each component has a distinct mechanism:

Understanding the Role of Telmisartan:

Telmisartan is part of the ARB (angiotensin receptor blocker) family. It supports relaxation of blood vessels by limiting the effects of specific hormones that cause narrowing.

What Amlodipine Contributes:

Amlodipine is a calcium channel regulator that allows smoother blood flow by acting on the muscle walls of the arteries.

Hydrochlorothiazide and Fluid Regulation:

This diuretic component helps eliminate excess salt and fluid from the body, aiding in pressure balance without compromising volume control.

Why This Triple Mechanism Matters:

When used together under professional guidance, this combination may be helpful for individuals requiring multi-pronged support in managing their cardiovascular profile.

Headache

Heart problems symptoms such as palpitations, dizziness, fainting

warnings.details: TELINOR AMH TABLET is not recommended during pregnancy, especially in the second and third trimesters, as it may harm the developing fetus by reducing blood flow and kidney function. Always consult your doctor before taking this medicine if you are pregnant or planning to become pregnant.
It is unknown whether TELINOR AMH TABLET passes into breast milk. Due to the potential risk to the infant, Consult your doctor before breastfeeding while taking this medication.
TELINOR AMH TABLET may cause dizziness, tiredness, or visual disturbances. If affected, avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you know how the medication affects you.
Avoid drinking alcohol while taking TELINOR AMH TABLET, as it may enhance the blood pressure-lowering effects, leading to increased dizziness or risk of fainting.

TELINOR AMH TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment or electrolyte imbalances. Regular kidney function tests are recommended during management. Consult your doctor before use.

TELINOR AMH TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease, particularly due to the presence of telmisartan and amlodipine, which are processed by the liver. Dose adjustments may be necessary. Consult your doctor before use.

Do not take TELINOR AMH TABLET if you are allergic to telmisartan or amlodipine or hydrochlorothiazide or any other component of the medicine. Seek immediate medical attention if you experience symptoms of an allergic reaction.
There are no specific warnings related to lung function. However, if you experience shortness of breath or wheezing, seek medical attention immediately.
TELINOR AMH TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe aortic stenosis, congestive heart failure, or recent heart attack. Consult your doctor before use.
TELINOR AMH TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age due to limited safety and efficacy data. Consult your pediatrician before giving it.
TELINOR AMH TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

USE WITH CAUTION

CONTRAINDICATED

Do not take TELINOR AMH TABLET if you are allergic to telmisartan or amlodipine or hydrochlorothiazide or any other component of the medicine. Seek immediate medical attention if you experience symptoms of an allergic reaction.

CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

There are no specific warnings related to lung function. However, if you experience shortness of breath or wheezing, seek medical attention immediately.

USE WITH CAUTION

CONTRAINDICATED

TELINOR AMH TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age due to limited safety and efficacy data. Consult your pediatrician before giving it.

USE WITH CAUTION

TELINOR AMH TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

More Information
A. Why TELINOR AMH TABLET Preferred Choice Over Other Antihypertensive Medications?

TELINOR AMH TABLET is a fixed-dose combination therapy used to manage high blood pressure effectively. It combines three well-established antihypertensive agents such as Telmisartan (40 mg), Amlodipine (5 mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5 mg) in a single tablet. This formulation offers multiple advantages over monotherapy or dual therapy options.

1. Triple-Drug Combination for Comprehensive Control

Mechanism: Targets different physiological pathways—vasodilation, fluid elimination, and renin-angiotensin system blockade.
Benefit: Enhances efficacy in patients with moderate to severe hypertension or those not controlled with monotherapy.

2. Improved Patient Compliance

Formulation: Single daily dose.
Benefit: Reduces pill burden, increases adherence, and simplifies treatment plans.

3. 24-Hour Blood Pressure Control

Pharmacokinetics: Long-acting agents ensure stable blood pressure throughout the day and night.
Benefit: Reduces early morning surges and associated cardiovascular risks.

4. Organ Protection

Telmisartan: Offers proven cardiovascular and renal protective effects, particularly in patients with:
Type 2 diabetes
Chronic kidney disease
Left ventricular hypertrophy

5. Lower Incidence of Side Effects

Balanced Dosing: Moderate doses of each component reduce the likelihood of dose-dependent side effects.
Electrolyte Stability: Telmisartan may counteract the potassium-lowering effects of hydrochlorothiazide.

6. Reduced Need for Additional Medications

Clinical Outcome: Many patients achieve target BP goals with this single tablet.
Benefit: Cost-effective and reduces complexity of management.

7. Evidence-Based Components

Each drug is individually supported by strong clinical evidence for blood pressure reduction and cardiovascular risk mitigation.

Conclusion

TELINOR AMH TABLET is an effective, convenient, and well-tolerated option for managing hypertension, especially in patients requiring multi-drug therapy. It enhances blood pressure control, offers organ protection, and promotes management adherence, making it a preferred option under medical guidance.

What is TELISMART AM TABLET Tablet?

TELISMART AM TABLET is a prescription medicine used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension). It contains Telmisartan (40mg) and Amlodipine (5mg), which help to relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.

TELISMART AM TABLET helps to controls high blood pressure, reduces the risk of heart-related complications and improves blood circulation.

Take one TELISMART AM TABLET daily with or without food, as directed by your doctor. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.

Avoid alcohol while taking TELISMART AM TABLET. Inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease.

The most common side effects of taking TELISMART AM TABLET are dizziness, swelling in ankles or feet, headache or fatigue. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELISMART AM TABLET Works

1. Telmisartan (Angiotensin II Receptor Blocker - ARB):

Blocks Angiotensin II, a hormone that narrows blood vessels and increases blood pressure
When blocked, blood vessels stay relaxed and open, lowering blood pressure

2. Amlodipine (Calcium Channel Blocker - CCB):

Inhibits calcium from entering blood vessel muscles, stopping them from tightening
This helps blood vessels remain wide, allowing better blood flow and reducing pressure
Who should take TELISMART AM TABLET?
Patients with hypertension – helps control blood pressure and reduces complications
Individuals with Heart disease – reduces the risk of heart attack, stroke, and heart failure
People with poor blood circulation – helps widen blood vessels and improve oxygen flow

High Risk Group - Why It is risky?

Pregnant women

	

Telmisartan can harm the unborn baby, cause low amniotic fluid, and lead to birth defects. Avoid use, especially in the second and third trimester




Breastfeeding mothers

	

The medication may pass into breast milk, potentially affecting the baby’s blood pressure and kidney function. Consult a doctor before use.




Individuals with Low blood pressure (hypotension)

	

TELISMART AM TABLET lowers blood pressure, which can cause dizziness, fainting, or shock in people with already low BP




Kidney Disease Patients

	

Telmisartan affects kidney function, and Amlodipine may cause fluid retention, worsening kidney disease




Severe Heart Failure Patients

	

Can lead to excessive BP drop, irregular heartbeat, or worsened heart failure symptoms




Liver Disease Patients

	

The drug is metabolized in the liver, and damaged liver function can lead to toxic buildup




High Potassium (Hyperkalemia) Patients

	

Telmisartan can increase potassium levels, leading to dangerous heart rhythm problems




Patients on Certain Medications

	

Avoid if taking NSAIDs, lithium, diuretics, or other BP meds, as they may interact and cause severe side effects

introduction:
Introduction About OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET

OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET is a combination of Metoprolol and Olmesartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). It can also be used to reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction), stroke, chest pain (angina) and uneven heartbeat (arrhythmia).

Before taking OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, thyroid problems, asthma, poor blood circulation, psoriasis, allergic reactions or gout as a precaution.

OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe low blood pressure, uncontrollable heart failure or heart block. It is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are low blood pressure, slow or fast heart rate, cold hands and feet, headache, dizziness, nausea, diarrhoea, constipation, sore throat, cough, high blood cholesterol levels and swollen ankles. Consult your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

How OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET Works

OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET is an antihypertensive medicine. It relaxes the blood vessels supplying the heart and various other organs of the body. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. It also reduces the heart rate and force of contraction of heart muscles. Collectively, these actions reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump more blood with less pressure.
