Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET as it might make you feel dizzier and drowsier.
OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems (such as kidney transplant, narrowing of renal arteries). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver impairment (such as cholestasis, jaundice, biliary obstruction). It should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET if you are allergic to Metoprolol or Olmesartan.
OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe asthma or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Therefore, consult your doctor for advice before taking it.

OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe heart problems (such as heart block, uncontrollable heart failure, sick sinus syndrome or a very slow or uneven heartbeat). It should be used with caution in patients with other heart problems (such as a recent heart attack, or angina attack, irregular heart rhythm, enlarged heart muscles, or surgery in the heart within the last 4 months). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are in shock caused due to poor blood circulation
Have poor blood circulation caused due to blockage in the blood vessels
Have a very low blood pressure
Have metabolic acidosis (too much acidity in blood)
Have unmanageed phaeochromocytoma (tumor present in adrenal glands)
Have diabetes related kidney problems

Before taking OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have diabetes
Are prone to allergic reactions very often (such as even for insect bites)
Have thyrotoxicosis (increased thyroid hormones in the body)
Have problems in blood circulation around the body (especially in fingers, arms and feet)
Have psoriasis (white scaly patches on the skin)
Are going to undergo an operation
Have primary hyperaldosteronism (problems in adrenal gland)
Are severely dehydrated (due to diarrhea, vomiting or excess sweating)
Have hyperkalemia (high blood potassium levels)

Use in pediatrics:

OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Therefore, consult your doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

OLMEVAC M 40/50 TABLET should be used with caution in the elderly patients. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET

TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

mechanismOfAction:
How TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET Works

TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageInstructions: The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET.

TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET.
TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET.

TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET.

TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET.

TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET.

Others

TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking TETAN BETA 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

TELTAS M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELTAS M 50 TABLET.

Liver
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

TELTAS M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TELTAS M 50 TABLET.

Allergy
CONTRAINDICATED

TELTAS M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

Lungs
USE WITH CAUTION

TELTAS M 50 TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking TELTAS M 50 TABLET.

Heart Disease
CONSULT YOUR DOCTOR

TELTAS M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELTAS M 50 TABLET.

Use In Pediatrics
CONTRAINDICATED

TELTAS M 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking TELTAS M 50 TABLET.

Use In Geriatrics
USE WITH CAUTION

TELTAS M 50 TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking TELTAS M 50 TABLET.

Others

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About NUMLO TMH TABLET

NUMLO TMH TABLET is a triple-combination oral formulation containing Telmisartan (40mg), Amlodipine (5mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5mg). It is generally prescribed for managing blood pressure in individuals who may benefit from the complementary actions of these three ingredients. This combination works by supporting fluid balance, easing vascular tension, and encouraging optimal blood flow.

NUMLO TMH TABLET can be taken with or without food. Your dosage will depend on your medical condition and how you respond to management. Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in your body. It is important to continue taking this medication until your doctor advises otherwise. Since this medicine contains a diuretic (water pill), it increases urination. To avoid disturbing your sleep, it’s best not to take it within four hours of bedtime. For best results, use this medication regularly, even if you feel fine. High blood pressure often has no symptoms, but stopping the medicine suddenly can raise your risk of heart attack or stroke.

The most common side effects of this medicine include headache, dizziness, tiredness, taste change, fatigue, flu-like symptoms, diarrhea, and sinusitis. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms bother you, worsen, or persist. Be sure to drink plenty of fluids while taking the medication to help manage muscle weakness, dry mouth, and excessive thirst.

NUMLO TMH TABLET is generally advised for individuals who have experienced suboptimal outcomes with monotherapy or dual therapy, require effective management of both systolic and diastolic blood pressure, and benefit from a simplified, once-daily combination formulation to enhance adherence and management outcomes.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek their doctor's advice before taking this medicine. Additionally, make sure to tell your doctor about any other medications you are currently taking, particularly those for high blood pressure or heart conditions. Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolyte levels, and blood sugar is recommended to ensure the medication is working effectively.

How NUMLO TMH TABLET Works

The tablet combines three different classes of ingredients that support cardiovascular goals by addressing multiple factors in blood pressure regulation. Each component has a distinct mechanism:

Understanding the Role of Telmisartan:

Telmisartan is part of the ARB (angiotensin receptor blocker) family. It supports relaxation of blood vessels by limiting the effects of specific hormones that cause narrowing.

What Amlodipine Contributes:

Amlodipine is a calcium channel regulator that allows smoother blood flow by acting on the muscle walls of the arteries.

Hydrochlorothiazide and Fluid Regulation:

This diuretic component helps eliminate excess salt and fluid from the body, aiding in pressure balance without compromising volume control.

Why This Triple Mechanism Matters:

When used together under professional guidance, this combination may be helpful for individuals requiring multi-pronged support in managing their cardiovascular profile.

NUMLO TMH TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease, particularly due to the presence of telmisartan and amlodipine, which are processed by the liver. Dose adjustments may be necessary. Consult your doctor before use.

There are no specific warnings related to lung function. However, if you experience shortness of breath or wheezing, seek medical attention immediately.
NUMLO TMH TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe aortic stenosis, congestive heart failure, or recent heart attack. Consult your doctor before use.
NUMLO TMH TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age due to limited safety and efficacy data. Consult your pediatrician before giving it.

More Information
A. Why NUMLO TMH TABLET Preferred Choice Over Other Antihypertensive Medications?

NUMLO TMH TABLET is a fixed-dose combination therapy used to manage high blood pressure effectively. It combines three well-established antihypertensive agents such as Telmisartan (40 mg), Amlodipine (5 mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5 mg) in a single tablet. This formulation offers multiple advantages over monotherapy or dual therapy options.

1. Triple-Drug Combination for Comprehensive Control

Mechanism: Targets different physiological pathways—vasodilation, fluid elimination, and renin-angiotensin system blockade.
Benefit: Enhances efficacy in patients with moderate to severe hypertension or those not controlled with monotherapy.

2. Improved Patient Compliance

Formulation: Single daily dose.
Benefit: Reduces pill burden, increases adherence, and simplifies treatment plans.

3. 24-Hour Blood Pressure Control

Pharmacokinetics: Long-acting agents ensure stable blood pressure throughout the day and night.
Benefit: Reduces early morning surges and associated cardiovascular risks.

4. Organ Protection

Telmisartan: Offers proven cardiovascular and renal protective effects, particularly in patients with:
Type 2 diabetes
Chronic kidney disease
Left ventricular hypertrophy

5. Lower Incidence of Side Effects

Balanced Dosing: Moderate doses of each component reduce the likelihood of dose-dependent side effects.
Electrolyte Stability: Telmisartan may counteract the potassium-lowering effects of hydrochlorothiazide.

6. Reduced Need for Additional Medications

Clinical Outcome: Many patients achieve target BP goals with this single tablet.
Benefit: Cost-effective and reduces complexity of management.

7. Evidence-Based Components

Each drug is individually supported by strong clinical evidence for blood pressure reduction and cardiovascular risk mitigation.

Conclusion

NUMLO TMH TABLET is an effective, convenient, and well-tolerated option for managing hypertension, especially in patients requiring multi-drug therapy. It enhances blood pressure control, offers organ protection, and promotes management adherence, making it a preferred option under medical guidance.

introduction:
Introduction About TELSART AM TABLET

TELSART AM TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take TELSART AM TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking TELSART AM TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TELSART AM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take TELSART AM TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking TELSART AM TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELSART AM TABLET Works

TELSART AM TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

Introduction About PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET

It is recommended to take PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.

Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET.

PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET.
PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET.

PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET.

PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET.

PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET.

Others

PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking PROLOVAS T 25MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About ONTEL AMH TABLET

ONTEL AMH TABLET is a triple-combination oral formulation containing Telmisartan (40mg), Amlodipine (5mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5mg). It is generally prescribed for managing blood pressure in individuals who may benefit from the complementary actions of these three ingredients. This combination works by supporting fluid balance, easing vascular tension, and encouraging optimal blood flow.

ONTEL AMH TABLET can be taken with or without food. Your dosage will depend on your medical condition and how you respond to management. Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in your body. It is important to continue taking this medication until your doctor advises otherwise. Since this medicine contains a diuretic (water pill), it increases urination. To avoid disturbing your sleep, it’s best not to take it within four hours of bedtime. For best results, use this medication regularly, even if you feel fine. High blood pressure often has no symptoms, but stopping the medicine suddenly can raise your risk of heart attack or stroke.

The most common side effects of this medicine include headache, dizziness, tiredness, taste change, fatigue, flu-like symptoms, diarrhea, and sinusitis. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms bother you, worsen, or persist. Be sure to drink plenty of fluids while taking the medication to help manage muscle weakness, dry mouth, and excessive thirst.

ONTEL AMH TABLET is generally advised for individuals who have experienced suboptimal outcomes with monotherapy or dual therapy, require effective management of both systolic and diastolic blood pressure, and benefit from a simplified, once-daily combination formulation to enhance adherence and management outcomes.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek their doctor's advice before taking this medicine. Additionally, make sure to tell your doctor about any other medications you are currently taking, particularly those for high blood pressure or heart conditions. Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolyte levels, and blood sugar is recommended to ensure the medication is working effectively.

How ONTEL AMH TABLET Works

The tablet combines three different classes of ingredients that support cardiovascular goals by addressing multiple factors in blood pressure regulation. Each component has a distinct mechanism:

Understanding the Role of Telmisartan:

Telmisartan is part of the ARB (angiotensin receptor blocker) family. It supports relaxation of blood vessels by limiting the effects of specific hormones that cause narrowing.

What Amlodipine Contributes:

Amlodipine is a calcium channel regulator that allows smoother blood flow by acting on the muscle walls of the arteries.

Hydrochlorothiazide and Fluid Regulation:

This diuretic component helps eliminate excess salt and fluid from the body, aiding in pressure balance without compromising volume control.

Why This Triple Mechanism Matters:

When used together under professional guidance, this combination may be helpful for individuals requiring multi-pronged support in managing their cardiovascular profile.

More Information
A. Why ONTEL AMH TABLET Preferred Choice Over Other Antihypertensive Medications?

ONTEL AMH TABLET is a fixed-dose combination therapy used to manage high blood pressure effectively. It combines three well-established antihypertensive agents such as Telmisartan (40 mg), Amlodipine (5 mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5 mg) in a single tablet. This formulation offers multiple advantages over monotherapy or dual therapy options.

1. Triple-Drug Combination for Comprehensive Control

Mechanism: Targets different physiological pathways—vasodilation, fluid elimination, and renin-angiotensin system blockade.
Benefit: Enhances efficacy in patients with moderate to severe hypertension or those not controlled with monotherapy.

2. Improved Patient Compliance

Formulation: Single daily dose.
Benefit: Reduces pill burden, increases adherence, and simplifies treatment plans.

3. 24-Hour Blood Pressure Control

Pharmacokinetics: Long-acting agents ensure stable blood pressure throughout the day and night.
Benefit: Reduces early morning surges and associated cardiovascular risks.

4. Organ Protection

Telmisartan: Offers proven cardiovascular and renal protective effects, particularly in patients with:
Type 2 diabetes
Chronic kidney disease
Left ventricular hypertrophy

5. Lower Incidence of Side Effects

Balanced Dosing: Moderate doses of each component reduce the likelihood of dose-dependent side effects.
Electrolyte Stability: Telmisartan may counteract the potassium-lowering effects of hydrochlorothiazide.

6. Reduced Need for Additional Medications

Clinical Outcome: Many patients achieve target BP goals with this single tablet.
Benefit: Cost-effective and reduces complexity of management.

7. Evidence-Based Components

Each drug is individually supported by strong clinical evidence for blood pressure reduction and cardiovascular risk mitigation.

Conclusion

ONTEL AMH TABLET is an effective, convenient, and well-tolerated option for managing hypertension, especially in patients requiring multi-drug therapy. It enhances blood pressure control, offers organ protection, and promotes management adherence, making it a preferred option under medical guidance.

introduction:
Introduction About AZOVAS T 80 TABLET

AZOVAS T 80 TABLET is a combination of Azelnidipine and Telmisartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents. It is used in adults to manage stage II hypertension (high blood pressure) when management with single agents is not effective.

Hypertension (also known as high blood pressure) is a medical condition in which the force of the blood exerted against the walls of the artery remains very high, and as a result it may lead to severe damage to the blood vessels supplying several vital organs, such as heart, kidney, or brain. If left unmanageed, it may cause serious complications such as heart attack, heart failure, stroke or even blindness.

By lowering blood pressure, AZOVAS T 80 TABLET can also reduce the risk of heart attack (myocardial infarction) and stroke. During management with AZOVAS T 80 TABLET your doctor will constantly monitor your kidney functions, blood pressure and blood sugar levels to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects.

Before taking AZOVAS T 80 TABLET inform your doctor if you have any heart, liver, or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have diabetes, low blood pressure or are severely dehydrated due to excessive vomiting or diarrhea. Avoid taking grapefruit juice while taking this medicine as it may reduce the risk of side effects.

AZOVAS T 80 TABLET is also not suitable for use in pregnant or breastfeeding women as it may cause serious harm to the growing baby. Stop taking AZOVAS T 80 TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you become pregnant while undergoing therapy with AZOVAS T 80 TABLET.

The most common side effects of taking AZOVAS T 80 TABLET are low blood pressure, dizziness, tiredness, headache, sleepiness, swollen ankles, and flushing. Contact your doctor if any of these side effect worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How AZOVAS T 80 TABLET Works

AZOVAS T 80 TABLET effectively controls blood pressure in patients with hypertension. It contains two medicines namely, Azelnidipine and telmisartan. Telmisartan blocks the actions of certain hormones (angiotensin-II) in the body that causes narrowing of blood vessels and increase in blood pressure.

Azelnidipine is a vasodilator. It relaxes the blood vessels by blocking the entry of certain ions (calcium ions) within them that causes narrowing. This allows blood to flow more smoothly across the blood vessels. Collectively, they reduce the strain on the heart and helps the heart to pump blood more smoothly with less pressure.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition. Do not stop taking AZOVAS T 80 TABLET without consulting your doctor.

introduction:
Introduction About VALSAC 200 TABLET

VALSAC 200 TABLET is a combination of Sacubitril and Valsartan which belongs to the group of medicines called Angiotensin receptor neprilysin inhibitors. VALSAC 200 TABLET is indicated to reduce the risk of cardiovascular death and hospitalization for heart failure in patients with chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association Class II-IV) and reduced ejection fraction.  

Heart failure occurs when the heart is weak and cannot pump enough blood to the lungs and to the rest of the body and it is characterized by symptoms such as breathlessness, fatigue, tiredness and ankle swelling. Before taking VALSAC 200 TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney or heart problems. VALSAC 200 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breast-feeding women. It is not suitable for use in children and adolescents under 18 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (65 years of age and above).    

Before taking VALSAC 200 TABLET inform your doctor about previous allergy and medication history to manage any serious effect. The most common side effects of taking VALSAC 200 TABLET are dizziness, cough, headache, tiredness, nausea and weakness. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How VALSAC 200 TABLET Works

VALSAC 200 TABLET helps to manage long-term heart failure, where sacubitril works by relaxing and widening the blood vessels and makes it easier for the heart to pump blood throughout the body and valsartan works by relaxing the blood vessels by blocking a substance called angiotensin-II (causing blood vessels to tighten) which is produced in the body and thus lowers the blood pressure.

Take VALSAC 200 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow VALSAC 200 TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: BISOWEL AM Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BISOWEL AM TABLET

BISOWEL AM TABLET is a prescription medicine used to effectively manage high blood pressure (hypertension) and chest pain (angina). It is a dual-combination therapy that contains Bisoprolol (a beta-blocker) and Amlodipine (a calcium channel blocker). Together, these ingredients help relax and widen the blood vessels, improve blood flow, reduce heart rate, and lower the workload on the heart. This helps in maintaining optimal blood pressure levels and reducing the risk of complications like heart attacks or strokes in patients with cardiovascular risk.

Caution is advised before using BISOWEL AM TABLET in specific groups. It is not recommended during pregnancy and breastfeeding, unless clearly advised by the doctor. Patients with liver or kidney impairment, lung conditions such as asthma or COPD, or diabetes should use this medicine only under strict medical supervision. It may mask symptoms of low blood sugar or worsen breathing problems in some patients. Regular monitoring of blood sugar, heart rate, and blood pressure is essential during treatment.

Take BISOWEL AM TABLET once daily, preferably at the same time each day, with or without food, as prescribed by your doctor. Do not stop the medication abruptly without consulting your doctor, as it may worsen the condition. Common side effects may include dizziness, tiredness, swelling in the ankles or feet, slow heart rate, and cold hands or feet. Always follow your doctor’s instructions and inform them about any ongoing medications to avoid potential drug-drug or drug-food interactions.
uses: Hypertension and its associated heart complications
usesDetails:
Uses Of BISOWEL AM TABLET
Hypertension and its associated heart complications
mechanismOfAction:
How BISOWEL AM TABLET Works

BISOWEL AM TABLET works through a dual mechanism to manage high blood pressure and chest pain.

It contains Bisoprolol, a beta-blocker that slows down the heart rate and reduces the force of each heartbeat, and Amlodipine, a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels and improves blood flow.

Together, they lower blood pressure, reduce the heart’s workload, and enhance oxygen delivery to the heart muscles — making it highly effective for heart patients.

How BISOWEL AM TABLET Works for Blood Pressure?

BISOWEL AM TABLET is highly effective in controlling blood pressure. Amlodipine dilates blood vessels, making it easier for blood to flow, while Bisoprolol slows the heart rate and decreases the heart’s pumping force. This combination results in smoother blood circulation and reduced pressure in the arteries, helping to keep blood pressure levels within a healthy range throughout the day.

How BISOWEL AM TABLET Helps in Chest Pain (Angina)?

BISOWEL AM TABLET helps relieve chest pain (angina) by reducing the oxygen demand of the heart. Bisoprolol limits how hard the heart has to work, and Amlodipine enhances blood supply to the heart muscle by widening arteries. This dual action prevents angina attacks during stress or physical exertion and helps patients stay active without discomfort.

How BISOWEL AM TABLET Works for Heart Patients?

For heart patients dealing with hypertension and angina, BISOWEL AM TABLET offers comprehensive support. It reduces strain on the heart, lowers blood pressure, and increases blood flow significantly lowering the risk of heart attacks, strokes, and other heart-related complications. It is especially beneficial for patients who require dual therapy in a single tablet to improve treatment adherence and outcomes.
usageInstructions: Take BISOWEL AM TABLET exactly as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow it whole with a glass of water — do not crush or chew the tablet.
It can be taken with or without food, but try to take it at the same time each day for consistent blood pressure control.
The best time to take BISOWEL AM TABLET is in the morning, preferably after breakfast.
Taking it early helps manage blood pressure during the day and reduces the chance of dizziness or fatigue at night.
However, always follow your doctor’s specific recommendation.
The usual starting dose for managing high blood pressure is one BISOWEL AM TABLET once daily.
Depending on your blood pressure response, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Never self-adjust your dosage without consulting a doctor.
For adults with hypertension or angina, the recommended dose is typically 5mg once daily.
The dose may be increased or decreased based on your medical condition, response to treatment, and tolerability.

Dosage of BISOWEL AM TABLET for Hypertension
The usual starting dose for managing high blood pressure is one BISOWEL AM TABLET once daily.
Depending on your blood pressure response, your doctor may adjust the dose.
Never self-adjust your dosage without consulting a doctor.
BISOWEL AM TABLET Dosage for Adults
For adults with hypertension or angina, the recommended dose is typically 5mg once daily.
The dose may be increased or decreased based on your medical condition, response to treatment, and tolerability.
Dosage Adjustments in Kidney or Liver Condition

Patients with mild to moderate kidney or liver impairment may require dose adjustments.

In such cases, the doctor will assess your condition and may prescribe a lower dose or increase monitoring frequency.

BISOWEL AM TABLET should be used cautiously in severe impairment.

BISOWEL AM TABLET Dosage Timing:

Take the tablet at the same time every day, preferably in the morning hours, to maintain consistent drug levels in your body. Setting a daily reminder can help prevent missed doses.

sideEffectsDetails:
Side Effects Of BISOWEL AM TABLET

Like all medicines, BISOWEL AM TABLET may cause certain side effects in some individuals, although not everybody gets them.

Common side Effects of BISOWEL AM TABLET are:
Headache, dizziness
Somnolence (especially at the beginning of the treatment)
Palpitation, flushing
Abdominal pain
Ankle swelling, oedema
Fatigue
Feeling of coldness and numbness in the extremities
Gastrointestinal complaints such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea, constipation
Side effects of BISOWEL AM TABLET in Elderly:

Elderly patients are more likely to experience certain side effects due to age-related changes in metabolism and organ function. Common side effects of BISOWEL AM TABLET in seniors include:

Increased risk of falls from dizziness or low blood pressure
Bradycardia (very slow heartbeat)
Fatigue, confusion, or drowsiness
Swelling in the legs or feet
Worsening of kidney function if already compromised

Due to these risks, doctors may start elderly patients on a lower dose and monitor them closely for side effects. Always report any new symptoms promptly.

Side Effects in Long-Term Use of BISOWEL AM TABLET:

Using BISOWEL AM TABLET for a prolonged period can lead to certain side effects in some individuals. While many people tolerate the medicine well, long-term use may occasionally cause:

Fatigue or tiredness due to slower heart rate
Dizziness or lightheadedness, especially when standing up suddenly
Cold hands and feet due to reduced blood circulation
Mood changes, including depression or anxiety (rare)
Sexual dysfunction or decreased libido
Swelling of the ankles or feet (from Amlodipine)
Slow heart rate (bradycardia) or low blood pressure with prolonged use

Regular follow-ups with your doctor are important to monitor these effects and adjust the dosage if needed.

Serious side effects of BISOWEL AM TABLET:

Stop taking BISOWEL AM TABLET and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects:

Severe skin reactions such as stevens-johnson syndrome, toxic epidermal necrolysis (skin rash, itching, blistering, and reddening of skin all over the body, peeling and swelling of the skin, swelling of mucous membrane) 
Signs of an inflamed pancreas (severe pain in abdomen and back, feeling unwell)
Slow or abnormal heartbeat, heart attack
Severe allergic reactions (such as swelling of the eyelids, face, neck, lips, mouth, tongue, throat, or airways, chest pain and sudden wheezing which can lead to difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
Dizziness, weakness or breathing difficulties

warnings.details: BISOWEL AM TABLET is not recommended during pregnancy unless clearly advised by your doctor. BISOWEL AM TABLET may affect fetal development, especially in the second and third trimesters. Always consult your gynecologist before using any antihypertensive medicine during pregnancy.

BISOWEL AM TABLET should be used with caution while breastfeeding. Limited human data is available on the excretion of Bisoprolol and Amlodipine in breast milk. If prescribed, your doctor will weigh the benefits and risks before recommending it during lactation.

Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience tiredness, dizziness, or drowsiness, as it may impair your ability to drive or work. Consult your doctor for advice before taking BISOWEL AM TABLET.
Consumption of alcohol is not recommended during management with BISOWEL AM TABLET as it may increase the risk of tiredness, dizziness, and drowsiness.

BISOWEL AM TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Dosage adjustments may be required based on renal function. Regular monitoring of kidney parameters and blood pressure is important during treatment.

In patients with mild to moderate liver impairment, caution is advised. Your doctor may start with a lower dose. In severe liver disease, this medication may be avoided or used only under strict medical supervision.

Do not take BISOWEL AM TABLET if you are allergic to Amlodipine and Bisoprolol or if you are allergic to other drugs of the same class (calcium-channel blockers such as nifedipine, felodipine, nimodipine).
BISOWEL AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or chronic lung disease. Consult your doctor for advice before taking BISOWEL AM TABLET.

BISOWEL AM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with cardiogenic shock (where the heart cannot pump sufficient blood around the body), aortic stenosis (narrowing of the aortic heart valve), chest pain at resting position, slow or irregular heart rate, very low blood pressure, heart failure or heart attack. Consult your doctor for advice before taking this medicine.
BISOWEL AM TABLET is not recommended in children under 18 years due to limited safety and efficacy data. BISOWEL AM TABLET is typically prescribed only for adult patients with hypertension or angina.

BISOWEL AM TABLET is used with caution in elderly patients, especially those with kidney or liver impairment. Older adults may be more sensitive to the blood pressure-lowering effects, so close monitoring of blood pressure and heart rate is advised.

BISOWEL AM TABLET is not recommended in children under 18 years due to limited safety and efficacy data. BISOWEL AM TABLET is typically prescribed only for adult patients with hypertension or angina.

BISOWEL AM TABLET is used with caution in elderly patients, especially those with kidney or liver impairment. Older adults may be more sensitive to the blood pressure-lowering effects, so close monitoring of blood pressure and heart rate is advised.

introduction:
Introduction About AMLOVAS OL TABLET

AMLOVAS OL TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with AMLOVAS OL TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking AMLOVAS OL TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. AMLOVAS OL TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How AMLOVAS OL TABLET Works

AMLOVAS OL TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking the medicine, inform your doctor if you are taking any of these medicines:

Angiotensin-converting enzyme (ACE) inhibitors (Ex. enalapril, lisinopril, ramipril) or aliskiren

Diuretics (Ex. spironolactone)
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (Ex. ibuprofen, aspirin, diclofenac)
Antacids (Ex. aluminium hydroxide or magnesium hydroxide)

Anti-viral agents (Ex. ritonavir, nelfinavir, or indinavir)
Antifungal agents (Ex. ketoconazole or itraconazole)

introduction:
Introduction About TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET

TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET is a medication used to manage hypertension (high blood pressure). By lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of heart attacks and strokes. It contains a combination of two medicines, metoprolol and telmisartan which works together effectively to improve heart functions.

It is recommended to take TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET with food at the same time each day to maintain consistent blood levels. Continue taking it as prescribed by your doctor, even if you feel fine, since high blood pressure often presents no symptoms. Stopping the medication abruptly can worsen your condition. Along with the medicine, staying active, maintaining a healthy diet, and managing your weight can further help control blood pressure. Always follow your doctor’s guidance while on this therapy.

Common side effects include headache, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure, increased potassium levels, orthostatic hypotension (which may lead to fainting), breathlessness, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, and fatigue. It is advised to avoid potassium-rich foods or supplements while taking this medicine. Since it can cause dizziness, avoid driving or get up slowly from a seated position. Regular monitoring of blood pressure, blood sugar, kidney function, urea, and electrolyte levels may be required during treatment.

Before starting this medicine, inform your doctor if you have any kidney or liver issues. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should consult their doctor before use. Also, let your doctor know about any other medications you are taking, particularly those for blood pressure or heart conditions.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET Works

TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET helps in managing high blood pressure where metoprolol works by managing certain chemical messengers to bind their respective receptors in the heart and vessels, causing heart to beat slowly with less force and telmisartan blocks the effect of angiotensin II receptor (a chemical messenger that narrow down your blood vessels) that causes relaxation and widening of blood vessels resulting in lowering of blood pressure.
usageInstructions: The typical dose is one tablet daily, taken as prescribed by your doctor.
The dosage may vary based on individual health conditions, age, and response to treatment. Always follow your doctor's instructions.
Take the tablet at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels of the medication in your bloodstream.
It can be taken with or without food, but taking it with food may help reduce side effects like nausea or dizziness.
It should be taken regularly for long-term blood pressure control.
Do not stop taking the medication abruptly, as it can lead to a rebound increase in blood pressure or heart rate.
If you miss a dose take it as soon as you remember.
If it is almost time for your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and continue with your regular dosing schedule.
Do not take a double dose to make up for the missed one, as this may increase the risk of side effects.
Symptoms of overdose include severe dizziness, excessive drop in blood pressure, low or irregular heartbeat and breathing difficulties.

In case of an overdose, seek immediate medical attention or call a poison control center. Overdosing on this medication can lead to life-threatening complications, including heart failure or circulatory collapse.

warnings.details: Human and animal studies have indicated that the use of telmisartan (one of the components in this medicine) has shown to cause fetal harm. Therefore, TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. If you are pregnant or think you may be pregnant consult your doctor for advice.

TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Animal studies suggest that Telmisartan is excreted in breast milk and can lead to potential adverse effects on the lactating neonate. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or operate machines if you feel dizzy or tired after taking TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET. Consult your doctor before taking TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET since it may aggravate the low blood pressure.

TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if have impaired kidney function and managed with a blood pressure lowering medicine containing aliskiren. It should be used with caution if you have certain kidney disease such as renal artery stenosis (narrowing of the blood vessels to one or both kidneys) or have undergone kidney transplant. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET.

TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver problems such as cholestasis or biliary obstruction (disease causing difficulty in drainage of the bile from the liver and gall bladder). It should be used with caution in patients with liver diseases such as hepatic impairment. Consult your doctor before taking TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET.
TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you are allergic to metoprolol, telmisartan or any other ingredients of this medicine.

TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients bronchospastic disease (disease causing tightening of airway muscles) such as asthma, emphysema, chronic obstructive pulmonary disease or lung infections. Consult your doctor before taking TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET.

TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe bradycardia (low heart rate), heart block greater than first degree (condition in which heart beats very slowly or in abnormal rhythm), cardiogenic shock (sudden life-threatening condition in which heart fails to pump sufficient blood in the body), decompensated cardiac failure (inability of heart to accommodate and/or eject sufficient blood) or sick sinus syndrome (disorder of heart’s natural pacemaker). It should be used with caution in patients having heart trouble. Consult your doctor for advice before taking TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET.

TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years). Animal studies in young rats have shown that high doses may affect kidney development and function. These studies indicated potential adverse effects, including reduced renal perfusion and delayed renal maturation. Consult your doctor before taking TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET.

TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Regular monitoring of renal and liver function tests is advised. Consult your doctor before taking TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET.

Others

TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Are planned for non-cardiac surgery

Before taking TELSMARC BETA 50MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:           

Have pheochromocytoma (tumour of adrenal glands located on the kidneys)
Have diabetes or hypoglycaemia (low blood sugar levels)
Have history of anaphylactic reactions (signs include itching and flushed or pale skin, low blood pressure, nausea, vomiting)
Have thyrotoxicosis (too high thyroid levels in the blood)
Have peripheral vascular disease (flow to limbs due to narrowing of vessels)
Raised aldosterone levels (water and salt retention in the body along with imbalance of various blood minerals)
Low blood pressure due to dehydration (excessive loss of water from the body)
Have deficiency of salt due to diuretic therapy (water tablets), low-salt diet, diarrhoea or vomiting
Have elevated potassium levels in the blood

introduction:
Introduction About CUPINE L TABLET

CUPINE L TABLET is a combination of Amlodipine and Losartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-hypertensive agents. It is used primarily in the management of hypertension (to lower blood pressure) in stage 2 hypertensive patients. This medicine is used in adults and children the age of 6 years and above.

Hypertension is a condition where pressure is exerted on the walls of the blood vessels inside the body, making the heart difficult to pump blood out to other parts of the body. This leads to symptoms such as early morning headaches, nosebleeds, irregular heart rhythms, vision changes, and buzzing in the ears. More severe forms may cause chest pain and muscle tremors. If left unmanageed, hypertension can cause persistent chest pain (also called angina), heart attacks, heart failure, and an irregular heartbeat, which can also get life-threatening.

Before taking this medicine, inform your doctor if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to the medicine or any ingredients present in it, or if you have, liver, kidney or heart problems.

Pregnant and breastfeeding women should consult their doctors before receiving this medicine.

The most common side effects are headache, muscle cramps, nausea, vomiting and diarrhoea. Consult your doctor for advice if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

introduction:
Introduction About MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET

MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET is a triple-combination oral formulation containing Telmisartan (40mg), Amlodipine (5mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5mg). It is generally prescribed for managing blood pressure in individuals who may benefit from the complementary actions of these three ingredients. This combination works by supporting fluid balance, easing vascular tension, and encouraging optimal blood flow.

MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET can be taken with or without food. Your dosage will depend on your medical condition and how you respond to management. Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in your body. It is important to continue taking this medication until your doctor advises otherwise. Since this medicine contains a diuretic (water pill), it increases urination. To avoid disturbing your sleep, it’s best not to take it within four hours of bedtime. For best results, use this medication regularly, even if you feel fine. High blood pressure often has no symptoms, but stopping the medicine suddenly can raise your risk of heart attack or stroke.

The most common side effects of this medicine include headache, dizziness, tiredness, taste change, fatigue, flu-like symptoms, diarrhea, and sinusitis. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms bother you, worsen, or persist. Be sure to drink plenty of fluids while taking the medication to help manage muscle weakness, dry mouth, and excessive thirst.

MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET is generally advised for individuals who have experienced suboptimal outcomes with monotherapy or dual therapy, require effective management of both systolic and diastolic blood pressure, and benefit from a simplified, once-daily combination formulation to enhance adherence and management outcomes.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek their doctor's advice before taking this medicine. Additionally, make sure to tell your doctor about any other medications you are currently taking, particularly those for high blood pressure or heart conditions. Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolyte levels, and blood sugar is recommended to ensure the medication is working effectively.

How MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET Works

The tablet combines three different classes of ingredients that support cardiovascular goals by addressing multiple factors in blood pressure regulation. Each component has a distinct mechanism:

Understanding the Role of Telmisartan:

Telmisartan is part of the ARB (angiotensin receptor blocker) family. It supports relaxation of blood vessels by limiting the effects of specific hormones that cause narrowing.

What Amlodipine Contributes:

Amlodipine is a calcium channel regulator that allows smoother blood flow by acting on the muscle walls of the arteries.

Hydrochlorothiazide and Fluid Regulation:

This diuretic component helps eliminate excess salt and fluid from the body, aiding in pressure balance without compromising volume control.

Why This Triple Mechanism Matters:

When used together under professional guidance, this combination may be helpful for individuals requiring multi-pronged support in managing their cardiovascular profile.

MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET may cause dizziness, tiredness, or visual disturbances. If affected, avoid driving or operating heavy machinery until you know how the medication affects you.
Avoid drinking alcohol while taking MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET, as it may enhance the blood pressure-lowering effects, leading to increased dizziness or risk of fainting.

MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment or electrolyte imbalances. Regular kidney function tests are recommended during management. Consult your doctor before use.

MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disease, particularly due to the presence of telmisartan and amlodipine, which are processed by the liver. Dose adjustments may be necessary. Consult your doctor before use.

MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe aortic stenosis, congestive heart failure, or recent heart attack. Consult your doctor before use.
MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 18 years of age due to limited safety and efficacy data. Consult your pediatrician before giving it.

moreInfo:
More Information
A. Why MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET Preferred Choice Over Other Antihypertensive Medications?

MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET is a fixed-dose combination therapy used to manage high blood pressure effectively. It combines three well-established antihypertensive agents such as Telmisartan (40 mg), Amlodipine (5 mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5 mg) in a single tablet. This formulation offers multiple advantages over monotherapy or dual therapy options.

1. Triple-Drug Combination for Comprehensive Control

Mechanism: Targets different physiological pathways—vasodilation, fluid elimination, and renin-angiotensin system blockade.
Benefit: Enhances efficacy in patients with moderate to severe hypertension or those not controlled with monotherapy.

2. Improved Patient Compliance

Formulation: Single daily dose.
Benefit: Reduces pill burden, increases adherence, and simplifies treatment plans.

3. 24-Hour Blood Pressure Control

Pharmacokinetics: Long-acting agents ensure stable blood pressure throughout the day and night.
Benefit: Reduces early morning surges and associated cardiovascular risks.

4. Organ Protection

Telmisartan: Offers proven cardiovascular and renal protective effects, particularly in patients with:
Type 2 diabetes
Chronic kidney disease
Left ventricular hypertrophy

5. Lower Incidence of Side Effects

Balanced Dosing: Moderate doses of each component reduce the likelihood of dose-dependent side effects.
Electrolyte Stability: Telmisartan may counteract the potassium-lowering effects of hydrochlorothiazide.

6. Reduced Need for Additional Medications

Clinical Outcome: Many patients achieve target BP goals with this single tablet.
Benefit: Cost-effective and reduces complexity of management.

7. Evidence-Based Components

Each drug is individually supported by strong clinical evidence for blood pressure reduction and cardiovascular risk mitigation.

Conclusion

MAYUTEL TRIO TABLET is an effective, convenient, and well-tolerated option for managing hypertension, especially in patients requiring multi-drug therapy. It enhances blood pressure control, offers organ protection, and promotes management adherence, making it a preferred option under medical guidance.

introduction:
Introduction About CULMI A 40 TABLET

CULMI A 40 TABLET is used for the management of high blood pressure among patients who remain unresponsive to therapy with either olmesartan or amlodipine alone. It is a combination of Amlodipine and Olmesartan, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antihypertensive agents.

During management with CULMI A 40 TABLET, your doctor might check your kidney function, blood pressure, and electrolyte (Ex. potassium) concentration in your blood at regular intervals to avoid the risk of unwanted side effects. Avoid consumption of grapefruit or grapefruit juice while taking the medicine, as it could lead to an unpredictable decrease in blood pressure. Before taking CULMI A 40 TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any liver, kidney, or heart disease. It is not recommended in early pregnancy and must not be taken if you are more than 3 months pregnant, as it may cause serious harm to your baby if used at that stage.

It is not recommended for mothers who are breast-feeding, and your doctor may choose another treatment for you if you wish to breast-feed, especially if your baby is newborn, or was born prematurely. CULMI A 40 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged under 18 years) due to a lack of safety data. It should be taken with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or older). The most common side effects are headache, dizziness, tiredness, edema, sore throat, and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

CULMI A 40 TABLET effectively reduces elevated blood pressure, where Olmesartan acts by inhibiting the actions of angiotensin-II (a peptide hormone that causes narrowing of blood vessels and an increase in blood pressure) at the angiotensin-II receptors of the kidneys, and Amlodipine acts by blocking the influx of calcium in the blood vessels by inhibiting the voltage-gated calcium channels, thus causing vascular smooth muscle relaxation, vasodilation, and a marked decrease in blood pressure.

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of CULMI A 40 TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital right away. Overdosage symptoms include low blood pressure, dizziness, and a fast or slow heartbeat.

Introduction About TAZPURE AM TABLET
What is TAZPURE AM TABLET Tablet?

TAZPURE AM TABLET is a prescription medicine used to manage high blood pressure (hypertension). It contains Telmisartan (40mg) and Amlodipine (5mg), which help to relax blood vessels and improve blood flow.

TAZPURE AM TABLET helps to controls high blood pressure, reduces the risk of heart-related complications and improves blood circulation.

Take one TAZPURE AM TABLET daily with or without food, as directed by your doctor. Do not exceed the prescribed dose.

Avoid alcohol while taking TAZPURE AM TABLET. Inform your doctor if you have kidney or liver disease.

The most common side effects of taking TAZPURE AM TABLET are dizziness, swelling in ankles or feet, headache or fatigue. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

How TAZPURE AM TABLET Works

1. Telmisartan (Angiotensin II Receptor Blocker - ARB):

Blocks Angiotensin II, a hormone that narrows blood vessels and increases blood pressure
When blocked, blood vessels stay relaxed and open, lowering blood pressure

2. Amlodipine (Calcium Channel Blocker - CCB):

Inhibits calcium from entering blood vessel muscles, stopping them from tightening
This helps blood vessels remain wide, allowing better blood flow and reducing pressure

Patients with hypertension – helps control blood pressure and reduces complications
Individuals with Heart disease – reduces the risk of heart attack, stroke, and heart failure
People with poor blood circulation – helps widen blood vessels and improve oxygen flow

introduction:
Introduction About TELMICHEK AH TABLET

TELMICHEK AH TABLET is a combination medication specifically designed to manage hypertension (high blood pressure) when a single therapy is insufficient. By effectively lowering blood pressure, it reduces the risk of severe complications such as heart attack, stroke, and kidney damage.

This medicine combines the benefits of Telmisartan, Amlodipine, and Hydrochlorothiazide, providing a comprehensive solution to manage high blood pressure. It works by relaxing blood vessels, improving blood flow, and increasing urine output (diuretic effect) to help reduce fluid retention, which can contribute to high blood pressure.

Take TELMICHEK AH TABLET with or without food, ideally at the same time every day for maximum effectiveness. As it contains a diuretic (water pill), it may cause increased urination. Avoid taking it within four hours of bedtime to prevent sleep disturbances.

Even if you feel well, continue using this medication as prescribed, as hypertension often shows no symptoms but poses significant health risks if untreated.

Before taking TELMICHEK AH TABLET, inform your doctor if you have liver or kidney problems, are pregnant, or are breastfeeding before starting this medication. Let your doctor know about any other medications you’re taking, especially those for heart conditions or blood pressure.

Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolytes, and blood sugar levels is essential to ensure the medicine is working effectively. By consistently taking TELMICHEK AH TABLET and following medical advice, you can manage high blood pressure effectively and reduce the risk of life-threatening complications.

The most common side effects of TELMICHEK AH TABLET includes headache, dizziness, and fatigue, taste changes, diarrhea, and sinusitis, flu-like symptoms and muscle weakness. Stay hydrated to manage side effects like dry mouth, muscle cramps, and excessive thirst. If these symptoms persist or worsen, consult your doctor promptly.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELMICHEK AH TABLET Works

TELMICHEK AH TABLET helps to manage hypertension. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that relaxes blood vessels by inhibiting the entry of calcium into the muscle cells of the heart and blood vessels. This reduces blood pressure and improves blood flow, making it easier for the heart to pump blood.

Hydrochlorothiazide is a thiazide diuretic that helps the kidneys remove excess salt and water from the body. This reduces fluid buildup, lowers blood pressure, and helps decrease swelling (edema).

Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB) that relaxes blood vessels by blocking the action of angiotensin II, a hormone that causes blood vessels to constrict. This helps lower blood pressure and makes it easier for the heart to circulate blood.

Introduction About TELSAT AM TABLET

TELSAT AM TABLET is used in the management of hypertension. It is preferably used when treatment with single BP medicines does not provide adequate control in blood pressure.

It contains a combination of two medicines, namely Amlodipine and Telmisartan which works by relaxing the blood vessels supplying the heart and other organs which reduces the strain on the heart and decreases blood pressure.

Take TELSAT AM TABLET under medical supervision. It can be taken with or without meals. Do not take alcohol or grapefruit juice while taking TELSAT AM TABLET, as it could severely decrease your blood pressure.

Before taking TELSAT AM TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver disease, kidney disease or any other heart conditions apart from hypertension such as heart failure, etc. You must also inform your doctor if have diabetes, swelling of body parts or any other pre-existing medical conditions.

Do not take TELSAT AM TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant and breastfeeding as a precaution. The most common side effects of taking TELSAT AM TABLET are dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness, sudden drop in blood pressure with fainting, racing heartbeat, and flushing or redness of face and neck. Talk to your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How TELSAT AM TABLET Works

TELSAT AM TABLET is a combination of two medications namely, amlodipine and telmisartan. Amlodipine is a calcium channel blocker that works by relaxing the blood vessels and improving blood flow by preventing calcium from entering the muscles of the heart and arteries, which helps to lower blood pressure. Telmisartan is an angiotensin II receptor blocker (ARB), which blocks the hormone angiotensin II, preventing it from tightening blood vessels. This also helps relax the blood vessels and reduce blood pressure. Together, these two drugs provide better control of high blood pressure.

introduction:
Introduction About TAZPURE TRIO TABLET

TAZPURE TRIO TABLET is a triple-combination oral formulation containing Telmisartan (40mg), Amlodipine (5mg), and Hydrochlorothiazide (12.5mg). It is generally prescribed for managing blood pressure in individuals who may benefit from the complementary actions of these three ingredients. This combination works by supporting fluid balance, easing vascular tension, and encouraging optimal blood flow.

TAZPURE TRIO TABLET can be taken with or without food. Your dosage will depend on your medical condition and how you respond to management. Try to take it at the same time each day to maintain consistent levels in your body. It is important to continue taking this medication until your doctor advises otherwise. Since this medicine contains a diuretic (water pill), it increases urination. To avoid disturbing your sleep, it’s best not to take it within four hours of bedtime. For best results, use this medication regularly, even if you feel fine. High blood pressure often has no symptoms, but stopping the medicine suddenly can raise your risk of heart attack or stroke.

The most common side effects of this medicine include headache, dizziness, tiredness, taste change, fatigue, flu-like symptoms, diarrhea, and sinusitis. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms bother you, worsen, or persist. Be sure to drink plenty of fluids while taking the medication to help manage muscle weakness, dry mouth, and excessive thirst.

TAZPURE TRIO TABLET is generally advised for individuals who have experienced suboptimal outcomes with monotherapy or dual therapy, require effective management of both systolic and diastolic blood pressure, and benefit from a simplified, once-daily combination formulation to enhance adherence and management outcomes.

Before taking this medication, inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. Pregnant or breastfeeding women should also seek their doctor's advice before taking this medicine. Additionally, make sure to tell your doctor about any other medications you are currently taking, particularly those for high blood pressure or heart conditions. Regular monitoring of your blood pressure, kidney function, electrolyte levels, and blood sugar is recommended to ensure the medication is working effectively.

Understanding the Role of Telmisartan:

Telmisartan is part of the ARB (angiotensin receptor blocker) family. It supports relaxation of blood vessels by limiting the effects of specific hormones that cause narrowing.

Amlodipine is a calcium channel regulator that allows smoother blood flow by acting on the muscle walls of the arteries.

Hydrochlorothiazide and Fluid Regulation:

This diuretic component helps eliminate excess salt and fluid from the body, aiding in pressure balance without compromising volume control.

Why This Triple Mechanism Matters:

When used together under professional guidance, this combination may be helpful for individuals requiring multi-pronged support in managing their cardiovascular profile.
